raw.excerpt: We are looking for an Accounting Methodology & Automation Manager to join our Finance team and support the Group's ERP implementation and ongoing business transformation.
raw.description:
We are looking for an Accounting Methodology & Automation Manager to join our Finance team and support the Group's ERP implementation and ongoing business transformation.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of accounting, finance, business and IT. You will translate business requirements and changes into accounting methodology, define how accounting processes should work in ERP and 1C, and collaborate with developers and business analysts to automate them.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain accounting methodology for the Group's business models, including merchant and agency models (net / gross), prepayment and postpayment, B2B and B2C transactions across hotels, air, rail, transfers and ancillary services;
  • Design accounting rules, posting logic and chart-of-accounts requirements, defining the data needed to automate accounting processes in ERP and 1C;
  • Translate business scenarios, new products and process changes into accounting requirements and technical specifications for developers and business analysts;
  • Define data sources, field mappings, document flows and reconciliation logic, including the handling of corrections and disputes;
  • Collaborate with IT, product teams, business analysts and other stakeholders to implement and improve accounting processes;
  • Ensure that automated accounting entries are aligned with supplier and partner settlements, as well as intercompany balances;
  • Analyse the accounting implications of new products, contracts and system changes under IFRS, with a particular focus on IFRS 15;
  • Design and improve intercompany accounting and settlement processes between Group entities;
  • Support ERP implementation and rollout to new entities, including accounting methodology, migration rules and process standardisation;
  • Review supplier, partner and intercompany contracts from an accounting and VAT perspective, identifying potential improvements to invoicing and payment processes;
  • Support operational accountants on methodological matters and perform user acceptance testing (UAT) of automated accounting processes before go-live.

Requirements

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field;
  • At least 5 years of experience in accounting, including 2+ years in accounting methodology, accounting process automation or accounting systems implementation;
  • Solid knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 15, including revenue recognition and principal-versus-agent considerations;
  • Practical experience working with ERP systems or 1C, with an understanding of accounting logic, posting rules and document flows — beyond day-to-day system usage;
  • Experience translating business requirements into accounting methodology and technical specifications for developers or business analysts;
  • Understanding of how accounting processes and data flows are organised and automated across different systems;
  • Practical experience with SQL or writing queries to retrieve and analyse data would be an advantage;
  • Understanding of APIs and system integrations;
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large data sets in Excel, including pivot tables and lookup functionsl
  • Ability to work independently, manage project timelines and deliver results;
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex accounting matters to both finance and technical teams;
  • Language proficiency: Upper-Intermediate English (B2) or higher; other languages are a plus.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely;
  • Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together;
  • Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities;
  • Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences;
  • Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world;
  • Corporate prices on hotels and travel services;
  • MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accounting Specialist to join our growing Finance team. Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will take primary responsibility for Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable while supporting reconciliations, month-end activities, financial reporting, and general accounting.

Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit memos, and account adjustments accurately and on time.
  • Record and apply customer payments to the appropriate accounts and invoices.
  • Monitor outstanding balances and proactively follow up on overdue accounts.
  • Investigate short payments, credits, payment discrepancies, and other account issues.
  • Reconcile customer accounts and resolve outstanding items.
  • Prepare and maintain AR aging and collections reports.

Accounts Payable

  • Review, verify, and process vendor invoices.
  • Match invoices against purchase orders and supporting documentation where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records and payment schedules.
  • Prepare vendor payments for review and approval.
  • Monitor upcoming payment obligations and help ensure timely processing.
  • Reconcile vendor statements and investigate billing discrepancies.

General Accounting & Month-End

  • Perform bank and corporate credit card reconciliations.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with journal entries and general ledger activities as required.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
  • Prepare account reconciliations and financial schedules.
  • Identify discrepancies and ensure they are investigated and resolved promptly.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on accounting experience, including both Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable.
  • Professional proficiency in English(written and verbal)
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting or ERP system.
  • A good understanding of general accounting principles, the general ledger, accruals, reconciliations, and month-end procedures.
  • Experience preparing or working with AR and AP aging reports.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate financial records.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies and independently work through accounting issues.

Why Join GG TEQ?

A fully remote role where you will have the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of core accounting processes, work closely with teams across the business, and help strengthen the systems and practices that support a growing organization. This role offers exposure beyond transaction processing and the chance to expand your experience in general accounting, reporting, controls, and process improvement.Salary: $1500 USD Monthly

You will be part of a multi-touchpoint integrated digital ecosystem to drive growth with new customers (Reach) & current customers (Penetration). You will use data and CRM tools to plan and execute sales calls to establish yourself as a valuable partner and grow market share in your territory.



Who You Are and What You'll Do

You will be accountable for delivering business targets like Sales Growth, Reach & Penetration, Digital Engagement, and customer presentations with both Operators and Distributor Trade Partners. You are Responsible to execute Multi touchpoint contact strategy online and face to face for generating demand for Food Solutions Products & deliver great customer experience. You will provide virtual culinary consultation to targeted operators.

It is an exciting role and a great development opportunity for an ambitious and motivated individual. It’s a role where the right individual can really make a difference

Demand Creation: Operators and Local Chain Accounts

Engage with Local Chain Account and Operator Customers, and be accountable for delivering business targets for the assigned Territory i.e. Turnover, Reach & Penetration & digital, FPO (Fully Profiled Operators), Digital Engagement, Demos, Sampling etc.

Implement full Key Account Management approach. Execute CBP, Win & Retain funnel, Contact Matrix and execute Multi touchpoint contact strategy on and off-line. i.e. 20% Online Calls & 80% F2F Calls


Key Activities
• Using Dat to convert Business Insights into Activation Solution Selling
• Utilize Market Trends to create Concept Solution Selling 
• Gain insight and lead customers to the right solution
• Network to key customer stakeholders to engage the right decision makers
• Prepare visits with solution recommendation and utilize CRM Salesforce system to manage workflow and overall market funnel
• Conduct F2F and Virtual Sampling, Ideation, Cooking Demo using culinary knowledge to secure new opportunities or increase volume usage by new menu applications or into existing dishes. Use relevant selling stories to help deliver the revenue savings and or efficiency improvements from UFS solutions
• Follow up on previous calls to ensure opportunities progress to the sale close.
• Secure and coordinate customer Orders each month to ensure growth is on target
• Meet with Distributors/Trade Partners to expand assortment, align on priorities and source leads for customer follow through
• Build & Nurture relationships with local Distributor Sales Rep’s (DSRs)
• Implement Contact Matrix for Key Trade customers with a Squad approach (where possible) for more effective customer management 
• Engage trade customers to gain alignment for Secondary Sales Data (SSD)
• Implement Promotions with customer related to key seasons and events
• Ensure timely submission & settlement of claims


What You’ll Need to Succeed

Critical Skills Required for the Role


  • You are a Hunter with big Ambition. You seek effective ways to create New Demand (70% Hunting vs 30% Farming)
    • You are a fast adopter of Contemporary technology and are already using AI in your day-to-day life. You are highly proficient in MS office including Power BI and Excel
    • You are Entrepreneurial and proactively create mutually beneficial solutions for UFS and your customers
    • You are Curious and are constantly learning from the Market on how to stay ahead of the food trends in your market
    • You know how to sell Premium Brands with Superiority Selling stories and Culinary Solutions outside center of the plate

• Bilingual is a plus (Spanish, English)


Essential Experiences

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in similar and relevant positions within the market/industry.
    • Bachelor’s degree preferred; candidates with substantial and relevant industry experience will also be considered.
    • CPG Foodservice Sales Experience (B2B Sales)

• Culinary/Chef Selling Experiences

  • Network of Existing Foodservice Operator Partners
    • Distributor Sales or Ingredient Sales or Broker Sales
    • Experiences CRM (Salesforce)
    • Operator Experience
    • Market/Geographical knowledge
    • Food University Background (CIA, Food & Hospitality)
    • Multi-National Corporate Company Experience – Understands Corporate Ways of Working

raw.excerpt: Clinisys’ AI PhilosophyBuilding an AI first organization is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver.
raw.description:
Clinisys’ AI Philosophy

Building an AI first organization is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we develop AI enabled, cloud-based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier, safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. Every team member must help drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.

Role Summary

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the successful management and delivery of customer engagements, with full accountability for project planning, execution and outcomes.

The role focuses on delivering high-quality implementations and exceptional customer satisfaction through effective expectation management, proactive communication and close management of project risks and issues.

Working across a cross-functional environment, the Senior Project Manager will collaborate with technical consultants, professional services, Product Development, Product Management, application engineering, Sales and other internal teams. The role will also support continuous improvement across the Project Management team and provide mentoring to Associate Project Managers and Project Managers.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, organise and manage assigned projects, with accountability for delivery on time, within budget and scope, and to a high standard of customer satisfaction.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets, financial forecasts, resources, dependencies, risks, issues and change control.

  • Proactively manage internal and external stakeholder expectations around scope, deliverables, timelines, project status, risks and issues.

  • Lead regular project meetings, ensuring responsibilities, milestones and deliverables are clearly understood and remain on track.

  • Apply established PMI and project management methodologies to effectively manage project delivery.

  • Collaborate with Product Development, Services and other internal teams to ensure quality deliverables, aligned schedules and seamless client handoffs.

  • Review project schedules and forecasts, escalating risks and issues and working with senior management to address delivery challenges.

  • Support the standardisation of project documentation, processes and ways of working, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Mentor Associate Project Managers and Project Managers in project management best practices.

  • Partner with Program Managers and Project Management Leadership to identify challenges and develop solutions.

  • Use AI tools to support efficient and effective ways of working.

Experience & Education

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, a laboratory-related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years’ project or program management experience delivering complex enterprise software solutions.

  • 5+ years’ experience working with senior client stakeholders, including Director level or above.

  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • Knowledge of laboratory workflows.

  • PMP or PRINCE2 certification, or ability to obtain certification within two years of employment.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Copilot.

Preferred

  • Experience working within hospitals or laboratories.

  • LIMS implementation project management experience.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career and in areas of your life outside of work. From health and wellness benefits, 401 (k) Savings Plan, stock incentive programs, paid time off, parental leave, and tuition assistance, we've got you covered with our total rewards package. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $100,000 - $125,000 annual base salary. The successful candidate’s actual pay will be based on various factors, such as work location, qualifications, and experience, so the actual starting pay may be above or below this range.

Physical Requirements:

  • Work is performed remotely or in a normal office setting with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards. Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds with assistance as part of office routine

  • 30% Travel may be required

  • Moderate lifting/carrying 15-44 lbs.; use of fingers; walking/standing 2-6 hours

  • Exposure to hazardous materials or various weather conditions

  • Travel to client sites that can pose risk associated with healthcare organization

  • May be required to follow customer location health and safety requirements

Clinisys’ Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Clinisys Information systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

General Guidance:

This job description is meant to provide an accurate depiction of tasks and accountabilities that are most often associated with this role. While we strive to provide an accurate depiction, nothing in this description restricts the company from changing, reassigning, expanding or reducing scope of accountabilities and is subject to change at any time.

Onboarding:

As part of our onboarding process, all new employees will be required to attend / travel to the office on their first day of employment (Raleigh, NC / Tucson, AZ / Carmel, IN). This requirement is essential for onboarding activities, including the identity verification, completion of necessary documentation, receiving your IT equipment, introductions to key team members, and orientation to Clinisys policies and procedures.

  • Results-oriented

L1 Technical IT Engineer - Azure Infrastructure Support

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused L1 Azure Infrastructure Support Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team. The role is responsible for providing 24x7 operational support for Azure-based infrastructure environments, monitoring cloud resources, responding to alerts and incidents, and performing day-to-day administration of Windows and Linux systems hosted in Microsoft Azure.

The ideal candidate should possess foundational Azure cloud knowledge, basic system administration skills, and a strong willingness to learn and grow within a managed services environment.

Key Responsibilities

Monitoring & Incident Management

  • Monitor Azure infrastructure, applications, and services using approved monitoring tools.
  • Acknowledge, triage, and respond to alerts and incidents within agreed SLAs.
  • Perform first-level troubleshooting and resolution of infrastructure issues.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex incidents to L2/L3 support teams following defined procedures.
  • Participate in major incident bridges and provide timely updates.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of incidents, service requests, and resolutions.

Azure Infrastructure Support

  • Monitor and support Azure Virtual Machines (Windows and Linux).
  • Perform routine operational tasks on Azure resources.
  • Monitor Azure networking components including Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, and VPN connections.
  • Support Azure Backup and recovery operations.
  • Assist with storage administration and capacity monitoring.
  • Validate successful completion of scheduled jobs and maintenance activities.

Operating System Administration

  • Perform routine health checks on servers and infrastructure components.
  • Support patching and maintenance activities as per established procedures.
  • Perform basic troubleshooting of Windows Server and Linux systems patching and backup issues.

Service Requests & Change Support

  • Execute standard service requests and operational tasks.
  • Support implementation of approved changes under supervision.
  • Validate system health before and after changes.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and change documentation.

Documentation & Communication

  • Maintain and update operational runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
  • Provide detailed shift handovers to incoming support teams.
  • Communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and operational reviews.

Technical Skills

Microsoft Azure

Basic knowledge and operational support experience with:

  • Azure Virtual Machines
  • Azure Virtual Networks (VNet)
  • Network Security Groups (NSG)
  • Azure Storage Accounts
  • Azure Backup
  • Azure Monitor
  • Log Analytics Workspace
  • Azure Alerts and Action Groups
  • Azure DNS
  • Recovery Services Vault

Windows Administration

  • Event Viewer Analysis
  • Disk and File System Management
  • Service Monitoring
  • Basic PowerShell knowledge

Linux Administration

  • Service Management
  • Log Analysis
  • Basic Shell Scripting

Monitoring Tools

Experience or exposure to:

  • Azure Monitor
  • AlertOps
  • Other infrastructure monitoring tools

ITSM Tools

Experience using ticketing and service management platforms such as:

  • ServiceNow
  • HaloITSM

Preferred Skills

  • Basic PowerShell scripting.
  • Understanding of cloud security concepts.
  • Exposure to Azure DevOps and automation tools.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring and alert management.
  • Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Understanding of ITIL processes and best practices.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or Graduate .
  • Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in Infrastructure Support, Cloud Operations, Service Desk, or Technical Support.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure environments preferred.
  • Experience supporting Windows and Linux operating systems.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) - Preferred
  • ITIL Foundation Certification - Preferred

Soft Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 rotational shift environment.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good documentation and reporting skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple incidents simultaneously.
  • Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn new technologies.

About Rackspace Technology

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.


More on Rackspace Technology

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance.

Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries.

To learn more about us we encourage you to visit

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic, results-driven Services Sales Manager to join our EMEA team . This is a role for an active, hands-on person who is not afraid to pick up the phone, and who is also a true team player. In this pivotal role, you will work closely with our Direct Sales teams and our Services customer team to grow our services business and make sure customers receive best-in-class solutions and ongoing support.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Management

  • Play an active leadership role within the Global Programs Leadership Team, alongside divisional executives and regional directors.
  • Set and implement the GAPS strategy through 2030, translating agency priorities into annual plans, performance measures, resource allocations, and clear accountabilities.
  • Lead the GAPS Senior Management Team and build an integrated department across Global Awards, Project Support and Delivery, the Project Management Unit, the Field Management Response Team, Contracts, and the World Bank Support Unit.
  • Establish clear roles, decision rights, governance, and ways of working across GAPS and with PIQA, GREM, regions, country programs, Finance, Operations, Human Resources, and other service departments.
  • Supervise Global Award Project Directors and leaders of GAPS units, ensuring strong performance management, coaching, succession planning, staff wellbeing, workload management, and talent development for direct and lower-tier staff.
  • Work with the geographic homes of GAPS staff to ensure effective matrix management and equitable access to departmental support.
  • Provide executive oversight of departmental performance, operational challenges, staffing capacity, and progress toward established goals and objectives.
  • Communicate the GAPS value proposition and represent the department’s needs and contributions across the agency.

Global Portfolio Stewardship, Award Compliance, Finance, and Risk

  • Ensure all awards are implemented in compliance with donor requirements and CRS policies, procedures, program management standards, and internal controls.
  • Maintain executive-level visibility of portfolio performance, expenditure, reach, deliverables, risks, and corrective actions through regular award performance and budget reviews.
  • Establish escalation and decision-making mechanisms for awards at risk and ensure timely, documented corrective action.
  • Oversee award negotiation, start-up, implementation, modification, transition, and close-out, ensuring commitments are translated into executable staffing, governance, partner, budget, milestone, and risk-management plans.
  • Ensure the Project Support and Delivery Unit provides consistent, high-quality, full-lifecycle support for US Government and non-US Government awards, including donor reporting, compliance, negotiation, modifications, close-out, donor relationship management, and audit-response support.
  • Build sustainable service and cost-recovery models for Project Support and Delivery and strengthen CRS capacity to pursue, negotiate, manage, and close grants, cooperative agreements, and contracts.
  • Ensure early involvement of Project Support and Delivery and Contracts in opportunity and award design, with appropriate contracting readiness and compliance support throughout delivery.
  • Review new or updated CRS policies and procedures, identify implications for global programs, and work with policy owners to address operational and contracting challenges proactively.
  • Coordinate with global, regional, and country program operations to ensure sound budgeting, resource stewardship, contingency planning, and appropriate support to Project Directors and Chiefs of Party.
  • Balance portfolio growth with CRS’s institutional and delivery capacity, escalating investment, staffing, and risk decisions when needed.

Program Quality, Project Management, Partnership, and Learning

  • Provide agency-wide leadership for project management standards, guidance, tools, templates, onboarding, training, coaching, and communities of practice.
  • Integrate project management with ProPack, Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning, safeguarding, partnership, internal controls, and program-quality standards.
  • Ensure appropriate technical assistance is incorporated within global awards and coordinate the effective deployment of short-term technical and operational support through the Field Management Response Team and other mechanisms.
  • Identify portfolio-wide gaps in resources, staffing, systems, or oversight and develop and implement corrective actions.
  • Set expectations for meaningful country, regional, government, and partner participation, ensuring local leadership and subsidiarity inform award design, governance, staffing, implementation, and transition.
  • Oversee strategic partner selection, negotiation, due diligence, relationship management, and capacity strengthening so global awards reinforce rather than bypass country and partner systems.
  • Develop a pipeline of project management leaders and strengthen the capacity of CRS staff and partners to deliver complex awards successfully.
  • Capture and share lessons, successes, failures, and emerging practices across awards; use portfolio evidence to improve policies, systems, tools, staffing models, and business development decisions.
  • Maintain effective GAPS information platforms and dashboards and promote learning on new donor mechanisms, contracts, milestone-based awards, global mechanisms, and locally led delivery.

Global Opportunities and Responsible Growth

  • Provide senior leadership and decision-making for complex global and multi-country opportunities, in coordination with PIQA, GREM, regions, country programs, Finance, Operations, and other contributors.
  • Oversee opportunity intake, country consultation and selection, strategic fit and capacity assessment, go/no-go decisions, capture, proposal governance, review, submission, negotiation, and transition to award start-up.
  • Approve or escalate proposed management structures, staffing arrangements, partner strategies, risk assumptions, resource requirements, and investment decisions.
  • Maintain and prioritize a global business development pipeline, positioning and capture strategies, and an up-to-date business development strategy.
  • Ensure documented handover from business development to award start-up and implementation, with clear ownership of commitments, risks, deliverables, and decisions.
  • Maintain oversight of Global Opportunities and Multi-Opportunity Mechanisms in Gateway and ensure accurate, timely information for decision-makers.
  • Oversee the World Bank Support Unit’s full-cycle positioning, capture, proposal, negotiation, delivery, compliance, risk-management, and learning support for World Bank Group-funded work.
  • Guide CRS engagement with the World Bank Group and regional development banks, including the Asian Development Bank, Inter-American Development Bank, and African Development Bank, and ensure readiness for relevant procurement, contracting, environmental and social, and third-party implementation requirements.
  • Nurture strategic partnerships with peer organizations, research institutions, government entities, faith actors, and private-sector partners as potential primes, consortium members, or subrecipients.
  • Drive continuous improvement of business development processes and tools and leverage strong performance and learning from existing awards to pursue responsible follow-on funding.

Representation

  • Maintain strong strategic relationships with current and prospective donors, especially the World Bank Group, U.S. Government, Global Fund, Gavi, foundations, corporations, and donors supporting global awards.
  • Represent CRS in high-level donor negotiations, formal award discussions, major donor functions, and relevant World Bank and faith-based working groups.
  • Exercise delegated decision-making and signatory authority as assigned, making or escalating time-sensitive decisions that affect major awards, financial exposure, delivery, and agency reputation.
  • Brief the Global Programs Leadership Team, Executive Leadership Team, Regional Directors, and other senior governance bodies on portfolio performance, opportunities, risks, and investment decisions.
  • Maintain strong strategic relationships with primes, consortium partners, research institutions, and private-sector partners supporting global awards.
  • Ensure marketing and communication plans communicate global award results, lessons, and impact and support future positioning.
  • Represent GAPS with relevant internal stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent strategic, analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate agency strategy into practical portfolio and departmental decisions.
  • Strong executive judgment and demonstrated ability to assess delivery capacity, financial exposure, operational risk, and reputational implications.
  • Excellent relationship-management and negotiation skills, with the ability to represent CRS and exercise influence at senior levels internally and externally.
  • Extensive knowledge of multiple donors and multilateral development banks, including their practices, preferences, procurement approaches, contracting modalities, and applicable regulations.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. Government grants, cooperative agreements, and contracts and familiarity with World Bank Group-funded operations and requirements.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and communicate complex portfolio issues clearly.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to manage leaders and staff at different career levels in a diverse global workforce.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish governance, decision rights, performance measures, and cross-functional ways of working in a complex, multicultural organization.
  • Ability to use evidence, learning, and portfolio data to drive continuous improvement, responsible growth, and organizational change.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft products and familiarity with enterprise project, award, finance, and information-management systems; experience with Oracle products is a plus.

Required Languages: Fluency in written and spoken English required; ability to work effectively in French a plus.

Travel: Must be willing and able to travel internationally and domestically up to 15%.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

Key Working Relationships:

  • Internal: GAPS Senior Management Team; Global Award Project Directors and Chiefs of Party; Project Support and Delivery; Field Management Response Team; Project Management Unit; Contracts; World Bank Support Unit; Global Programs Finance and Operations; PIQA; GREM/Institutional Funding; Government Relations; Human Resources; Safeguarding; regional and country leadership; Regional Directors; Global Programs Leadership Team; and Executive Leadership Team.
  • External: Bilateral and multilateral donors; the World Bank Group and regional development banks; foundations and corporations; government counterparts; primes, consortium partners, research institutions, faith actors, and private-sector partners.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

Are you ready to see your career take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.

The Executive Supply Chain FLIGHT DECK Leader drives the deployment of FLIGHT DECK across the GE Aerospace Supply Chain organization, which includes Procurement & Supplier Management, Materials Management, Industrial Transformation, and Engineering Material Systems. Reporting to the CES FLIGHT DECK & AI leader with a dotted line to the VP, Supply Chain, this leader coaches leaders, leads kaizen in transactional and physical value streams, and extends lean into the supply base to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

Job Description

Role & Responsibilities

As the Executive Supply Chain FLIGHT DECK Leader, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as facilitator, educator, advocate, consultant, subject matter expert, and accountability partner to the Supply Chain leadership team to drive the understanding and application of FLIGHT DECK
  • Lead and execute high-impact lean transformations across all four Supply Chain teams to achieve operating goals using KPI-based performance management
  • Map and improve end-to-end supply chain value streams (supplier to sourcing, planning/SIOP, logistics and fulfillment, shop/RSP, and customer) and build a kaizen funnel tied to Supply Chain hoshin kanri priorities, including LEAP program flow, RSP material delivery, and mid-term delivery
  • Champion kaizen and facilitate events in transactional processes (sourcing, procure-to-pay, compliance, supply planning, fulfillment) and physical flow (distribution, materials readiness, supplier operations)
  • Partner with Procurement & Supplier Management to extend FLIGHT DECK into the supply base through supplier kaizens, capacity and readiness assessments, and delivery recovery
  • Partner with Industrial Transformation and Engineering Material Systems to build lean into the industrialization of emerging technologies and materials (e.g., additive, CMC/PMC, critical minerals)
  • Coach, mentor, and develop organizational capability in daily management, action planning, and problem solving so that results are achieved and sustained
  • Stand up model areas within Supply Chain and scale them through robust transformation plans that deliver breakthrough results
  • Partner with the CES FLIGHT DECK & AI team and Supply Chain enabling functions (Operations, HR, Finance, DT, Comms, Legal) to deploy best-practice capability, standard work, and AI-enabled tools across the organization

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in lean / operational excellence, supply chain, or operations leadership

Additional Information

  • The ideal candidate will reside locally to the Cincinnati, OH area or be open to relocation with the ability to travel up to 50% to Supply Chain sites and supplier locations based on business needs
  • For those who are remote, Central or Eastern time zones are strongly preferred with the ability to travel more than 50% to Supply Chain sites and supplier locations based on business needs
  • Remote workers: this role will require in-person attendance for New Hire Orientation on Day 1

Desired Qualifications

  • Demonstrated lean leadership: sets a clear vision, engages and empowers others, models expected behaviors, and manages resistance to change
  • Proven ability to influence across a matrix and deliver results without direct authority, including through a dotted-line relationship with business leadership
  • Executive presence and stakeholder management with senior leaders, their staffs, and supplier executives
  • Ability to apply lean strategically to Supply Chain objectives such as supplier delivery, material availability, cost, and readiness for new materials and technologies
  • Expertise in end-to-end value stream mapping and the full set of FLIGHT DECK fundamentals (VSM, Daily Management, Problem Solving, Action Planning, 5S, Standard Work, Operating Cadences, Flow/Pull, TPM)
  • Experience applying daily management and structured problem solving to transactional and planning processes (sourcing, procure-to-pay, SIOP, fulfillment)
  • Track record of designing and leading large-scale, multi-team transformations with mechanisms that sustain year-over-year improvement
  • Hands-on supplier development or supplier kaizen experience, ideally in aerospace or another regulated industry
  • Ability to link lean results to Supply Chain KPIs (supplier on-time delivery, past due, inventory/turns, cost-out, lead time) and to the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Demonstrated commitment to developing others, driving culture change, and respect for people

The base pay range for this position is $300,000.00-$350,000.00. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on 11/16/2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

#FLIGHTDECK

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

About the Role

We are seeking an outgoing, articulate, and customer-service-driven Patient Outreach & Referral Coordinator to lead our patient engagement and referral management workflows.

In this role, your primary responsibility will be connecting directly with patients via phone calls and text messaging. You will manage incoming/outgoing specialist referrals, conduct proactive outreach to patients to guide them through care steps, and ensure seamless follow-up. If you naturally enjoy speaking with people, building rapport over the phone, and providing a warm customer service experience, this position is ideal for you.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Phone & Text Patient Outreach

  • Conduct outbound phone calls and send text communications to connect with patients regarding appointment reminders, care updates, and follow-ups.
  • Serve as an empathetic, friendly, and reassuring point of contact for patients navigating their care plans.
  • Maintain high call volume standards while ensuring every patient feels listened to and supported.

2. Referral Management & Specialist Tracking

  • Process, log, and track inbound and outbound patient referrals to external specialists and diagnostic centers.
  • Perform follow-up outreach with specialist offices and diagnostic facilities to confirm appointment dates and obtain clinical consult notes.
  • Keep patients continuously updated via phone or text on the status of their pending referrals.

3. Customer Service & Patient Retention

  • Apply strong customer service skills to answer patient inquiries, address concerns, and de-escalate patient frustration over the phone.
  • Reach out to overdue or un-scheduled patients to assist them in getting their required care booked promptly.
  • Document all phone conversations, text exchanges, and referral tracking updates accurately in the practice Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Communication Excellence: Flawless, exceptionally clear spoken and written English with a pleasant, warm telephone voice and active listening skills.
  • Phone & Customer Service Experience: Prior experience in customer service, call handling, or patient communication roles where phone interaction was a primary duty.
  • Interpersonal Passion: A genuine enjoyment of phone communication and connecting with patients empathetically throughout the day.
  • Referral Workflow Familiarity: Experience or familiarity with medical referral processing, specialist outreach, and patient tracking logs.
  • Technical Setup: Quiet home office environment, noise-canceling headset, reliable high-speed internet, and comfort with web-based phone/texting tools and EHR systems.

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Join Netwrix’s mission to build high-impact teams that drive business success! As a Senior Recruiter, you'll be the architect behind hiring top-tier talent for critical roles across sales, marketing and other GTM roles. You'll craft innovative sourcing strategies that attract game-changing professionals, ensuring we remain ahead in the competitive landscape. If you're ready to shape the future of talent acquisition in a fast-moving GTM environment, let's make an impact together!

*Role is a 6-month contract.

  • Strategize with hiring teams to craft compelling talent attraction methods that bring in top-performing sales professionals.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand the nuances of sales roles and tailor recruitment strategies for maximum success.
  • Proactively build and maintain a high-quality talent pipeline, keeping top sales candidates engaged for current and future opportunities.
  • Deliver market intelligence by providing insights into industry trends, competitor hiring strategies, and sales talent movement.
  • Leverage data-driven recruitment, maintaining accuracy in the ATS and providing regular reports to optimize hiring performance.
  • Drive continuous enhancements to recruitment processes, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness in identifying and securing top-tier sales talent.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, or equivalent recruitment experience in fast-paced, high-growth tech environments.
  • Expert proficiency in ATS and sourcing tools, including LinkedIn Recruiter, CRM platforms, and competitive intelligence tools used in cybersecurity recruiting.
  • Deep understanding of the cybersecurity sales market, including regional hiring trends, emerging technologies, compensation benchmarks, and competitor landscape.
  • Deep connections within cybersecurity communities, leveraging industry networks to source and engage high-performing sales candidates.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills, managing multiple high-priority requisitions while collaborating with hiring managers and leadership.
  • Exceptional communication skills in English (written and verbal) to engage top-tier sales talent and influence hiring decisions.
  • Flexibility across time zones, working seamlessly with global teams and sales leaders to drive hiring success.

Our Values

  • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
  • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
  • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
  • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
  • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
  • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

  • Competitive Health Benefits
  • Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
  • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
  • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

raw.description:
GenLogs is a hardware, software, and data company building the next generation of Truck Intelligence™. Our mission is to build unbreakable supply chains in order to make our world safer and stronger. Through a nationwide network of sensors, we help our customers source carriers, eliminate fraud and theft, and provide real-time visibility on every truck in America. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

About the role

GenLogs is looking for a Partnerships Manager to manage and grow our technology alliance ecosystem, with a focus on Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and other technology partners across the logistics industry.

In this role, you'll own relationships with existing technology partners, drive the execution of integrations and joint initiatives, and identify opportunities to expand our partner ecosystem. You'll work closely with teams across Sales, Product, and leadership to ensure our partnerships deliver meaningful value to mutual customers and support GenLogs' broader go-to-market efforts.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex organizations, and turning partnership opportunities into tangible business outcomes. You'll have the opportunity to shape how GenLogs works with technology partners as our platform and customer base continue to grow.

What you'll do

  • Manage existing partnerships: Own day-to-day relationships with GenLogs' existing TMS and technology partners, serving as the primary point of contact and driving progress across active integrations and partnership initiatives.
  • Drive partnership execution: Coordinate cross-functional efforts to move partnerships forward, working with internal teams and external stakeholders to manage priorities, resolve blockers, and keep initiatives on track.
  • Identify new partnership opportunities: Build a pipeline of prospective technology partners, prioritizing opportunities based on customer demand, strategic alignment, and potential business impact.
  • Develop partner relationships: Build relationships with key stakeholders across partner organizations, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement and expand the value of existing partnerships.
  • Support joint go-to-market initiatives: Partner with Sales and other internal teams to develop and execute co-selling, referral, and co-marketing initiatives that generate awareness and create opportunities with mutual customers.
  • Represent GenLogs externally: Attend partner meetings, industry events, and TMS user conferences to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and increase GenLogs' presence across the technology ecosystem.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Sales, and leadership to align on partnership priorities, incorporate customer feedback, and ensure partner initiatives support broader company objectives.
  • Track partnership performance: Monitor partnership activity, engagement, and outcomes to understand what is working, identify opportunities for improvement, and help guide future investment.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in partnerships, technology alliances, business development, account management, or a related customer-facing role.
  • Experience working within the logistics technology ecosystem, ideally with exposure to TMS platforms, transportation management, freight brokerage, or logistics service providers.
  • Experience managing external business relationships and coordinating initiatives across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how partnerships can support customer acquisition, retention, and broader go-to-market objectives.
  • Ability to identify and evaluate partnership opportunities, balancing customer demand, strategic value, and potential business impact.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different levels of an organization.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • A proactive, resourceful approach to problem-solving and the ability to move initiatives forward without needing a defined playbook.

Do you enjoy cyber security and taking ownership to get the job done?

Are you excited about working with cutting-edge security systems?

Are you a Security Subject Matter Expert

As a Senior Security Incident Responder, responsibilities include investigating security incidents, analyzing digital evidence, collaborating with teams, and preventing threats. You will gain exposure to some of the complex tasks within the job function. The role requires technical competence, familiarity with recent threats, and adversarial techniques.

As a Senior Security Incident Responder, you will be responsible for:

  • Conducting in-depth investigations of security incidents, such as data breaches, malware infections, unauthorized access attempts and more.
  • Identifying the root cause of security incidents and determining the scope of the impact.
  • Using the central alerting and graphing systems to monitor internal infrastructure and customer events
  • Collaborating with various security teams to address threats, enhance defenses, and prevent future incidents by improving overall security posture.
  • Overseeing the identification and resolution of vulnerabilities arising from security-related incidents with precision and efficiency.
  • Providing training and offering guidance to team members regarding security incidents, potential gaps, and associated risks effectively.
  • Staying current with emerging threat hunts and digital forensics tools and methodologies ensures expertise and effectiveness in the field.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • 8 years of experience in Information Security and a High School Diploma or a Bachelor's Degree in a related field
  • 4-6 years specifically focused on Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), intrusion detection, and network or application security
  • Understand traditional Endpoint, Network, Perimeter, and Endpoint Detection Response security product solutions, including tools like SentinelOne or CrowdStrike.
  • Have solid knowledge of operating system internals (macOS, Linux, and/or Windows) and network fundamentals
  • Show proficiency in using forensic tools such as Sleuthkit, Axiom, Magnet, EnCase, FTK, Autopsy, and other industry-standard software

We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

raw.description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Money team, you own backend services behind customer accounts and money movement from design to production: ledger and balances, transfers and payments, bank integrations, interest and statements, and daily processing. You design for exactness, auditability and security first, make sound decisions under real traffic, and mentor engineers around you.

  • Design, build and run scalable, secure backend services and APIs for accounts, balances, transfers and payments.
  • Own larger features and services end to end, including monitoring, alerting and on-call follow-up.
  • Design the ledger and balance logic: double-entry records, holds, available and ledger balances, reversals and complete audit trails.
  • Design every money flow for correctness: idempotent requests, clear transaction states, safe retries and handling of unknown results from banks.
  • Integrate with banks and payment networks, and make those integrations resilient to timeouts, delays, cut-off times and duplicate or out-of-order messages.
  • Build and improve reconciliation, settlement and end-of-day batch processing, and drive root-cause fixes for every mismatch.
  • Build risk controls such as transaction limits, velocity checks and fraud rules, with Risk and Compliance.
  • Keep services fast and stable during busy periods, such as salary days and month-end, and plan capacity ahead of known peaks.
  • Lead design reviews and give thoughtful code reviews.
  • Investigate production incidents, run root cause analysis and ship lasting fixes.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and share knowledge within the team.
  • Work with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Security to turn requirements into reliable solutions.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional backend engineering, with a track record of owning production services that handle money or other critical transactions.
  • Languages: Strong in Java, Go or another modern backend language.
  • System Design: Solid understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven design, distributed transactions, and reliability and observability practices.
  • Data & Messaging: Hands-on with relational databases (transactions, locking, query tuning), caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka).
  • Banking Domain: Working knowledge of ledgers, payment networks, bank integrations and reconciliation, or strong experience in comparable payment or e-wallet systems.
  • Infrastructure: Experience running services on cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), with containers and CI/CD.
  • Mindset & Domain: Ownership mindset and clear communication. Experience in banking, payments, e-wallets or another regulated financial environment is a strong plus.

Benefits

  • Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
  • Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
  • Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
  • Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
  • Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
  • Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
  • Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
  • Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users.

WATT Global Media

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Client Success Manager

Reports To: National Sales Director Petfood

Department: Sales

Prepared By: Human Resources

FLSA Status: Exempt

Date Prepared: 09/25/26

SUMMARY

Responsible for exhibitors and sponsors at Petfood Forum from onboarding through event activation, working with sales, operations and marketing to deliver a strong client experience.

Assists clients with understanding the value of their participation and identify opportunities for future years, this position sets the stage for future renewal.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Engage with designated clients upon confirmation of booth application.
  • Review the package purchased, preparation and tools for success.
  • Set clear timelines and expectations so clients arrive at the event ready to perform.
  • Work closely with clients, particularly first-time exhibitors, to provide support from confirmation through the event.
  • Consistent conversations with clients as program progresses, being proactive in communication and anticipating potential issues.
  • Identify where clients are behind on deliverables, related to Petfood Forum, confused about logistics, or underutilizing what they have bought.
  • Works with appropriate WATT Global Media teams to resolve any issues ahead of the event.
  • Conducts a structured review conversation with each client towards the end of their activation.
  • Understand what worked, what didn't, and what the client is trying to achieve next year.
  • Identify what solutions — exhibit space, Petfood Forum Sponsorship(s), would best serve their objectives for the following event.
  • Document those insights clearly and brief the relevant account manager with everything they need to open the re-book conversation from a position of knowledge.
  • Onboard new clients on time and ensure client arrives at the event prepared and confident.
  • End-of-cycle reviews completed for all clients before the event closes.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • Two to three years of experience in a client-facing role such as account management, client success or event operations in a B-2-B environment.
  • Experience working in or around B-2-B events, exhibitions or trade media is strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Arts Degree with emphasis in Business, Advertising, Event Marketing, Sponsorships and measurement of best client outcomes.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL

  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and rapport quickly with new and established clients.
  • Strong organizational and portfolio-management skills, with the ability to manage clients at different stages of the event cycle without frequent oversight.
  • Commercial awareness sufficient to understand what each client purchased, evaluate whether the client is receiving value and recognize early signs of dissatisfaction or disengagement.
  • Ability to translate client feedback into concise, actionable briefing notes for account managers.
  • Proficiency using CRM to maintain client records, activity history, issues and follow-up actions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, reliable follow-through and the ability to determine when and how to escalate an issue.
  • Ability to work effectively across Sales, Event Operations, Event Production and Event Marketing as a connector between clients and internal teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office software programs (PowerPoint, Excel, Microsoft Word, Outlook) Microsoft Teams, Zoom, CRM platforms, Trello, Viva Engage, Paylocity, Bamboo HR, and other programs as required to fulfill the responsibilities of the position.
  • Proficiency in AI tools ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or others to drive sales results.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

  • Communicate with internal and external customers, face-to-face and on the telephone and correspond by using voice, email or letter/memo.
  • Sit, stand, bend and stoop.
  • Approximately 20% domestic travel is necessary to support event efforts and working with sales managers for upselling and closing.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Results-Only Work Environment (ROWE). Works in virtual team environment where culture, distance, time, and language are considerations to effective working relationships.

  • Works from home office
  • Works from Rockford office, clean, well-lighted area with access to up-to date technology and equipment.

About Curio

Curio brings strategy, learning design, technology and delivery together to solve complex learning challenges as one connected system. Since 2016, we've helped education providers and organisations turn ambitious ideas into learning that people can use. We're a distributed team supported by a global Faculty community, working across higher education, vocational education, schools, professional learning and enterprise in seven countries.

Find out more about us at

Please note

  • We are building our Curio talent pool in Southeast Asia for contract opportunities that are coming up in the future. Therefore, we are seeking multimedia designers.
    Kindly note that this role is not guaranteed full time work.

  • We will be able to offer contract opportunities for multiple clients over a particular period of time (short-term and long-term). Based on suitability, we intend to take you through our recruitment process and onboard you into our 'talent pool', so that when the right opportunity arises in the next few weeks / months, we are able to engage and onboard you quite quickly.

Objectives of this role

The Multimedia Designer brings learning and brand content to life through motion, video, and interactive media. You produce motion graphics, video content, and rich digital assets for client learning projects, Curio's marketing channels, and internal use - working across the full production cycle from brief to final export.

You are technically strong across the Adobe suite and confident with AI-powered production tools. You understand how visual and audio elements combine to create compelling learning experiences, and you work closely with Learning Designers and the broader creative team to deliver polished, on-brief output.

Key responsibilities and duties
Motion graphics and motion design

  • Produce motion graphics and motion design assets for learning content, marketing campaigns, and client deliverables.

  • Create kinetic typography, animated explainers, and branded motion sequences for digital channels.

  • Design and produce title sequences, transitions, and visual effects to support video productions.

Video production and editing

  • Produce and edit video content for client learning projects, marketing campaigns, and internal use.

  • Manage the full video production workflow: footage organisation, editing, colour grading, audio mixing, and export for multiple formats and platforms.

  • Create screen-capture and talking-head videos, including recording setup, editing, and post-production.

  • Produce AI-generated video content using tools such as Synthesia, including scripting visual layouts and managing avatar-based production.

eLearning visual and interactive assets

  • Design and produce visual and interactive assets for eLearning courses built in Articulate Rise and Storyline.

  • Create rich media elements — including embedded video, interactive overlays, and branching scenario visuals — that integrate cleanly into course builds.

  • Work closely with Learning Designers to ensure motion and multimedia assets support learning outcomes and meet accessibility standards.

AI-powered production

  • Produce AI voice and audio content using tools such as ElevenLabs, including voice selection, scripting, and audio post-production.

  • Integrate AI production tools confidently and efficiently into standard multimedia workflows.

  • Stay current with emerging AI capabilities in video, audio, and motion design — and bring relevant tools to the team's attention.

Administration and collaboration

  • Maintain accurate and organised project files, footage libraries, and export archives on the company shared drive.

  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback into revisions accurately and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with the Graphic Designer, Learning Designers, and clients to ensure multimedia output is visually consistent and on-brand.

Skills and qualifications
Required

  • Diploma or degree in multimedia design, digital media, film and television, or a related discipline, with 1–3 years of experience in a similar role.

  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects for video editing and motion graphics production.

  • Demonstrated ability to produce motion graphics and motion design assets to a professional standard.

  • Solid video production skills: shooting, editing, colour grading, audio mixing, and multi-format export.

  • Experience producing eLearning multimedia assets, with familiarity with Articulate Rise or Storyline.

  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling — how motion, pacing, sound, and graphic elements work together.

  • Able to manage multiple concurrent productions and deliver reliably to deadlines.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desired

  • Confident working in Articulate Rise and Storyline — able to build and adapt interactive visual assets directly within these tools.

  • Proficient with Synthesia for AI video production and ElevenLabs for AI voice and audio.

  • Strong AI fluency — actively integrates AI tools into multimedia workflows and keeps pace with emerging capabilities.

  • Experience with Adobe Audition or equivalent for dedicated audio post-production.

  • Familiarity with accessible media standards, including captions, audio descriptions, and WCAG 2.1 AA requirements for multimedia content.

  • Experience working in a higher education, professional learning, or professional services context.

What success looks like

  • Motion graphics and video deliverables are polished, on-brand, and exported correctly for every intended platform and format.

  • eLearning multimedia assets integrate seamlessly into course builds — visually consistent and technically sound.

  • AI production tools are used confidently and efficiently, improving output quality and production speed.

  • Learning Designers and clients see you as a reliable creative partner who elevates the quality of every project you touch.

Work health and safety responsibilities

  • Take reasonable care for the health and safety of others.

raw.excerpt: Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом.
raw.description:
Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.

У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 


Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

  • Здійснювати продаж банківських продуктів існуючим та новим клієнтам банку

Твій досвід та навички: 

  • Вільно володієш українською мовою
  • Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером
  • Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла
  • Готовий до роботи у напрямку телефонних продажів
  • Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації
  • Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми
  • Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді
  • Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

  • Конкурентна заробітна плата: гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.
  • Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.
  • Комфортні умови праці: віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
    (засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
    Графік роботи роботи пн-пт з 9:00 до 18:00
    Є можливість працювати по 4\6 годин на день.
  • Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.
  • Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.
  • Крута команда: наші колеги – це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.
  • Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.
  • Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

    • Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 
    • Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC
    • Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 
    • Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 
    • Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

    • Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  
    • Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.
    • Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче середовище під ваші особливі потреби
    • Співпрацюємо зі студентами та людьми старшого віку, створюючи умови для зростання на будь-якому етапі кар’єри.

В Райфі ти маєш значення! 

Бажаєш дізнатися більше? – Підписуйся на нас у соц.мережах: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn 

Твій рекрутер: Катерина Бубнова - Олександра Гіндрова -

Відгукуйтесь на вакансію, заповнюйте коротку анкету на нашому сайті і ми зв'яжемось з вами якнайшвидше!
