raw.excerpt: For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential.
raw.description:
For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.

As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:

Job Duck is seeking a highly organized, personable, and results-driven Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients seeking legal representation. In this role, you will manage incoming inquiries, conduct initial intake interviews, assess prospective clients against established firm criteria, and guide qualified leads through the consultation and onboarding process. You will play an important role in creating a positive first impression while ensuring that attorneys receive accurate, well-organized information before meeting with prospective clients. The ideal candidate is empathetic, confident communicating with individuals facing stressful situations, and comfortable balancing consultative sales skills with exceptional client service. This position is well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of follow-ups, and understands the importance of urgency, confidentiality, and attention to detail.


Monthly Compensation: 1,150 to 1,220 USD

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Answer incoming calls from prospective clients and respond promptly to inquiries received through the website, text messages, email, referrals, and other communication channels.


• Follow up on unsigned engagement agreements and outstanding initial payments.


• Follow up with prospective clients after consultations who have not yet retained the firm.


• Collect consultation payments when applicable.


• Schedule attorney consultations and maintain an organized consultation calendar.


• Pre-qualify prospective clients financially before scheduling attorney consultations.


• Return missed calls and proactively follow up with prospective clients who have not responded.


• Send intake forms, appointment confirmations, reminders, and document requests.


• Prepare concise and accurate intake summaries to ensure attorneys have the necessary administrative information before consultations.


• Communicate firm-approved consultation fees, starting legal fees, minimum initial payments, and available payment options without independently negotiating or modifying fees.


• Conduct initial intake interviews and collect comprehensive information about prospective clients and their legal matters.


• Maintain consistent follow-up communication with warm and high-priority leads.


• Gather relevant family law information regarding divorce, child custody, child support, legitimation, modifications, contempt proceedings, DFCS matters, existing court orders, upcoming hearings, children, assets, and opposing parties.


• Collect essential criminal case information, including charges, jurisdiction, court dates, custody status, bond status, existing legal representation, and case progress.


• Gather relevant information for preliminary conflict checks, including opposing parties, alleged victims, co-defendants, spouses, and other individuals involved.


• Determine whether prospective matters fall within the firm's accepted practice areas and identify cases requiring immediate attorney attention.


• Screen prospective clients according to established firm criteria for criminal defense and family law cases.


Requirements:

• Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

• Time Zone: Eastern Standard Time (EST)


• Industry: Legal Services

• Practice Areas: Criminal Defense and Family Law

• Call Volume: 45+ calls per day


Experience:

• Previous legal intake experience is preferred, particularly in criminal defense or family law. Candidates with experience in high-volume professional services, sales, healthcare intake, insurance, or other client-facing environments will also be considered.


Technical Requirements:

  • Experience using case management or CRM systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools.
  • Ability to learn and navigate multiple software platforms.
  • Strong computer skills and accurate data entry.

Software and Tools:

  • Clio Grow
  • Clio Manage
  • RingCentral
  • Case Status
  • Monday.com
  • Dropbox

Additional Requirements:

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to handle a high volume of incoming and outgoing calls.
  • Comfortable working with established scripts, checklists, and procedures.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive client information.
  • Willingness to participate in call reviews, performance evaluations, and ongoing training.

Required Skills:

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

• Strong telephone etiquette and professional communication skills.

• Exceptional interpersonal and active listening skills.

• Empathy and emotional intelligence when interacting with individuals facing stressful or sensitive situations.

• Consultative sales and client conversion skills.

• Confidence discussing consultation fees, legal service costs, and payment requirements.

• Strong follow-up and lead management skills.

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

• High attention to detail and accurate documentation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple leads and priorities simultaneously.

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to recognize urgent situations and escalate matters appropriately.

• Technological proficiency and adaptability to new software systems.

• Discretion and ability to handle confidential information.

• Accountability and a results-oriented mindset.

• Coachability and openness to feedback, call reviews, and performance metrics.

• Ability to remain professional and composed when communicating with upset, frustrated, or distressed individuals.

Work Shift:

Languages:

English

raw.description:
Customer Success Manager - BEAMON AI (DE/AT)

As our Customer Success Manager - BEAMON AI (DE/AT) you will operate at the intersection of law, technology, and customer enablement, with a strong focus on making complex AI-driven functionality understandable, usable, and valuable for self-serve customers.

Your role is pivotal in driving business growth, ensuring customer satisfaction, and identifying opportunities for expansion. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking, sharp, and motivated professional with a passion for technology adoption. Your responsibilities will include providing data-driven strategic insights, maintaining high operational standards, and collaboratively solving complex business problems.

This is a hands-on AI adoption role that has a strong technical component. Therefore we are looking for someone who is comfortable navigating uncertainty: you will think about adoption strategy, and ROI metrics,but also roll up your sleeves to help our customers accelerate their legal work through the power of AI. We are currently only considering candidates with near-Native proficiency in German.

Travel may be required.

THE ROLE

  • Work proactively with our customers to ensure they are successfully leveraging our products and creating business value with BEAMON AI.

  • Use analytics and feedback to maintain stakeholder engagement and customer satisfaction nurturing accounts for renewals and expansion.

  • Ensure customer retention and customer satisfaction through increased product adoption and increased usage.

  • Monitor product usage patterns to proactively identify users who are stuck or at risk of churning

  • Be hands-on in solving technical issues for your customers

  • Build relationships with assigned customers and strategically identify opportunity for growth and expansion.

  • Be the customer advocate while capturing customer feedback and collaborating with the Product team to improve our product.

  • Develop and share best practices with team members to continually improve the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of our processes.

  • Travel to meet our customers or to join or speak at international events and conferences.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

MUST HAVE

  • Native German speaker

  • Highly fluent English speaker

  • ././MBAdegree in business, law, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience/touchpoints in the legal or legal tech industry.

  • Ability to stay calm, patient, and empathetic when assisting customers.

  • You have strong communication skills to explain technical issues and resolutions to both engineering and non‑technical stakeholders.

  • You are effective at working cross‑functionally in a high‑trust environment.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

  • You leverage AI in your daily work.

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Experienced in customer support, success, or enablement in legal tech

  • Experience with rolling out AI software and stewarding AI adoption.

  • Proficiency with adoption and product analytics tools such as Userpilot or Pendo.

  • Background in conducting webinars or training sessions

  • Start-up and remote work experience

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation package: We offer competitive salary packages that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you’ll have on our team.

  • Competitive Benefits: Along with 30 vacation days, we also offer Wellhub, JobRad, a generous Work From Home Allowance to make sure your home office has everything you need, paid parental leave & more!

  • Cutting-Edge Technology: You’ll be at the forefront of tech, working with advanced AI models, including large language models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques, gaining hands-on experience with the latest innovations.

  • High-impact role:Your contributions will directly shape BEAMON’s growth and success.

  • Collaborative and innovative team: Join a company with a strong culture of ownership, ambition, and teamwork.

  • Team Onsites:We regularly organize team off-sites at exciting destinations across Europe, where we come together to collaborate, bond, and have fun. So far we went to Portugal, Italy and Greece – stay tuned for this year’s destination!

  • Learning & Growth: You will have the opportunity to learn and grow every day, especially in AI-driven technologies, as we push the boundaries of what’s possible in automation.

ABOUT BRYTER

Our mission is to enable legal professionals to do their jobs better. We do this by combining the power of AI with the precision and control of workflows with BEAMON AI and BRYTER Workflows.

BEAMON AI supports legal professionals in their work: from drafting, summarising and research, to contract revie. BRYTER Workflows uses rule-based and AI workflows to orchestrate legal processes and document automation.

In short, we’ve built a platform that enables lawyers to get more done every day, without working longer hours.

Global brands like McDonald’s and ING Bank, and law firms like Ashurst and Linklaters, use BRYTER every day to improve efficiencies and scale their services.

BRYTER is a remote-first company with offices in New York, London and Frankfurt.

CURIOUS? PLEASE APPLY

Multiplestudies have found that women/non-binary people on average seek to match a high percentage of a role's requirements before applying. We encourage everyone to apply, even if they feel they might not fulfill all listed requirements fully. We'd like you to give us a chance to evaluate your skills and experience. We're curious to hear from you and learn what you believe you'd bring to the role and the team. For people living with disabilities, chronic illnesses, or neurodiversity, adjustments, and support can make a decisive difference in the interviewing process. Please let us know if you need any accommodations (specific tools, more time, additional breaks, etc.) and feel comfortable disclosing this, and we'll do our best to meet them.

raw.description:
The SMIT (Systems Modernization and Information Technology) contract at Leidos currently has an opening for an AI/Automation Development Intern - Assessment & Authorization to work with our Assessment & Authorization (A&A) team. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in developing cutting-edge AI solutions and automation tools that transform Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes within the cybersecurity authorization domain.


In this mission, we are revolutionizing how our organization handles RMF workflows for system authorization and accreditation by leveraging artificial intelligence, machine learning, and intelligent automation to increase efficiency, reduce processing time, and enhance security compliance decision-making. As part of our A&A team, you will contribute to building innovative solutions that streamline authorization processes, automate compliance documentation, and support the security authorization lifecycle for mission-critical systems.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts to streamline RMF processes and A&A workflows
  • Assist in the design, development, and testing of AI-enabled tools for RMF analysis, security control assessment, and authorization package processing
  • Create and optimize Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript scripts for data extraction, transformation, and automation of compliance documentation tasks
  • Support the integration of AI/ML models into existing RMF and A&A tools and platforms
  • Collaborate with senior developers, security analysts, and authorization professionals to identify automation opportunities in the authorization lifecycle
  • Document technical specifications, user guides, and process workflows for developed automation solutions
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks
  • Conduct testing and quality assurance of automation scripts and AI-enabled applications
  • Assist in data analysis and visualization to support RMF and authorization decision-making processes
  • Support the maintenance and enhancement of existing automation tools, dashboards, and compliance tracking systems
  • Help automate repetitive tasks related to security control documentation, evidence collection, and authorization status reporting

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field (Junior or Senior standing preferred)
  • Must have scripting experience with one or more of the following: Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or Bash
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Basic understanding of automation concepts and workflow optimization
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance (or higher if required)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenAI API)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered coding assistants and tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, Claude by Anthropic, OpenAI Codex)
  • Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Power Automate
  • Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) for document analysis and generation
  • Experience using AI tools for code generation, debugging, and documentation
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST RMF, FISMA, FedRAMP) and authorization processes
  • Experience with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
  • Understanding of API development and integration (REST, GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their AI/ML services
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
  • Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and data manipulation
  • Previous internship or project experience in automation, AI development, or cybersecurity
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
  • Coursework or certifications in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, or cybersecurity
  • Experience with low-code/no-code platforms
  • Familiarity with compliance management tools (e.g., Xacta, eMASS, Archer)
  • Strong interest in emerging AI technologies, automation trends, and cybersecurity
  • Experience integrating AI assistants into development workflows and automation pipelines

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Mobile / UI/UX Engineer

Stanbridge University | Technology & Product Engineering

Position Summary

Stanbridge University is seeking a highly capable, product-minded Mobile / UI/UX Engineer to design, develop, and enhance our growing ecosystem of student-facing digital platforms.

This mid- to senior-level position combines mobile application development, front-end engineering, and user experience design. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can translate complex workflows into intuitive, visually compelling, and functional digital experiences—and independently build the solutions they design.

The engineer will initially focus on enhancing existing digital platforms, improving usability, performance, and mobile responsiveness while helping establish a consistent, scalable user experience across the University's broader application ecosystem. The role will also contribute to the design and development of new student-facing applications and emerging digital initiatives.

As our platforms evolve, this position will play an important role in expanding our mobile capabilities, including developing native or cross-platform applications for iOS and Android. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to progressively assume greater technical ownership, including independently architecting, developing, and deploying complete mobile applications.

We are seeking a versatile builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-moving environment, embraces AI-assisted development, and takes ownership of solutions from concept through deployment.

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Application & Front-End Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, mobile-first web applications and interfaces.
  • Contribute to the architecture, development, and deployment of student-facing mobile applications for iOS and Android.
  • Build reusable, scalable front-end components that support consistent functionality across multiple platforms.
  • Translate product requirements, wireframes, and design concepts into production-ready applications.
  • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and usability across devices.
  • Integrate front-end applications with APIs, authentication systems, and existing backend services.

UI/UX Design & Product Experience

  • Own the design and implementation of intuitive, engaging user interfaces and experiences.
  • Develop wireframes, interactive prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity interface designs.
  • Establish and maintain shared design systems, reusable components, and visual standards.
  • Identify usability challenges and implement practical improvements based on user feedback and product requirements.
  • Ensure consistency in navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, and visual design across the University's digital platforms.
  • Balance design quality with technical feasibility, maintainability, and delivery timelines.

Product Engineering & Execution

  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product stakeholders to deliver enhancements across existing and emerging digital platforms.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from initial design through development, testing, deployment, and iteration.
  • Troubleshoot application issues, improve existing functionality, and contribute to ongoing product optimization and stability.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and other technical teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute as a hands-on individual engineer in a collaborative, AI-enabled development environment.

AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation

  • Leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, prototyping, debugging, and delivery.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when evaluating, validating, and integrating AI-generated code.
  • Explore emerging technologies and development approaches that improve the student experience.
  • Help establish efficient, repeatable development practices without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.

Required Qualifications

  • Approximately 4–7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on front-end development and experience contributing to mobile application development.
  • Demonstrated experience in front-end software engineering and building production-quality user interfaces.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end development frameworks.
  • Experience with React, Vue, Angular, or comparable component-based frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile application development technologies such as React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, or comparable frameworks, with an understanding of native or cross-platform mobile development.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement user interfaces using Figma or comparable design platforms.
  • Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, interaction design, accessibility, and responsive, mobile-first development.
  • Experience integrating applications with RESTful APIs or comparable backend services.
  • Familiarity with Git, modern software development workflows, testing, debugging, and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical judgment, communication, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience developing, testing, and deploying production mobile applications for iOS or Android.
  • Experience contributing to mobile application architecture, technical design decisions, and scalable application development.
  • Familiarity with mobile application lifecycle management, performance optimization, security, and deployment processes.
  • Experience developing reusable UI component libraries and maintaining shared design systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development tools and modern engineering workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability and interest in progressively assuming independent ownership of mobile application architecture and development.

Work Location and Employment Eligibility

  • This is a United States-based position. All employment duties must be performed from within the United States.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Remote employment is available only to candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees.
  • Eligible states currently include Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.
  • Candidates residing in the designated states will receive preference; however, qualified applicants from other U.S. states are also encouraged to apply. Employment eligibility and remote-work arrangements will be evaluated based on applicable state requirements and University policies.

Compensation

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $115,000–$150,000, depending on qualifications, experience, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

Conditions of Employment

  • A job-related assessment may be required during the interview process.
  • Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Employment Authorization and Sponsorship: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Stanbridge University does not provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.
  • Employment verification will be conducted to validate relevant work experience in accordance with applicable accreditation standards and University requirements.
  • Offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law.
  • Official transcripts may be required prior to hire when applicable to the position's educational qualifications. Degrees earned outside the United States may require evaluation by a recognized credential evaluation service to establish U.S. degree equivalency.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Work Environment

  • Standard professional and technology-focused work environment.
  • Duties are primarily performed at a desk or computer workstation.
  • Extensive use of computers, software development environments, cloud services, AI-assisted development tools, and related technology platforms.
  • Regular collaboration with cross-functional teams in an environment involving evolving technical requirements and project deadlines.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work at a computer workstation for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Regular use of electronic keyboards, computers, and standard office equipment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through electronic, verbal, and written channels.
  • Ability to review and interpret information presented through computer systems and related technologies.
  • May occasionally be required to lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as appropriate.

Employee Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable University policies.

Institutional Values

Diversity and Inclusion

Stanbridge University's motto, "Strength through Diversity," reflects our commitment to honoring the diverse backgrounds of our students, faculty, staff, and surrounding communities. We strive to build an inclusive learning environment and uphold anti-discrimination practices in all aspects of University life.

We embrace innovative technologies to enhance student learning through interactive, hands-on experiences, including virtual reality and simulation-based education, preparing students for the demands of modern healthcare practice.

Through initiatives such as Stanbridge outREACH, students are empowered to give back to local and global communities, cultivating compassion, civic responsibility, and social awareness.

raw.description:
Clearance: Current, active SECRET clearance required
Travel: CONUS and OCONUS, including contingency and austere locations
Employment type: Full-time, contingent on contract award

About KVG

KVG LLC is an international mission support company headquartered in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, with Program Management Offices worldwide. We deliver base operating and life support, expeditionary construction, logistics and commodities to U.S. military and Government customers under Navy, Air Force, Army, DLA and Department of State contract vehicles. Recent work includes ten miles of force-protection barriers on the southwest border, protective bunkers in the UAE, exercise life support in Japan and the Philippines, and bulk fuel delivery to Pine Gap, Australia.

About the role

KVG is bidding as a prime contractor on the U.S. Air Force Contract Augmentation Program VI (AFCAP VI), a multiple-award IDIQ run by the Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) at Tyndall AFB, Florida, for rapid-response construction, services and commodities worldwide. The Alternate Program Manager is one of two key personnel named in the contract. You work alongside the Program Manager on day-to-day program execution and act as Program Manager, with full authority, whenever the PM is unavailable or when designated.

The Alternate Program Manager is identified in our proposal and signs a letter of intent before proposal submission on 1 December 2026. Employment in the role begins at contract award, currently expected in late 2027, and carries a minimum 12-month commitment from that date.

Location

Remote within the United States; Gettysburg, PA or Tyndall AFB / Panama City, FL area preferred.

What you will do

  • Act as Program Manager in the PM’s absence, with authority to commit KVG’s funds and resources to the Contracting Officer.
  • Serve as one of the primary 24-hour contacts in the 24/7 on-call rotation: one-hour callback to the Contracting Officer, binding proposals within 24 hours on urgent requirements, on site within 24 hours CONUS or 48 hours OCONUS, and the two-hour in-person or secure-VTC response at Tyndall AFB for classified taskings.
  • Manage assigned task orders across engineering, construction, services and commodities: schedule, cost, quality, subcontractors, Government property and deliverables.
  • Prepare task order proposals, Task Order Management Plans, quality control plans, mission-essential plans and modification packages.
  • Produce program reporting: FLASH reports, situation reports, monthly status and cost reports, and the Key AFCAP VI Contact Listing.
  • Supervise Site Managers and Alternate Site Managers at dispersed locations and coordinate Government, subcontractor and vendor interfaces.
  • Keep the AFCAP Management Plan components current and support compliance with security, safety, property, CTIP and vendor threat mitigation requirements.
  • Oversee deployment readiness: Tyndall AFB processing, SPOT letters of authorization, medical and immunization standards and pre-deployment training.
  • Complete the Government’s AFCAP contractor training after award.

Minimum qualifications

These are the Government’s stated criteria for the position. Each one is verified from your résumé, your experience narrative and the DoW security database, so please address each directly.

  • U.S. citizen.
  • Current, active SECRET clearance. Clearance eligibility, an expired clearance or a clearance in process does not meet this requirement.
  • Two years of program management experience within the last seven years, with demonstrated expertise in each of the following:
    • Government appropriations
    • Engineering, construction, services or commodities
    • Government acquisitions
    • Management of multiple task orders greater than $400,000 each
  • Willing to sign a letter of intent committing to the role on award and to serve in it for at least 12 months.
  • Able to deploy CONUS and OCONUS and to meet DoW contractor deployment standards (medical and dental screening, immunizations, pre-deployment training).

Preferred

  • Experience on AFCAP, LOGCAP, WEXMAC, Navy base operating support or a similar contingency IDIQ.
  • Experience with Air Force installation support (civil engineering or force support functions).
  • Experience with cost-reimbursable task orders and Government cost reporting.
  • PMP or equivalent; bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, business or a related field.
  • Experience supervising personnel at multiple sites, including OCONUS.

How to apply

Apply through this posting and include the following:

  • Resume with month and year for each position.
  • A summary of the Government contracts and task orders you managed in the last seven years: customer, scope, dollar value, locations, your role and dates.
  • Confirmation that your SECRET clearance is current and active, the agency that granted it, and a facility security officer who can verify it. Do not send a Social Security number; KVG’s security lead will collect verification details separately.

KVG LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
Overview

Responsible for developing and maintaining the trusted data foundation that supports technology performance reporting, operational and risk metrics, analytics, and operational insights. This role acquires, transforms, structures, and maintains data from multiple sources to enable consistent, scalable, and automated reporting and analytical solutions. The position also designs and supports an interim analytics data repository to meet current business needs while partnering with enterprise data teams and preparing for transition to long-term enterprise data solutions.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities

System Enhancement & Data Warehouse Support

  • Evaluates, enhances, and maintains technology performance data warehouse solutions, reporting capabilities, and analytics platforms.
  • Develops and supports data structures, processes, and applications that improve access to technology performance metrics and operational insights.
  • Designs, develops, tests, and implements enhancements that align with existing system architecture and enterprise technology standards.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve solution performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability.

Data Ingestion & Source Integration

  • Develops and maintains data ingestion processes that integrate information from technology platforms, operational systems, vendor applications, and other internal and external data sources.
  • Supports source-to-target mappings, data integration requirements, and data movement processes.
  • Develops and maintains interfaces utilizing APIs, database connectivity, and file-based integrations to ensure efficient and reliable data acquisition.
  • Collaborates with business and technology stakeholders to identify new data requirements and integration opportunities.

Data Transformation & Curation

  • Develops and maintains ETL/ELT processes that transform source data into trusted analytics-ready datasets.
  • Applies business rules, data validations, standardization processes, and transformation logic to support reporting and analytical requirements.
  • Ensures data consistency, accuracy, usability, and alignment with established business definitions and reporting standards.

Analytics Data Modeling

  • Designs, develops, and maintains analytical and dimensional data models that support technology performance management, reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI measurement.
  • Supports reporting and analytics initiatives through the development of optimized data structures and reporting datasets.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective analytical data solutions.

Historical Data & Snapshot Management

  • Maintains historical data repositories and snapshot methodologies to support trend analysis, forecasting, benchmarking, audit requirements, and long-term performance measurement.
  • Ensures historical data structures support consistent reporting and analysis across reporting periods.
  • Implements processes that preserve data lineage and historical integrity.

Data Quality Controls

  • Develops and maintains data quality controls, validation procedures, reconciliation processes, and monitoring solutions.
  • Identifies, researches, and resolves data integrity issues, anomalies, and discrepancies.
  • Partners with source system owners and stakeholders to improve data quality and ensure confidence in reporting outputs.
  • Supports data governance, documentation, and compliance requirements where applicable.

Business Support & Operational Excellence

  • Provides technical support to production data warehouse and analytics environments by addressing complex issues, anticipating maintenance requirements, and ensuring ongoing functionality.
  • Monitors data processes, data flows, and scheduled jobs to ensure timely and accurate delivery of information.
  • Performs root cause analysis and implements corrective actions to improve system stability and performance.
  • Develops technical solutions to unique business and system challenges.
  • Leads major projects, delegates tasks as appropriate, and ensures quality outcomes.

Data Process Automation

  • Develops and implements automation solutions for data processing, validation, monitoring, reporting, and operational support activities.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and enhance process reliability.
  • Supports CI/CD and deployment automation practices where appropriate.

Technical Documentation & Maintainability

  • Creates and maintains technical documentation including data mappings, process flows, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, support documentation, and implementation plans.
  • Ensures solutions are maintainable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise development standards and best practices.
  • Reviews business specifications, technical designs, coding standards, testing plans, and implementation documentation for accuracy and completeness.

Planning & Team Ceremonies

  • Participates in Agile planning activities, sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, work estimation, and project execution activities.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to prioritize work and align solutions with business objectives.
  • Provides technical leadership and guidance during project planning and delivery efforts.

Technical Expertise

  • Utilizes expertise to mentor and train associates within the work group.
  • Serves as a technical resource for management, associates, and business partners.
  • Participates in special projects and meetings as needed to provide technical insight and recommendations.
  • Promotes best practices related to data management, reporting, analytics, software development, and operational support.

Data Analysis

  • Collects and analyzes data related to user requests and business requirements to determine scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and system impacts.
  • Evaluates business and technical requirements to develop effective data and reporting solutions.
  • Reviews specifications, coding, test plans, documentation, and implementation activities to ensure quality and alignment with business needs.

Required Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL development, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with Oracle database technologies and data warehouse environments.
  • Advanced experience with ETL/ELT development and support.
  • Advanced experience with Python or similar programming language used for automation, orchestration, and data engineering solutions.
  • Experience with data ingestion, source integration, and API-based data acquisition.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Experience developing and maintaining analytics-focused and dimensional data models.
  • Experience supporting historical data management and snapshot-based reporting.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, reconciliations, and validation processes.
  • Experience with pipeline orchestration and automated workflow management.
  • Experience with cloud-based data technologies, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with monitoring, troubleshooting, observability, and production support processes.
  • Advanced experience with Git or similar source code repository systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes and deployment automation.
  • Advanced experience with Jira, ServiceNow, or similar work management and support platforms.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
  • Proven ability to drive consensus among cross-functional roles, resolve conflicting situations, and drive effective business and technical outcomes.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call support rotation as needed.

Education

Bachelor's Degree and 6 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 10 years' experience

Work Experience

  • Technology reporting, analytics, or data warehouse solution development and support.
  • SQL and Oracle database development.
  • Data integration, ETL/ELT development, and data transformation processes.
  • Analytics, reporting, dashboard, and KPI solution development.
  • Dimensional data modeling and analytics data structures.
  • Historical data management and snapshot reporting methodologies.
  • Data quality management, validation, and reconciliation processes.
  • AWS or other cloud-based data technologies.
  • Production support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices.

raw.title: AI Security Governance Architect
raw.excerpt: Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions?
raw.description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions? At Plain Concepts, our AI Security Studios team helps organizations adopt AI securely and responsibly by defining how risks, controls and responsibilities should be managed throughout the AI lifecycle.

As an AI Security Governance Architect, you will help design and operationalize cybersecurity governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI and agentic AI, working closely with security, architecture and business teams. You will act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for AI governance, translating emerging AI risks into practical security controls, requirements, processes and architecture patterns that organizations can actually implement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve AI security governance frameworks, covering AI use case registration, risk classification, security controls, approvals, exceptions, monitoring and periodic reassessment.
  • Align AI security governance with recognized standards and regulations, including NIST AI RMF, NIST Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the EU AI Act.
  • Assess AI, GenAI and agentic AI use cases from a cybersecurity perspective, considering risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, identity and access management, excessive agent permissions, model exposure, third-party AI services, data residency and AI supply chain risks.
  • Translate AI risks into practical security controls, including security policies, technical requirements, architecture patterns, guardrails, evidence requirements, ownership and acceptance criteria.
  • Define security requirements and architecture patterns for different AI scenarios, including internal copilots, Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG systems, AI agents, ML models, vendor AI solutions and low-code/no-code AI automations.
  • Integrate AI security governance with existing security tooling and processes, including solutions such as HiddenLayer, Sentra and Zenity, as well as GRC, IAM, DLP, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, CMDB and data governance environments.
  • Define and improve AI security governance deliverables, including AI security control frameworks, use case classification models, security requirements, architecture patterns, risk acceptance processes, security review templates, KPI/KRI dashboards and maturity roadmaps.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong background in security governance, security architecture, risk management, AppSec or Cloud Security.
  • Strong understanding of AI and GenAI security risks, including LLM application security, prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, RAG security, AI agent permissions, model/API exposure, model supply chain and third-party AI services.
  • Experience designing and operationalizing security governance and control frameworks, with the ability to turn policies and risk requirements into practical controls, processes and security requirements.
  • Knowledge of AI security and governance frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and related AI risk and security standards.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture and business teams, translating complex cybersecurity risks into clear requirements and recommendations for both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to create executive-ready materials as well as detailed security and control documentation.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI governance programs, GenAI security assessments or AI Security Posture Management (AISPM).
  • Experience securing enterprise AI environments such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG solutions or AI agents.
  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture, Secure SDLC/DevSecOps, DSPM, GRC or AI-related SOC monitoring.
  • Familiarity with tools such as HiddenLayer, Sentra, Zenity, Wiz, Microsoft Purview, Defender, CSPM/CWPP, DLP or SIEM/SOAR platforms.
  • Knowledge of third-party AI risk management and security control evidence automation.
  • Understanding of privacy and AI regulatory requirements, including GDPR, DPIAs, data classification and the EU AI Act.

Benefits

  • Salary determined by the market and your experience 🤑
  • Flexible schedule 35 Hours / Week 😎
  • Fully remote work (optional) 🌍
  • Flexible compensation (restaurant, transport, and childcare) ✌
  • Fully free health insurance, with a co-payment for dental services 🚑
  • Individual budget for training or equipment and free Microsoft certifications 📚
  • English lessons 🗽
  • Birthday day off 🌴🥳
  • Monthly bonus for electricity and Internet expenses at home 💻
  • Discount on gym plan and sports activities 🔝
  • Plain Camp (annual team-building event) 🎪
  • Extra perks: events attendance and speakers, welcome pack, baby basket, Christmas basket, discount portal for employees ➕ The pleasure of always working with the latest technological tools!

Will you let us know you better?

The selection process: Simple, just 3 steps.

  • Phone screen
  • 2 interviews with the team 🤘

What is Plain Concepts?

Plain Concepts is a global company of over 500 people passionate about technology and innovation. Since our founding, we have grown through technical proficiency and confidence in ideas that others might consider risky, creating custom solutions for our clients. With offices in more than 6 countries, our mission is to continue to drive cuttingedge projects around the world.

We are highly committed to technical excellence. We are known for developing highly customized projects, offering specialized technical consultancy and training.

Thanks to the great work of our technicians, we have been recognized for our ability to lead innovative projects that generate value, from artificial intelligence to blockchain, driving solutions that help companies optimize their performance.

What we do at Plain Concepts?

We pride ourselves on being a 100% technical team, dedicated to crafting custom projects from scratch, offering expert technical consultancy, and providing top-tier training.

  • Our approach goes beyond traditional outsourcing; we focus on creating value together with our clients.
  • Our teams are diverse and multidisciplinary, operating in a flat, collaborative structure.
  • We live and breathe AGILE principles, ensuring flexibility and efficiency in everything we do.

Department:

WDTech - I&O

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is Walker & Dunlop’s technology organization, bringing together product, design, engineering, data, infrastructure, information security, and operations to build, operate, and protect the technology that powers our business.

You will have the opportunity to apply modern technology and AI within one of the nation’s leading commercial real estate finance and advisory services firms. W&D’s market position, deep industry expertise, client relationships, and proprietary data provide a strong foundation for solving meaningful business problems, improving how we work and serve our clients, and creating new sources of competitive advantage.

Across WDTech, we combine business context with disciplined technology practices and a high standard for security, resilience, and quality. Teams have ownership of meaningful problems and collaborate across disciplines, make thoughtful decisions, and continuously improve the products, platforms, and capabilities that move W&D forward.


The Impact You Will Have

The Senior Cloud Services Engineer, II, will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting the cloud infrastructure that powers Walker & Dunlop’s technology platform. This position will help ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our cloud environments while enabling engineering teams to build and deliver innovative, data-driven solutions.


Working closely with Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams, the Senior Cloud Services Engineer, II, will help modernize and automate our cloud operations, implement infrastructure best practices, and support highly available systems that serve both internal users and external products. This role will directly impact the productivity of WDTech teams and the performance of the platforms that support collaboration, communication, monitoring, and data governance across the organization.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise collaboration, monitoring, and security platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Box, and Cisco Email Security (Ironport).
  • Manage and optimize enterprise cloud services and SaaS platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and availability for internal users and business applications.
  • Independently evaluate complex infrastructure challenges, recommend technical solutions, and implement improvements to cloud services, system performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of cloud resources as required.
  • Utilize monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted to ensure proactive detection of system performance issues and service disruptions.
  • Support enterprise data governance and compliance initiatives through the implementation and management of tools such as Microsoft Purview.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex technical incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement operational improvements to enhance system reliability and operational maturity.
  • Partner with Information Security to ensure infrastructure platforms and SaaS services adhere to security policies, regulatory requirements, and enterprise governance standards.
  • Utilize ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence to manage work tracking, operational documentation, and knowledge sharing across engineering and infrastructure teams.
  • Contribute to the development and enforcement of infrastructure standards, cloud architecture guidelines, and operational best practices across the organization.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and team members.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure architecture documentation, operational procedures, and system configurations, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with established standards.
  • Be part of an on-call rotation for 24/7 support of the infrastructure.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud services, or related technical disciplines.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in real-estate domain a plus.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of Azure, AWS, and related cloud technologies.
  • Ability to maintain documentation for infrastructure architecture, operational procedures, and system configurations.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure architecture, networking, identity management, and enterprise SaaS integrations.
  • Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and information lifecycle management practices within cloud environments.
  • Knowledgeable in disaster recovery and business continuity principles.
  • Understanding of information security certifications and audits.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

This position has an estimated base salary of $145,000 - $160,000 plus a discretionary bonus. An employment offer is based on the applicant’s relevant work experience, applicable knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data


What We Offer 

  • The opportunity to join one of Fortune Magazine’s Great Places to Work winners

  • Comprehensive benefit options* that have earned Walker & Dunlop the gold level of the 2025 Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation™, some of which include:
    - Up to 83% subsidized medical payroll deductions
    - Competitive dental and vision benefits

    - 401(k) + match

    - Pre-tax transit and commuting benefits
    - A robust health and wellness program – earn cash rewards and gain access to resources that
    promote health, engagement, and balance
    - Paid maternity and parental leave, as well as other family paid leave programs
    - Company-paid life, short and long-term disability insurance
    - Health Savings Account and Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending

  • Career development opportunities

  • Empowerment and encouragement to give back – volunteer hours and donation matching

*Eligibility may vary based on average number of hours worked

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.


SPAM
Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.


Fair Chance Hiring

Background checks, including any questions related to infractions, arrests, or conviction records, will not be conducted until after a conditional offer of employment has been accepted. We will consider for employment qualified applicants regardless of arrest and conviction records, in accordance with federal, state, and local laws.

Job Summary:

As a Junior CTRM Consultant at Agiboo, you will work with customers to implement and configure Agiblocks, our Commodity Trade and Risk Management (CTRM) solution.

You will join the Consulting team with an existing foundation in CTRM, gained through approximately 1–2 years of experience implementing, supporting, testing, or working with a CTRM application. Building on that experience, you will develop deeper knowledge of commodity trading processes and the Agiblocks platform while contributing directly to customer implementation projects.

Working alongside experienced consultants, you will participate in requirements gathering, business process analysis, system configuration, testing, customer training, and go-live activities. As your Agiblocks product knowledge and consulting experience grow, you will progressively take ownership of customer requirements, configuration areas, workshops, and implementation activities.

This is a customer-facing consulting role suited to someone who already understands the fundamentals of CTRM and wants to develop into an independent CTRM implementation consultant. Employment is supported for candidates residing in Spain, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Germany or Portugal.

Job Description:

Reporting Line and Team

This role is part of the Professional ServicesConsulting team reporting toProfessional Services Team lead.

Responsibilities

  • Work with customers and experienced Agiboo consultants to understand commodity trading processes, workflows, and business requirements.
  • Participate in customer workshops and help analyse and document functional requirements, business processes, workflows, and use cases.
  • Translate customer requirements into appropriate Agiblocks configuration and functional specifications, with guidance from senior consultants where required.
  • Configure Agiblocks to support customer trading and operational processes.
  • Assist with implementation activities including system setup, configuration, data-related activities, testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and go-live preparation.
  • Support functional testing of configured Agiblocks environments and newly developed functionality.
  • Investigate functional issues and work with customers and internal Agiboo teams to identify appropriate solutions.
  • Act as a link between customers and Agiboo’ s Consulting, Product Development, and Customer Success teams when required.
  • Prepare and maintain customer-specific documentation, including process documentation, configuration documentation, user guides, and training materials.
  • Assist with and progressively take responsibility for delivering customer training on Agiblocks.
  • Track assigned project activities and communicate progress, issues, risks, and dependencies to the project team.
  • Develop deeper knowledge of commodity trading, CTRM processes, and the Agiblocks application.
  • The candidate should be open and ready to adopt AI tools in their day-to-day work to improve productivity, efficiency, and the quality of deliverables.
  • Gradually take independent ownership of defined implementation workstreams and customer-facing activities.
  • Be willing to travel to customer locations when required.

Experience and Qualifications

Required

  • 1–2 years of professional experience working with or implementing a CTRM/ETRM application.
  • Practical understanding of the fundamental commodity trading lifecycle and associated business processes.
  • Some hands-on experience in one or more areas such as:
    • CTRM implementation or configuration
    • Business or functional analysis
    • Application support
    • Functional testing/UAT
    • Customer onboarding or training
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into clear functional or system requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable interacting directly with customers in a professional environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Self-motivated, curious, and eager to develop deeper expertise in commodity trading and CTRM.
  • Hands-on experience working with Business Intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including data analysis and reporting.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word for preparing and maintaining professional documentation.
  • Able to work both independently and collaboratively within an international team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Logistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Willingness to travel for customer projects when required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with physical commodity trading processes such as contracts, logistics, pricing, invoicing, position management, or risk management.
  • Exposure to commodity markets such as agricultural commodities, soft commodities, energy, or metals.
  • Experience configuring enterprise business applications.
  • Understanding of ERP, finance, accounting, or billing systems.
  • Experience participating in customer workshops or software implementation projects.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Additional languages like Dutch, French or Spanish is a plus.

What Agiboo Offers in This Role

The role provides the opportunity to build on your existing CTRM experience and develop further expertise in:

  • Commodity trading and CTRM
  • The Agiblocks platform
  • Business and functional analysis
  • CTRM configuration and implementation
  • Customer workshops and requirements gathering
  • Functional testing and UAT
  • Customer training
  • End-to-end implementation projects

The objective is for the Junior CTRM Consultant to progressively develop from contributing to implementation activities to independently handling defined customer requirements, workshops, configuration areas, and implementation workstreams.

Career Development

This role is intended as a development path toward becoming a CTRM Consultant who can independently manage customer requirements and deliver Agiblocks implementation activities.

As experience develops, the consultant will take increasing responsibility for customer workshops, solution design, configuration, training, go-live activities, and eventually broader project delivery.

raw.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

Remote, Brazil | Full-time | Intelex

Why should you join Intelex?

At Intelex, you’ll help build and evolve the cloud platforms that power business-critical environmental, health, safety, and quality solutions. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll have meaningful ownership of how our engineering teams build, deploy, observe, secure, and operate software at scale.
This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role where you can solve complex engineering problems while making the developer experience simpler for others. You’ll work across AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, security, and reliability, while partnering with engineering, SRE, security, data, and architecture teams. Your work will directly influence deployment velocity, platform resilience, operational efficiency, and the ability of teams to deliver safely.

What this role entails?

  • Build platforms that make engineering easier. Design and evolve internal developer platforms, paved paths, reusable Terraform modules, deployment patterns, golden pipelines, and self-service capabilities that help teams deliver software securely and efficiently.
  • Engineer reliable cloud infrastructure. Design, operate, and continuously improve production environments across AWS and Azure, including Kubernetes workloads on EKS and AKS. Apply automation and engineering practices that improve availability, scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Advance CI/CD and release engineering. Build secure, repeatable CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and related tooling. Implement automated testing, policy controls, artifact management, GitOps, and deployment approaches such as rolling, blue/green, and canary releases.
  • Strengthen observability and reliability. Improve monitoring, metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, SLOs, incident response, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. Troubleshoot complex production issues, drive root-cause analysis, reduce operational toil, and automate recurring remediation.
  • Raise engineering standards. Partner with development, SRE, security, data, architecture, and FinOps stakeholders on cloud architecture, DevSecOps, operational practices, cost optimization, and resilience. Mentor engineers, contribute to design reviews, and help establish reusable engineering standards.
You’ll work within a distributed engineering environment and collaborate across teams and time zones. The role includes participation in scheduled on-call rotations and requires meaningful overlap with the core engineering team.

What we are looking for?

Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a related discipline, including ownership of highly available production environments. Approximately 8+ years of relevant experience is a helpful benchmark, but we value demonstrated capability and impact.
  • Strong production experience with AWS and/or Azure, with hands-on expertise in cloud networking, identity and access management, secrets, certificates, security, scalability, and resilient architecture. Experience working deeply across both clouds is highly valued.
  • Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code, including reusable modules, environment provisioning, remote state, CI/CD integration, automated validation, security controls, and drift management.
  • Production experience with CI/CD, containers, and Kubernetes, using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker, EKS, AKS, Helm, Argo CD, Flux, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong automation and operational engineering capabilities, including scripting with Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages, plus experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent.
Experience with technologies such as Octopus Deploy, Kustomize, Karpenter, Backstage, OpenTelemetry, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, C#/.NET, service mesh, chaos engineering, or AI-assisted DevOps tooling is valuable, but you do not need experience with every technology listed to be successful in this role.

Personal / Soft Skills

  • You take ownership of complex technical problems and are comfortable troubleshooting across applications, infrastructure, networking, deployment pipelines, and cloud services.
  • You balance reliability, security, developer experience, scalability, and cost when making engineering decisions.
  • You enjoy automating repetitive work and creating reusable solutions rather than solving the same problem multiple times.
  • You communicate clearly in English and collaborate effectively in distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • You enjoy sharing knowledge, mentoring other engineers, documenting solutions, and helping establish technical standards.

Additional experience that can help you succeed

We’d be particularly interested in experience with one or more of the following:
  • Building Internal Developer Platforms, developer portals, or Golden Paths
  • Large-scale Kubernetes environments and advanced Kubernetes tooling
  • Multi-account AWS or multi-subscription Azure architectures
  • GitOps and progressive delivery
  • OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, or advanced observability
  • SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and reliability engineering
  • Multi-region architectures, disaster recovery, and chaos/resilience testing
  • Cloud FinOps, rightsizing, tagging, autoscaling, and cost governance
  • Modernizing Windows/IIS or other legacy enterprise workloads to cloud-native architectures
  • AIOps or AI-assisted tooling for operations, troubleshooting, or developer productivity
  • C#/.NET enterprise application environments
  • Portuguese language skills for collaboration in Brazil

What you’ll get?

This opportunity combines the autonomy of a senior individual contributor position with the chance to influence cloud, DevOps, platform, and reliability practices across a distributed engineering organization. You’ll solve technically challenging problems while building reusable capabilities that make other engineers more productive.
Location: Remote, Brazil
Employment: Full-time
Working model: Remote collaboration with meaningful overlap with the core engineering team and participation in scheduled on-call rotations when required.

As a Senior Salesforce Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

The company is on an incredible journey to become the universal symbol of trust. As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement. With over 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users, the work we do together has a massive global impact, helping millions of people make better choices every day. In this role, you will join the Go To Market department within the Technology organization. You will be pivotal in delivering large strategic projects and change requests across the Salesforce platform, supporting commercial, marketing, ops, and customer service teams. Lead & Senior Data Engineers

Location: Remote United States (US work authorization required)

Job Type: Multi-month engagement, likely to extend

Openings: 4 positions, 2 Lead and 2 Senior

Start Date: Around December 1, 2026

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the Role

We are building a team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform pulls data from the many systems a hospital runs on, maps it into a shared ontology and knowledge graph, and uses it to help executives make operational decisions, act on them and measure the results.

The hardest recurring problem is getting messy enterprise data in, clean and trusted, for every new customer. You will build that: connectors and pipelines from HR, scheduling, EHR and external benchmark sources into Snowflake on Azure, mapped to the ontology and published to a Neo4j graph. You will make it repeatable, so the next customer’s data goes live in days, not months. You will work with real, sensitive client data, and you will use AI-assisted development as a normal part of how you build.

Lead vs Senior

Both levels are hands-on and write production code every week.

Lead: Owns the technical direction of a pod: its design, its standards and the order in which work gets done. Works directly with the client’s architects and data owners to agree source extracts, data contracts and acceptance criteria. Reviews other engineers’ code and designs, and is accountable for what the pod ships. You have led a small team of engineers, set technical direction and worked directly with client architects and stakeholders.

Senior: Owns significant pieces end to end, such as a source connector, a set of mappings or the reconciliation for a domain, inside the direction the Lead sets. Works independently, raises problems early and needs no day-to-day supervision.

What We're Looking For

  • You have integrated messy enterprise source systems in production, not just clean APIs. You can talk through two or three: what the source really looked like, how you handled late files, schema drift, duplicates and conflicting records, and what you would do differently.

  • Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on Snowflake. You have built and run layered pipelines (raw, cleaned, modelled) with dbt or equivalent, with mappings and rules kept as versioned code.

  • Data contracts and versioned schemas. You define what a source must send, validate it on arrival, quarantine what fails and evolve schemas without breaking what sits downstream.

  • Data quality, lineage and reconciliation as part of the build. You can prove that totals match the source, trace any number back to the record it came from, and rerun a load without duplicating data.

  • Regulated or sensitive data. You have worked under PHI/PII controls such as HIPAA: masking and tokenisation, least-privilege access, audit trails and keeping sensitive fields out of places they should not be.

  • Multi-tenant data platforms with strict per-customer isolation. You have built onboarding that is repeatable: a new customer is configuration and mapping, not a new code base.

  • Azure experience: storage, identity and infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).

  • AI-assisted development. You use coding assistants daily and check what they produce.

  • You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the US. Occasional domestic travel may be required.

  • Available around December 1, 2026.

Strong Plus

  • Healthcare data: HR and workforce systems such as Workday or UKG, scheduling and timekeeping, or EHRs such as Epic, Cerner or MEDITECH.

  • Graph databases, ideally Neo4j: loading a graph from a warehouse and modelling for it.

  • Mapping data into an ontology or a common data model shared across many customers.

  • Entity resolution: matching people and records across systems without a shared identifier.

  • External benchmark or reference data feeds, by data share or flat file.

  • Batch pipelines built to be event-ready, with idempotent loads and incremental refresh.

  • Open lineage and metadata standards such as OpenLineage.

  • Monitoring data feeds in production: freshness, volume and failure alerts.
