Clearance: Current, active SECRET clearance required
Travel: CONUS and OCONUS, including contingency and austere locations
Employment type: Full-time, contingent on contract award

About KVG

KVG LLC is an international mission support company headquartered in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, with Program Management Offices worldwide. We deliver base operating and life support, expeditionary construction, logistics and commodities to U.S. military and Government customers under Navy, Air Force, Army, DLA and Department of State contract vehicles. Recent work includes ten miles of force-protection barriers on the southwest border, protective bunkers in the UAE, exercise life support in Japan and the Philippines, and bulk fuel delivery to Pine Gap, Australia.

About the role

KVG is bidding as a prime contractor on the U.S. Air Force Contract Augmentation Program VI (AFCAP VI), a multiple-award IDIQ run by the Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) at Tyndall AFB, Florida. AFCAP delivers rapid-response construction, services and commodities for contingencies, exercises, humanitarian operations and installation support worldwide. The Program Manager is the senior key person on the contract: the Government names the PM in the award, and the PM leads KVG’s AFCAP VI Program Management Office.

The Program Manager is identified in our proposal and signs a letter of intent before proposal submission on 1 December 2026. Employment in the role begins at contract award, currently expected in late 2027, and carries a minimum 12-month commitment from that date.

Location

Remote within the United States; Gettysburg, PA or Tyndall AFB / Panama City, FL area preferred.

What you will do

  • Lead the AFCAP VI PMO: Alternate Program Manager, primary and secondary 24-hour contacts, contracts managers, deployment managers and security manager.
  • Own the AFCAP Management Plan (staffing, quick response, quality control, procurement, subcontract management, safety, security, property control, mission-essential services and combating trafficking in persons) and keep it accepted by the Contracting Officer.
  • Serve in the 24/7 on-call rotation. Within one hour of the Contracting Officer’s call, respond with the authority to commit KVG’s funds and resources.
  • Direct task order capture: proposals on Fair Opportunity Proposal Requests, binding proposals within 24 hours on urgent requirements, and the Task Order Management Plan, task-order quality control plan and mission-essential plan that accompany each proposal.
  • Put KVG on site within 24 hours (CONUS) or 48 hours (OCONUS) of an urgent tasking. For classified taskings, respond in person at the AFCEC vault at Tyndall AFB or by secure video teleconference within two hours.
  • Manage simultaneous task orders in dispersed locations: schedule, cost, quality, subcontractor performance, Government property, and reporting (FLASH reports, situation reports, monthly status and cost reports).
  • Supervise the Site Manager and Alternate Site Manager on every task order.
  • Oversee deployment readiness for prime and subcontractor personnel: Tyndall AFB processing, SPOT letters of authorization, medical and immunization standards, pre-deployment training and CAAF obligations.
  • Manage firm-fixed-price, fixed-price-incentive and cost-reimbursable task orders, including draft-invoice pre-approval on cost-type work.
  • Complete the Government’s AFCAP contractor training after award.

Minimum qualifications

These are the Government’s stated criteria for the position. Each one is verified from your resume, your experience narrative and the DoW security database, so please address each directly.

  • U.S. citizen.
  • Current, active SECRET clearance. Clearance eligibility, an expired clearance or a clearance in process does not meet this requirement.
  • Five years of program management experience within the last seven years, with demonstrated expertise in each of the following:
    • Government appropriations
    • Air Force Mission Support functions, specifically Engineering and Force Support, or equivalent large-scale DoW/DoD installation services and base operations support
    • Construction, services and commodities
    • Government acquisitions
    • Management of multiple task orders greater than $2 million each, performed simultaneously in geographically dispersed locations, or equivalent deployment experience
  • Willing to sign a letter of intent committing to the role on award and to serve in it for at least 12 months.
  • Able to deploy CONUS and OCONUS and to meet DoW contractor deployment standards (medical and dental screening, immunizations, pre-deployment training).

Preferred

  • Experience on AFCAP, LOGCAP, WEXMAC, Navy base operating support or a similar contingency IDIQ.
  • Experience managing cost-reimbursable task orders (CPFF, CPIF) and DCAA-compliant cost reporting.
  • PMP or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, business or a related field.
  • Operating experience in CENTCOM, INDOPACOM, EUCOM/AFRICOM or SOUTHCOM.

How to apply

Apply through this posting and include the following:

  • Resume with month and year for each position.
  • A summary of the Government contracts and task orders you managed in the last seven years: customer, scope, dollar value, locations, your role, dates, and how many ran at the same time.
  • Confirmation that your SECRET clearance is current and active, the agency that granted it, and a facility security officer who can verify it. Do not send a Social Security number; KVG’s security lead will collect verification details separately.

KVG LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Are you passionate about increasing access to behavioral health services? Have you worked in Collaborative Care? Are you available to work evenings in your time zone? If so, we want you to join the April Health team as a Behavioral Health Care Manager.

About April Health

April Health is working to deliver high-quality, virtual behavioral health services to patients in the United States. Through the Collaborative Care model, an evidence-based model for treating behavioral health issues in primary care, April Health enables access to behavioral health services through healthcare providers that patients already know and trust.

April Health partners with primary care, women’s health, and pediatric practices to provide a hybrid behavioral health solution that combines human care management with AI-driven support to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider burden, and generate new revenue for our partners. Patients conduct regular appointments with our behavioral health care managers, receive guidance from psychiatrists, and our AI Therapeutic Coach helps patients between appointments, maximizing the value that patients receive in our program.

The Role

The Behavioral Health Care Manager is the primary point of contact for patients who are enrolled with April Health. This person is responsible for coordinating the patient’s care with the patient's primary care provider and consulting psychiatrist, tracking the patient’s symptoms with validated measurement tools, and directly meeting with the patient to deliver evidence-based treatments.

The Collaborative Care Model is a population-based approach to managing mental health in the primary care setting and is not a traditional psychotherapy model of care. Instead, we offer brief evidence-based interventions to patients, such as motivational interviewing, problem-solving treatment, and behavioral activation.

Responsibilities

  • Support and closely coordinate mental health care with the patient’s primary care provider, establishing a mutually agreeable care plan
  • Screen and assess patients for common mental health disorders
  • Support psychotropic medication management prescribed by PCPs, focusing on treatment adherence, side effects and other complications, and treatment effectiveness
  • Track patient follow-up and clinical outcomes using a registry, record encounters in the registry, and use the system to identify and re-engage patients
  • Plan specific mutual self-management goals, objectives, and behavioral interventions with action-oriented patients
  • Facilitate care plan changes for patients who are not improving, including changes in medications or psychosocial treatments or appropriate referrals for additional services
  • Participate in regularly scheduled caseload consultations with psychiatric consultants

Background and Skills

  • Background in providing care to patients struggling with mental health disorders
  • Experience working in a team-based healthcare setting
  • At least three years of clinical work experience
  • Proficiency in evidence-based treatment approaches (Problem Solving Treatment, Motivational Interviewing, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Behavioral Activation)
  • Experience using measurement-based care tools (PHQ9, GAD7, C-SSRS, etc.)
  • Masters degree in a mental health-related field

Key Attributes

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and communicate effectively in a team setting
  • Ability to maintain effective and professional relationships with patients and other members of the care team
  • Ability to effectively engage patients in a therapeutic relationship
  • Experience with telemedicine and comfort working with patients by telephone and video calls
  • Interpersonally adaptable, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to work in a startup environment

Our Top Perks

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote work
  • Fantastic total rewards package, including health, vision, dental, etc.
  • Working equipment allowance
Salary: $53,000 – $58,000 / year

Role Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of renewable energy engineering projects for Revamp’s Owner & Developer clients, with full accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, and deliverables. This role leads multiple smaller projects or several complex projects concurrently, coordinating internal teams and subconsultants to ensure high-quality, on-time, and on-budget delivery. The Project Manager serves as a key point of contact for clients.

Duties & Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own project scopes, schedules, and budgets from kickoff through closeout.
  • Manage multiple smaller projects or several complex projects simultaneously.
  • Coordinate and manage internal discipline teams and external subconsultants to ensure timely and accurate deliverables.
  • Prepare, track, and submit monthly project invoicing.
  • Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts.
  • Ensure projects comply with client requirements, contractual obligations, and Revamp quality standards.
  • Prepare and review project scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  • Review complete project documents for conformity, quality assurance, and contractual compliance.
  • Apply standard project management procedures and criteria with independent judgment.

Client & Stakeholder Coordinations

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.
  • Lead and participate in project meetings with clients, internal teams, and subcontractors.
  • Present project status, risks, and key issues clearly and confidently to stakeholders.
  • Review client standards, best practices, and project-specific requirements and ensure alignment across teams.
  • Assist with proposal development, including scope definition, budgeting, and scheduling inputs.

Collaboration & Team Support

  • Assign tasks to and direct discipline team members to complete project assignments.
  • Plan and coordinate detailed aspects of engineering work in collaboration with technical leads.
  • Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced project and engineering staff.
  • Support a collaborative, accountable, and transparent project team environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting project deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field or an associate’s degree in a related field plus substantial relevant industry experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of project management experience in an engineering consulting environment, renewable energy, or similar industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project scopes, schedules, budgets, and invoicing.
  • Ability to independently evaluate, select, and apply standard project management procedures.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex project issues.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a high standard for accuracy and quality.

Preferred

  • Substantial experience in renewable energy engineering, development, or construction environments.
  • Familiarity with the renewable energy project development lifecycle.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

  • Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the us since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of immigrants, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Mind Partners is an executive search firm with offices in London and Paris. We are partnering with Arkance to appoint their Partner Marketing Manager position. Arkance is a leading provider of digital solutions for the construction, manufacturing, and infrastructure industries.

With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, Arkance empowers businesses to accelerate their digital transformation and build a better world.

We are looking for a hands-on, proactive Partner Marketing Manager to drive demand generation and brand awareness for new partner solutions marketing and go-to-market activation across EMEA.

The role will be focused on our strategic alliance with partners in the AEC ecosystem, starting with Egnyte: an AI-powered cloud content security, governance, and file-sharing platform

Over time, new partners will be added to our ecosystem and will be covered by this role as well.

Reporting to the EMEA Product and Services Marketing Director, you will work closely with strategic partners, regional sales, services and marketing teams to turn partner strategies into coordinated go-to-market programmes that drive adoption, demand and pipeline growth.

You will act as the primary marketing point of contact for assigned partners, owning joint marketing planning, co-funded initiatives, campaigns, events and market activation and sales enablement while ensuring strong coordination across EMEA and local teams.

This is a hands-on role requiring a startup mindset. You will be expected to take ownership, move quickly and translate partner opportunities into measurable marketing activity, leveraging internal resources and capabilities to scale execution across markets and new partners.

Your key responsibilities

1. Partner Marketing & Joint Planning
  • Act as the main marketing point of contact for assigned strategic partners, at first focusing primarily on Egnyte
  • Develop and coordinate joint marketing plans with partners
  • Translate partner priorities into actionable EMEA marketing programmes
  • Manage co-marketing initiatives, MDF/funding requests and reporting
  • Coordinate activity across EMEA and local marketing teams

2. GTM Activation and Execution

  • Activate GTM strategies developed in collaboration with Product Marketing
  • Coordinate partner launches and market activation across EMEA
  • Ensure alignment across partners, Product Marketing, sales, services and local marketing teams

3. Design

Support the development of:

  • PowerPoint presentations and dynamic slide templates
  • marketing collateral across channels
  • sales enablement material
  • visual assets using design tools (Canva, Figma, or Office)

4. Demand Generation (Hands-on)

  • Execute targeted campaigns (ABM, digital, events)
  • Coordinate with EMEA and local marketing teams for:
  • campaign delivery
  • content creation
  • Manage and optimise:
  • landing pages
  • email campaigns
  • lead generation activities

5. Sales Enablement

  • Work with Product Marketing to activate and adapt pitch decks, one-pagers, sales playbooks and ROI tools for partner GTM activities
  • Support partner and sales enablement, training and key opportunities

6. Performance Tracking & Optimisation

  • Track and report on key KPIs:
  • lead generation and conversion to opportunity
  • pipeline contribution
  • campaign performance
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve results of marketing initiatives and sales plays

7. Broader Marketing and Communications Support

​
  • Support additional partner and product marketing initiatives as needed, in line with business priorities

Requirements

The skills required for this position:

  • Strong execution capability (campaigns, content, coordination)
  • Good understanding of product and solutions marketing fundamentals
  • Clear, concise and impactful communication, with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences and stakeholders
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments, navigating multiple stakeholders, markets and competing priorities
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects
  • Proficiency in designing high-converting sales decks, presentations, and enablement assets using tools like PowerPoint, Canva, or Figma
  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools (HubSpot, CRM, CMS, analytics)
  • Budget management
About you
  • Startup mentality- takes ownership and moves fast
  • Hands-on executor- comfortable doing as well as coordinating
  • Self-sufficient- able to operate with autonomy
  • Aesthetic & detail-oriented:High bar for visual quality and brand consistency across all internal and external-facing assets
  • Proactive- identifies opportunities and acts on them
  • Commercial mindset- understands how marketing drives revenue

Your profile

  • 3–6 years in partner marketing or demand generation roles
  • Experience in B2B SaaS or digital solutions
  • Exposure to sales-led environments

Languages & other requirements

  • Fluent in English (mandatory)
  • Other European languages are a plus
  • Willingness to travel across EMEA as requested

Benefits

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Mid-to-Senior Level Drupal Engineer (AI-Enabled Platform Support) contributes to the design, development, testing, and support of enterprise Drupal applications. This role supports custom module enhancements, configuration and workflow updates, bug fixes, and release activities while applying modern AI-assisted engineering practices to improve delivery speed, code quality, and documentation. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams including program managers, Subject matter experts, analysts, and designers to build a modern, secure, and AI-augmented platforms.

This role extends beyond traditional Drupal development and an ideal candidate has foundational Drupal/PHP skills, strong learning agility, and hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, analysis, and technical documentation. Additionally, you will troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, providing mentorship and guidance to junior developers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Design, develop, and implement custom modules (e.g., custom entities, views, forms, workflows, notifications, and reports) to extend Drupal functionality according to project requirements
  • Support multi-site development practices and environment-aware configuration management
  • Configure and theme Drupal sites, ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience across all devices
  • Implement and troubleshoot authentication and access patterns, including external auth/SAML-oriented integrations and role-based permissions
  • Assist with state-machine-driven workflow logic, forms-step experiences, queue/cron-driven processing, and event-subscriber behavior
  • Contribute to search and reporting capabilities (Search API, Views, Views Data Export, bulk operations, and operational dashboards)
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs to enhance application functionality and user experience
  • Identify and implement performance improvements to ensure fast, efficient, and scalable Drupal applications
  • Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior developers to foster a culture of continuous improvement
  • Provide ad hoc support for general project planning and technical design:
    • Support scheduling
    • Ensure development alignment with formal process reviews
    • Prepare and deliver presentations related to testing
  • Support overall project execution as required:
    • Assist in requirements definition
    • Support design processes
    • Support release branches and SDLC workflows (development, test, release, and production readiness)
    • Assist in development and documentation processes.
  • Use AI coding assistants responsibly to accelerate implementation, test generation, impact analysis, and root-cause investigation while preserving security and compliance requirements.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, code generation tools) to accelerate coding, debugging, and documentation.
  • Ensure responsible and secure use of AI in compliance with organizational and federal guidelines
  • Must demonstrate significant initiative, independence, ability to follow through, and an interest in learning our business are essential.
  • Security clearance or background check may be required at varying levels, depending on particular project assignments or role.
  • Keep up-to-date with the latest Drupal developments, industry trends, and best practices to ensure our solutions remain cutting-edge.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Hands-on experience and Demonstrated ability using AI-assisted development/engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, AI-based IDE tools)
  • Understanding of prompt design for software tasks (debugging prompts, test-generation prompts, and architecture summarization prompts)
  • Ability to validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, accessibility, and maintainability before adoption
  • Practical understanding of secure AI usage: no sensitive data leakage, controlled context sharing, and policy-compliant usage

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in Drupal and PHP development
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Expert proficiency in Drupal 8/9/10, including custom module and theme development
  • Strong knowledge of PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related web technologies
  • Experience with Drupal APIs, Drush, and Composer
  • Familiarity with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue.js) is a plus
  • Understanding of DevOps practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing
  • Knowledge of usability/accessibility standards of user interface development to produce code compliant for Section 508 accessibility; experience working with development tools that aid in this process
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud technologies like AWS and Acquia
  • Security clearance or background check may be required at varying levels, depending on particular project assignments or role
  • Ensure access and equipment are configured to begin and continue work
  • Follow established procedures and guidelines
  • Implement approved changes and communicate status to the PM/Department
  • Conduct and contribute to audits, resolution of compliance gaps, Lessons Learned, and implement process improvements, as designated by the PM/Department Lead
  • Analyze requested changes for LOE, provide estimates, and update plans, as assigned
  • Evaluate work products/deliverables for technical accuracy and adherence to project requirements and standards
  • Use SharePoint and document controls to follow established processes
  • When assigned as author, complete document updates, initiate peer review, complete the review process, and ensure updates are made according to that process

Scope Infotech offers all employees the following benefits:

  • Health Insurance (medical, dental, vision)
  • Retirement Savings Plans (401K)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Leave, Holidays)
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
  • Insurance (Life, Short/Long Term Disability, AD&D)
  • Employee Referral Bonus

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

Note

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities.

Salary: $125,000 - $140,000

raw.excerpt: Hey!  Alex here, founder of Elavate.  I'm writing this one myself because you'll be working directly with me.
raw.description:
Hey! Alex here, founder of Elavate. I'm writing this one myself because you'll be working directly with me.

  • Salary: £80,000+ base

  • Location: Remote-first (we do have a London Office where some of our team work from)

  • Reports to: Me, directly

  • Hours: Full-time, but not a 9-to-5. Read "The hours" below before you apply

Who we are

We're the fastest-growing DTC brand in the UK. We sell a collagen supplement for women in their 40s, 50s and beyond.

We've grown to over £100M in annual revenue, completely bootstrapped. Now we're looking to keep taking over the UK collagen market and grow into the USA.

We have a warm, friendly culture. We're fast-growing and ambitious, and as we grow we need more smart people. You'll work with other smart people on meaningful, exciting work every day.

About the role

As Elavate keeps growing, there's loads coming up, so I'm looking for one sharp person to be my right hand. Someone I can hand anything to: my inbox, my Slack, the threads I haven't got to and the random projects that land on my desk.

Over time you become a version of me for everything outside creative, so I can spend my time on growth and the future direction of the company, our creative team and our rapid US expansion. Right now I spend around 6 hours a day clearing Slack and email before I get to the real work. Your job is to give me most of that back.

This isn't a diary-and-travel EA role. I barely travel and there isn't much personal admin. It's the business: hundreds of messages a week, lots of open loops, and someone good enough to handle most of it the way I would.

What you'll own

  • My inbox. Stay on top of it: four sweeps a day, replies in my voice that I don't need to check, drafts for the rest, and every thread closed out.

  • Very fast Slack replies. This one's really important. Clear the chats that don't need me, reply in thread, and only bring me what actually needs me.

  • A daily roundup waiting when I'm online at midday: what needs me today, what you're handling, and what you've closed.

  • Follow-ups and chasing. Be very organised and diligent here. If I've said it, it's written down, tracked and chased with the right people until it's closed, including by email as me.

  • Meetings and calls. Prep notes before, recorded, then a summary and actions the next day. You'll also sit in on our weekly creative review and on supplier and partner calls, and hold people to their timelines.

  • People and hiring admin. Hiring admin with our recruiters, onboarding and offboarding, and people admin for our international team.

  • Trackers. A contracts and renewals tracker, plus cost tracking for things like influencer spend and software subscriptions.

  • Admin that just happens. Invoices paid fast, plus the bookings that keep things moving (team hotel nights, padel, Airbnbs for shoots, team gifts) without checking in with me.

  • Side projects outside everyone's remit. The things I've spotted but don't have time for, that don't sit in anyone's normal job. You dig in, figure it out and close it.

  • SOPs in Notion as you go, so nothing lives only in my/your head.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • I don't open my inbox or the misc Slack threads. You've handled them in my tone and I didn't need to check.

  • Nothing I mention gets dropped.

  • Every meeting has prep before it and a summary after.

  • Bookings and admin happen without me thinking about them.

  • I've got most of those 6 hours a day back.

Who you are

  • Very sharp. You read between the lines, get context fast and figure things out on your own. If I mention something once, it's handled.

  • Technical and fluent in AI. You build your own custom workflows and automations (Claude Code, n8n or whatever does the job), and you pick up new tools really fast.

  • Proactive and independent. You don't wait to be told. You ask what you need, then follow up with the right people, chase and close things out yourself.

  • Calm, organised and diligent. You bring order to a busy founder and a fast-moving business, and follow-ups never slip.

  • A great writer. You can write as someone else and nobody can tell.

  • Discreet. You'll see sensitive commercial, financial and people matters every day.

  • Always learning. A positive, growth mindset. You want to get better every week.

  • Locked in. You want this, and it shows from the first conversation.

Experience

  • You've been the right hand to a founder, CEO or C-suite exec in a fast-moving business (EA, chief of staff, founder's associate or similar).

  • You're fluent in Google Workspace, Slack and Notion, and at home in Google Sheets.

  • You don't need e-commerce experience. You do need to be technical: someone who learns new skills and adopts them really fast.

  • Bonus points if you've built something of your own. Everyone here is a builder in their own way.

Where it goes next

The role grows into chief of staff. That's the next step: working with me on the most important projects in the business. You'll see every part of a fast-growing brand up close.

The hours (please read this bit)

This isn't a typical 9-to-5 role. It also isn't literally 24/7, but I need someone who's always available, whether that's early in the morning or throughout the day.

My day starts late (12pm) and runs into the early hours, and most of what I send goes out after 6pm. You clear what came in overnight so the roundup is ready when I'm online, and you're quick on Slack in the evenings.

If you clock out at the end of a 9-to-5 and don't check or reply to messages after that, this won't work for me. This part is non-negotiable.

What you get

  • £80,000+ starting base, depending on experience

  • A real path into a chief of staff role, if that's where you want to go

  • A 3-month review against clear goals, with your base stepping up when you hit them

  • 30 days off a year

  • Vitality private health insurance

  • Travel allowance for trips to the London office

  • Free Elavate, obviously

How we hire

An intro call, an interview with me, a paid test task, then a final interview. There's a short reasoning test along the way. We move fast.

raw.description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your Role at Baxter

As a Clinical Integration Specialist, you will be responsible for providing clinical and technical expertise, best-practice standards, and professional skills to support Sales and Services engagements for the Baxter Care Communications product portfolio of Digital Health products.


You will report to the Clinical Integrations Manager, will work internally in close partnership with Sales, Clinical Solutions, Project Managers, and Services and Support, and will work with customer clinical and technical staff to design and implement solutions.

  • TRAVEL: Up to 80% travel, including overnight travel. 100% REMOTE

Your Team

We embrace opportunities to connect with the doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals that use our products every day to save and sustain lives. Observing their work, understanding their needs, and building positive relationships are integral to our success.


What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate with team members to architect accurate clinical assessment documents for customer-facing integration, alarm management middleware, and nurse call engagements
  • Consult on and configure alarm management middleware settings and nurse call configurations based on the clinical design workbook
  • Manage multiple, simultaneous projects from assessment through implementation for clinical integration consulting programs
  • Interface at all levels within a customer's organization and coordinate technical information and healthcare ecosystem requirements
  • Assist other team members with tasks required to execute delivery of clinical integration consulting programs
  • Aid in mentorship, continuous skill building and onboarding activities within Clinical Operations
  • Interact daily with customers through in-person, phone, and web conference activities
  • Provide input to product management, market planning, and technical development of Clinical Solutions
  • Incorporate quality and continuous improvement as part of overall job performance; adhering and training to Bater's QMS policies and procedures
  • Maintain up-to-date understanding of healthcare trends and technical developments

What you'll bring

  • Degree/certification in Business, IT, Project Management, Clinical Informatics, or related experience
  • Clinical experience in acute care hospital environment preferred
  • Ability to articulate, design, and successfully implement clinical technology
  • Facilitate change management philosophies to enhance the adoption of all Baxter Care Communication programs
  • Excellent written and verbal presentation skills and ability to build written content with little direction
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite
  • Must be able to work in team environment or independently making clinical consulting decisions without guidance
  • Strong conflict resolution skills, including the abilities to negotiate and influence others
  • Good problem solving and analytical skills to understand key customer clinical issues and define how IT solutions will solve challenges facing our customers today
  • Experience with standards development based on healthcare industry trends
  • Ability to react to changes in priorities, demands, timelines, and scope promptly and efficiently, through analytical and problem-solving techniques
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
  • Customer minded - actively evaluate and work to improve the customer experience

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all our employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. To that end, this position has a base salary range of $72,000 to $99,000 plus an annual incentive bonus. The above range represents the expected base salary range for this position. The actual salary may vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills/experience, time in the role, business line, and geographic/office location.

US Benefits at Baxter (except for Puerto Rico)

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. raw.description:
IM8 is a next-generation health and longevity brand co-founded by David Beckham and Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE), on a mission to make world-class nutritional science accessible to everyone. Launched in late 2024, IM8 grew Q1 2026 revenue nearly 6x year-over-year to $33.8M, and the company has raised full-year 2026 IM8 revenue guidance to $190M–$210M. Over 60% of revenue is generated outside the US. We ship to 43 countries, and our athlete partner roster includes David Beckham, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aryna Sabalenka, Ollie Bearman, and Inter Miami CF.

We are built on science, not story — our flagship Daily Ultimate Essentials carries 90 active ingredients, we run randomized controlled trials on our products, and we hold a clinical-grade standard in a category notorious for shortcuts.

Our business is subscription at its core. Every basis point of NRR we add compounds — into LTV, into payback, into the ability to outspend everyone else on acquisition. Retention isn't a department at IM8. It is the model.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Executive to be the front line of our consumer brands — converting pre-sales inquiries into customers and supporting existing customers across chat and email. You will blend a sales-driven, conversion mindset with genuine, patient customer care, acting as the customer's advocate and feeding real insight back to the team. This role interacts with Chinese-speaking clients and thrives in a fast-moving, startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify customer needs and offer clear explanations of product offerings, personalized suggestions, and value propositions to convert prospects into customers.
  • Actively follow up on pre-sales inquiries, with a focus on building rapport and turning leads into customers through engaging conversations and appropriate product recommendations.
  • Help our customers out by understanding their issues, verifying their validity, and providing the best possible solution according to the company's guidelines.
  • Ensure that your product knowledge is up-to-date by following announcements closely and staying organized.
  • Be the customer's advocate and help shape product improvement by disseminating customer feedback or identifying the core issues across internal teams.
  • Escalate relevant issues to management or cross-team stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Use Gorgias, internal systems, and collaboration tools (e.g. Google Sheets, Slack) to support customers through chat and email.
  • Provide assistance in general administrative activities and ad-hoc duties as assigned by your direct manager.

Requirements

  • Work hours: 5 days a week including Saturday, Sunday & Monday, or as assigned by your manager.
  • Demonstrated experience in a pre-sales or sales support role, preferably in an eCommerce or direct-to-consumer environment.
  • Sales-driven mindset with a passion for delivering results and achieving conversion goals.
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution skills: quick-thinking, patient, ability to absorb and convey constantly changing product information.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills: Fluency in English required, Cantonese and Mandarin a bonus.
  • High emotional intelligence: when faced with the occasional but inevitable situation of a bad customer interaction, be able to maintain professionalism and a positive outlook.
  • Desire to work in a startup environment: proactivity, a strong sense of responsibility, willingness to roll up your sleeves and get involved beyond your scope.
  • Preferably prior experience in Amazon, TikTok, or messaging tools for sales and customer support.
  • Experience in eCommerce, health, wellness, or tech industries is highly desirable.

You Must Be AI-Native
Active, fluent daily AI tool usage is mandatory, not optional. We expect you to use AI every day to work faster and smarter — drafting and personalising customer replies, staying on top of constantly changing product information, and spotting patterns in customer feedback. If AI is not already part of how you work, this is not the role for you.

Beat Claude Challenge
Shortlisted candidates complete a role-specific assignment, scored against a baseline we generate using Claude. To advance, your submission needs to beat it. Ties don't advance.

Want to stand out?
Take a look at our challenge repo: Prenetics/beat-claude

We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Vizient Intern Program Overview:


This program is designed to foster a beneficial relationship and provide growth opportunities for Vizient, our employees, and collegiate students. Since 2000, our summer intern program has provided college undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral students with practical experience that exposes them to multiple aspects of a career field and the healthcare industry. This full-time, paid intern program offers an opportunity to accelerate academic learning, apply classroom knowledge, and introduce students to a professional setting. Interns are assigned a supervisor to mentor/develop their business skills, as well as monitor their work experiences. Interns are integral members of the company’s team, setting goals, working toward deadlines, and actively participating in community service projects.


The program requires the intern to commit to 10 weeks of participation in all formal training, mentoring, on-the-job learning, and opportunities to interact with senior leaders.

  • Program starts June 1, 2027, and ends August 6, 2027
  • Pay rate: $25 per hour.

About the team and role

The Pharmacy Aggregation Group helps healthcare providers improve pharmacy purchasing performance, contract value, and supply-cost management through data, analytics, and strategic supplier relationships. The team supports member hospitals and health systems by translating pharmacy purchasing activity into actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve contract participation, compliance, and value.


What You’ll Do

  • Support the development of pharmacy spend, contract-value, and member opportunity analyses that help the team identify measurable savings and value-creation opportunities.
  • Assist with gathering, validating, organizing, and analyzing pharmacy purchasing and membership data.
  • Contribute to data models, reporting tools, and analytical methods used to evaluate pharmacy spend, pricing, contract participation, and compliance.
  • Work with analysts and cross-functional business partners to clarify requirements, investigate findings, and support data-driven solutions.
  • Document analytical methods and assumptions, summarize results, and help communicate findings through reports, dashboards, or presentations.
  • Generate ideas for improving pharmacy analytics and participate in assigned team, development, and community-impact activities.

What You’ll Learn

  • Learn how pharmacy purchasing, healthcare supply economics, aggregation, contracts, and member value intersect.
  • Build practical experience with data analysis, reporting, financial modeling, and analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, and Power BI.
  • Understand how pharmacy analytics supports member decision-making, supplier relationships, contract strategy, and enterprise performance.
  • Strengthen project coordination, written and verbal communication, documentation, presentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in business analytics, data analytics, computer science, information systems, statistics, finance, healthcare administration, pharmacy, or a related field.
  • Coursework, academic projects, internships, or other experience using Excel and at least one data or reporting tool such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or R.
  • Experience with data analysis, financial analysis, reporting, data visualization, database concepts, statistical analysis, or financial modeling.
  • Ability to organize information, analyze and synthesize findings, solve problems, and communicate results clearly in writing and verbally.
  • Interest in healthcare, pharmacy, business analytics, healthcare supply chain, or using data to improve business and member outcomes.
  • Available to participate full time for the ten-week program from June 1 through August 6, 2027. Locations: Irving, TX; Chicago, IL; Centennial, CO; Cape Girardeau, MO; Washington, DC; Alpharetta, GA; Edina, MN; Virtual (Remote).

raw.description:
In this role, you will build and lead Prosci's new Global Services Operations & Excellence team: the operational engine behind our training and advisory delivery worldwide and the owner of the client experience it produces. You will shape the team's charter, structure and operating model, and use it to turn delivery strategy into predictable, scalable and profitable execution across North America, EMEA and APAC. You also partner with the VP, Global Service Delivery, so they can focus on strategy, client relationships and growth.

Since our founding in 1994, Prosci has been laser-focused on change. By combining our deep understanding of people with a proven methodology rooted in the creation of the ADKAR® Model, we’ve helped countless people and organizations thrive. Our solutions empower customers with lasting change resiliency through a unique blend of training, advisory services, and licensing options, including Kaiya™, Prosci's expert change management AI tool.

At Prosci, we are a purpose-driven organization full of passionate, curious, and results-oriented people. Working at Prosci means being part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to our purpose of creating a world where change is done right. Join us and be part of a culture that thrives on continuous learning, growth, and making a difference.

Check out our website for more about our team and approach: .

Key Responsibilities

Key role responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

Run delivery operations and capacity

  • Plan global capacity and resources for instructors and consultants.
  • Forecast demand two or more quarters ahead.
  • Schedule and staff public, virtual, onsite and advisory engagements across time zones.
  • Manage the delivery lifecycle from sales-to-delivery handoff through logistics, delivery, close-out and billing handoff.
  • Set up escalation paths and resolve delivery issues quickly, including cancellations, instructor gaps and client escalations.

Drive performance, quality and financials

  • Define and report delivery KPIs: utilization, on-time delivery, cancellation and reschedule rates, CSAT/NPS, cost per delivery and delivery margin.
  • Build and maintain operational dashboards for the VP and leadership team.
  • Partner with Finance on delivery forecasts, budgets, cost control and revenue recognition.
  • Review quality and financial results together so efficiency gains never come at the expense of the client experience.

Raise service delivery excellence

  • Define what excellent Prosci delivery looks like and build a global delivery quality framework, including standards, session observations and quality audits.
  • Establish and lead the instructor and consultant quality program: onboarding, certification, performance reviews, coaching and exit decisions.
  • Own the client experience from booking through post-session follow-up.
  • Run the client feedback loop: collect, analyze and act on feedback, and share insights with Product and Content.
  • Track excellence metrics such as first-time-right delivery, repeat bookings and quality scores by instructor and consultant.
  • Ensure clients receive a consistent Prosci experience in every region and format.

Build and lead the Global Services Operations & Excellence team

  • Define the team's charter, scope and operating model, including how it works with regional delivery teams and the VP, Global Service Delivery.
  • Design the team structure and roles, build the hiring plan, and recruit and onboard the founding team. [CONFIRM: planned team size and hiring phases]
  • Bring existing operations, scheduling and quality activities into the team, with clear ownership and a smooth handover.
  • Set the team's operating rhythm: planning cycles, governance forums, reporting cadence and decision rights.
  • Design, document and improve global delivery processes and SOPs, balancing global standards with regional needs.
  • Own or co-own delivery systems (PSA/ERP, scheduling, LMS, BI) and drive adoption.
  • Identify and implement automation and AI opportunities that let delivery scale without growing headcount at the same rate.
  • Lead, coach and develop a distributed team as it grows, building its capability and a culture of operational discipline and service excellence.
  • Represent Service Delivery in cross-functional forums and stand in for the VP where needed.
  • Lead change within the team and delivery network, applying the Prosci Methodology.

Requirements

Based on this role’s scope and responsibilities, we are seeking candidates with the following minimum qualifications, skills, attributes, and competencies. Preferred qualifications are also noted.

Competencies

Drives Results: builds a team that delivers against agreed operational and financial targets.

Customer Focus: builds a client-first mindset in the team and delivery network.

Collaboration: builds strong working partnerships across Sales, Finance, Product and Content, and People.

Leads Change: builds the team's ability to adopt and sustain change.

Builds Effective Teams: forms a new team with a shared purpose, clear roles and strong accountability.

Develops Others: builds the team's skills through coaching and feedback.

Decision Quality: builds sound, data-informed decision making in the team.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with PSA/ERP and BI tools, such as Certinia, Salesforce, Kantata, Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong financial acumen: delivery margin, forecasting, budgets and working with Finance.
  • Capacity planning, scheduling and utilization management for a delivery workforce of employees and/or contractors.
  • Process design and improvement; Lean, Six Sigma or ITIL knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience applying automation or AI to operational workflows (preferred, but not required).

Working with AI at Prosci

As a people leader building a new team, you embed AI in how it works from the start to make delivery operations faster, more consistent and more scalable. You encourage experimentation, share what works and help people build confidence with new tools. You uphold Prosci's data security, confidentiality and intellectual property governance in every use of AI.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in service delivery, professional services or training operations, including 3+ years leading multi-region operations.
  • Experience building a new operations, service excellence or similar function from the ground up, including org design, hiring and setting up operating rhythms.
  • A track record of measurable improvement, such as higher utilization, lower delivery cost, faster time-to-deliver or better client satisfaction.
  • Experience building delivery quality or client experience programs, including standards, facilitator quality reviews and feedback loops.
  • Experience leading managers or coordinators across time zones.
  • Clear communication, moving comfortably between VP-level strategy and day-to-day problem solving.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Preferred: background in training, education, consulting or learning services; experience scaling from mid-size to global; experience across North American, European and Asia-Pacific markets.
  • Preferred: Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL or PMP credentials; familiarity with change management; Prosci certification is a plus.

Additional Information

Travel Requirements: This role requires 20% travel.

Work Location: This is a remote role.

Compensation: $131,600 - $164,500 USD is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience. This role is eligible for inclusion in our bonus program.

Benefits

Through our experience and strategic focus on the people side of change, we know that by taking care of our people, we are taking care of our business. In addition to the compensation detailed above, we offer comprehensive wellness benefits, including generous flexible paid time off, holidays and volunteer time, medical, dental, vision, long-term and short-term disability programs, life insurance, pet insurance, 401k with company matching, and access to LinkedIn Learning. Our “mostly virtual” culture is vibrant with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, get involved in employee-led interest and resource groups, and to meet up with team members at in-person local or market-wide events.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every requirement listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply. Prosci is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Employment opportunities at Prosci are available to all applicants, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. You can learn more about our efforts to build a more inclusive, equitable and diverse organization: Driving Meaningful Change | Prosci.

Job Description:

DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.

Our interns are not observers—they are contributors. Embedded in real teams and paired with dedicated mentorship, you will work on practical problems and deliver meaningful engineering output.


In this role, you will partner closely with our Documentation and Engineering teams to improve our developer-facing documentation platform, build CI/CD automation, and apply modern AI tooling to maintain freshness and accuracy. You will focus on building tools that minimize manual overhead—such as PR checks, content validation pipelines, and release workflows—helping our documentation evolve seamlessly alongside our product.


This is a fully remote position open to recent college graduates and early-career engineers. The program runs approximately 6 months.


What you'll do:


  • Build CI/CD Checks & Workflow Automation: Develop lightweight GitHub Actions/PR checks to streamline doc reviews, run automated linters, and validate content changes against code updates.
  • Automate Testing & Code Snippet Execution: Create automated tests that run documentation code examples and notebooks in CI to catch breaking changes early.
  • Implement Content & Documentation Tooling: Assist in building tools and scripts to convert, generate, or publish documentation artifacts (e.g., Markdown/MDX pipelines, changelogs, and release summaries from Jira/PR data).
  • Apply AI to Developer Tooling: Explore using LLMs and agentic scripts for practical site health tasks, such as flagging stale screenshots or enhancing doc indexing and retrieval for AI assistants.
  • Collaborate & Document: Work closely with your mentor and docs engineers, communicate progress in weekly syncs, and present your accomplishments at the end-of-internship Showcase.

What you'll learn:


  • CI/CD & Developer Productivity: Practical experience building GitHub workflows, PR bots, and test automation pipelines in a large-scale engineering environment.
  • Modern Documentation Engineering: Hands-on experience with modern documentation frameworks (Markdown, MDX, static site generators) and API documentation lifecycles.
  • Pragmatic AI & LLM Automation: How to apply LLMs, scripting, and evaluation to automate real-world maintenance tasks.
  • Collaborative Software Engineering: Working in an async-first culture using Git, code reviews, Slack, and agile delivery practices.

Program Structure:


Phase I (Month 1) — Onboarding & Foundation: Learn the platform, toolchains, and repos. Co-create an Individual Learning Plan with your mentor and complete your first guided tickets.

Phase II (Months 2–5) — Core Project Delivery: Take ownership of scoped automation projects (e.g., CI testing of doc snippets, PR review gating, or generator scripts) with ongoing guidance and weekly 1:1 check-ins.

Phase III (Month 6) — Refinement, Handoff & Showcase: Finalize deliverables, write clean documentation for the team to maintain your work, and present your accomplishments at an Intern Showcase.


Qualifications:


  • Recent graduate or completed Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical project experience).
  • Solid foundational programming skills in Python and comfort with scripting or data parsing.
  • Familiarity with Git and GitHub workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
  • Basic exposure to or enthusiasm for CI/CD concepts (e.g., GitHub Actions) and web/documentation formats (Markdown, HTML/CSS, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Curiosity and eagerness to experiment with LLM APIs for developer productivity.
  • Strong written communication skills and an organized, problem-solving mindset.

Nice to Have:


  • Experience writing GitHub Actions or automating developer workflows.
  • Prior experience with static site generators (Docusaurus, MkDocs, Next.js, etc.) or MDX.
  • Familiarity with running automated tests or linting tools in CI pipelines.
  • Personal or academic projects integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).

The talent and dedication of our employees are at the core of DataRobot’s journey to be an iconic company. We strive to attract and retain the best talent by providing competitive pay and benefits with our employees’ well-being at the core. Here’s what your benefits package may include depending on your location and local legal requirements: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance, Flexible Time Off Program, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!

raw.description:
This position will operate on a remote, contractual basis.

About MakeUseOf

MakeUseOf is one of the largest online technology publications on the web today. We equip millions of readers—from everyday consumers to seasoned tech enthusiasts—with practical guides, explainers, product recommendations, and deep feature analysis to help them make the most of their technology.

About the Role

MakeUseOf is looking for Freelance Features Writers across our core tech verticals. While we cover everything from desktop operating systems to smart home tech, we are actively looking for specialized writers who can turn complex technical subjects, hands-on builds, and practical home tech into clear, engaging features.

Priority Coverage Areas:

  • Home Automation & Practical DIY Tech: Smart home sensors (motion, occupancy, contact), smart hubs/protocols (Matter, Zigbee, Z-Wave), power tool ecosystems (Ryobi, Milwaukee, DeWalt), and AV/networking cabling infrastructure (Cat 6/6a, Ethernet drops, HDMI standards).
  • AI & Local Language Models: Writers with dedicated hardware rigs excited to test, benchmark, and write about open-source local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio), local AI workflows, custom agents, and practical consumer AI applications.
  • Homelab & Advanced Networking: Deep knowledge of home networking infrastructure, Proxmox, NAS builds, self-hosting, network management tools, routers, radio networks, and home network security.
  • PC Hardware & Linux: Hands-on experience with CPUs, GPUs, benchmarking, custom PC building, hardware testing, and the Linux ecosystem.
  • Maker Projects & Hardware Hacking: Smart home automation, Raspberry Pi, ESP32 microcontrollers, DIY hardware builds, and practical workshop tech.
  • Core Operating Systems & Software: Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, security/privacy tools, productivity software, and web utilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively pitch creative, original feature ideas while regularly claiming assigned topics from the editorial board.
  • Write clear, engaging, and structurally sound feature articles that simplify complex technical concepts.
  • Test software, hardware, or workflows hands-on to provide authentic, step-by-step guidance and technical analysis.
  • Input, format, and structure articles inside our in-house CMS according to style guidelines (including screenshots, formatting, and link insertion).
  • Work collaboratively with section editors to refine pitches and incorporate feedback.

Application Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Track record writing technical guides, hardware deep-dives, or software features in English.
  • Access to the physical hardware, custom rigs, microcontrollers, homelab environments, or testing setups required for your primary coverage areas.
  • Strong drive to consistently pitch fresh, relevant article ideas that match current tech trends.
  • Ability to break down technical jargon into accessible, practical advice for tech enthusiasts and everyday readers alike.

How to Apply:

Please submit the following materials in your application:

  1. Your CV / Resume
  2. A Cover Letter addressing: Which specific topics/verticals above match your hands-on expertise, and what setups/gear (e.g., home networks, tool ecosystems, test rigs) do you currently use?
  3. 2–3 published writing samples (preferably long-form tech features, explainers, homelab guides, or hardware breakdowns).

We will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you'd make a solid addition to the team.

raw.description:
Role Title: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineers to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced inspection and measurement solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity involves evaluating and producing first-article inspection deliverables using 3D scanning and advanced metrology software, ensuring accuracy in scan-to-CAD comparisons, datum setups, and profile and position callouts. Your insight will help determine whether deviations arise from true part discrepancies or fixturing and alignment artefacts, supporting critical sign-off decisions on FAI reports.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and validate first-article inspection (FAI) reports derived from 3D scan data.
  2. Conduct detailed scan-to-CAD comparisons, analyzing measurement deviations and their sources.
  3. Set up, interpret, and document datum structures, profiles, and position callouts as per industry standards.
  4. Utilize CMM measurement techniques and perform uncertainty analysis for dimensional integrity.
  5. Differentiate between actual part deviations and artefacts caused by fixturing or alignment issues.
  6. Deliver clear, comprehensive written and verbal feedback to support decision-making on FAI sign-off.
  7. Contribute nuanced, high-quality metrology input to inform and enhance AI system development.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Expertise in Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) and FAI processes within manufacturing or quality environments.
  2. Proficiency with 3D scanning devices and inspection software (e.g., PolyWorks, GOM Inspect, or similar).
  3. Strong background in CMM measurement techniques and uncertainty analysis.
  4. Proven ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications.
  5. Experience producing or approving FAI reports backed by practical metrology knowledge.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen attention to explanatory detail.
  7. Analytical mindset for discerning true quality issues versus artefacts introduced by measurement setup.

raw.description:
Role Title: Electronics Assembly Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Electronics Assembly Quality Engineers to contribute their expertise on a customer project focused on electronics manufacturing quality and reliability. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is suited to process and quality engineering professionals with hands-on experience in reviewing X-ray images of area-array solder joints (BGA, CGA, LGA), analyzing solder defects, optimizing reflow processes, and laboratory specialists skilled in counterfeit electronic component screening. Cases span voiding, head-in-pillow, bridging, open joints, reflow profile adjustments, Class 3 acceptance, and component authenticity detection. Contributors may have strengths on either process quality or counterfeit analysis—please indicate your focus.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze and interpret X-ray images of BGA, CGA, and LGA solder joints, identifying defects such as voiding, head-in-pillow, bridging, and opens.
  2. Review and suggest improvements to reflow soldering profiles to address process-related solder defects.
  3. Provide detailed root cause analysis and recommendations for solder joint anomalies and reliability concerns.
  4. Assess real-world cases for IPC Class 3 acceptance, documenting critical observations and decision criteria.
  5. Evaluate and outline test laboratory flows for counterfeit electronic component detection and screening.
  6. Deliver comprehensive written and verbal summaries of findings, ensuring clarity and actionable guidance.
  7. Contribute technical insights that enhance AI training data quality in the field of electronics assembly and component validation.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing process or quality engineering, particularly with area-array packages.
  2. Advanced proficiency in interpreting X-ray images and diagnosing solder joint failures.
  3. Strong expertise in reflow soldering process optimization and process troubleshooting.
  4. Familiarity with IPC acceptance standards, especially Class 3 requirements for critical applications.
  5. Experience with counterfeit component detection test methodologies and laboratory practices in component authentication.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional knowledge sharing.
  7. Background as either a process engineer, quality engineer, or laboratory analyst in electronics assembly or component screening (specify your strength area).

This position offers a base hourly range of $23.72 - $43.14 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications, plus bonus based on company performance.

One of the MANY work perkz at Sheetz is quarterly employee bonuses based on company performance! And there’s more – A LOT more… like competitive salaries, PTO and parental leave, 401k match and employee stock ownership, limitless professional development and growth opportunities, tuition reimbursement, full medical, vision and dental coverage, and snack discounts!

Support the governance and compliance aspects of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program across the organization. Assist with and perform access certifications, role management, analyze user and access data, generate reports, and ensure adherence to IAM policies and standards throughout the organization’s information and technology environment. Collaborate with IAM team members and cross-functional business units to maintain secure and efficient IAM practices and processes.

1. Generate and perform routine access certifications, assisting and maintaining certification processes and flows; serve as an initial technical resource to certifiers and escalating as needed.
2. Analyze user and access data, identifying trends, risks, and anomalies; generate reports and escalate findings as needed.
3. Participate in role management processes, such as role mining, role definitions, and access control structure optimization.
4. Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to address IAM-related questions and issues in relation to department, team, or technology projects. Assist in the analysis of IAM integrations and provide senior members with supporting artifacts.
5. Assist in documenting and refining IAM policies and workflows under guidance.
6. Develop and maintain team documentation such as standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflows, diagrams, end-user training materials, and job aids for identity and access tasks to deliver consistent and scalable experiences.
7. Participate in IAM Implementation / Deployment / Documentation projects as assigned.
8. Provide evening and weekend “on call/issue” support as needed. Sheetz is open 24/7/365 and as such, our internal and external customers may require support at any time.

(Equivalent combinations of education, licenses, certifications and/or experience may be considered. Two years of experience is equivalent to one year of college/trade school)

Education

  • Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or related field is required; or Associates degree in another field of study which includes courses in computer programming, systems analysis, system development, or systems engineering is preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in Identity and Access Management or related field with exposure to IAM governance platforms, solutions, and technologies (SailPoint, Saviynt, ForgeRock, Ping Identity, Okta, Entra, etc.) required
    • Demonstrate understanding of IAM principles and core concepts such as least privileged, access control models, and lifecycle management required
    • Experience with service management and reporting tools (ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine, etc.) preferred.
    • Familiarity of compliance frameworks (NIST, ISO, CIS, PCI-DSS, etc.) preferred.

Licenses/Certifications

  • IAM, cybersecurity, governance or similar certification is preferred.

Tools & Equipment

• General Office Equipment

Sheetz is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. Sheetz is committed to considering all applicants regardless of disability who can perform all essential job duties with or without accommodations.
