raw.description:
O Grupo Boticário é líder de Beleza no Brasil. Unimos tecnologia, varejo, logística e soluções digitais (com A Mooz) para transformar dados em desejo e conectar toda a nossa cadeia de valor. Somos uma rede de talentos que impulsiona resultados exponenciais com responsabilidade, cuidado e espírito de colaboração.

Acreditamos que a beleza pode e deve inspirar mudanças.

Construa o futuro da beleza com a gente. Vamos juntos?

Temos o compromisso de construir um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e inclusivo. Essa vaga é afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

Como Product Designer III, você atuará no ecossistema de Ecommerce e Consumer, sendo referência na disciplina de design para canais digitais com foco prioritário na jornada de autoatendimento. Seu objetivo será transformar e modernizar a experiência de autoserviço e canais digitais — reduzindo o transbordo para o atendimento humano, mitigando ruídos operacionais de rastreio e integrando soluções inovadoras com assistentes virtuais de inteligência artificial—, além de dar suporte ágil e transversal a frentes correlatas do ecossistema:

  • Pesquisa e análise: Planejar, conduzir e sintetizar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas (surveys, testes de usabilidade, benchmark e entrevistas), transformando dados brutos em insights acionáveis e monitorando métricas de design e negócio;
  • Design e execução: Desenvolver soluções ponta a ponta orientadas a heurísticas, usabilidade, arquitetura de informação, WCAG (acessibilidade) e iterações guiadas por dados, aplicando refino visual e componentes de interface consistentes;
  • Inovação e inteligência artificial: Incorporar e explorar ferramentas de IA do início ao fim das iniciativas, impulsionando a evolução contínua da jornada de assistentes virtuais e autosserviço;
  • Comunicação e influência: Articular decisões de design com clareza técnica e estratégica, conectando a perspectiva da pessoa usuária aos objetivos do negócio e influenciando a priorização do roadmap;
  • Autonomia e visão sistêmica: Atuar de forma colaborativa e dinâmica em estruturas matriciais, mantendo alinhamento com áreas de logística, frete, contestação, produto e engenharia;
  • Conduzir validações contínuas, testes A/B e experimentações ágeis com postura analítica e foco em métricas de conversão e eficiência operacional;
  • Facilitar dinâmicas de ideação, cocriação e workshops multidisciplinares conectando viabilidade técnica às necessidades do negócio;
  • Garantir a conformidade e evolução contínua do Design System corporativo e os padrões de acessibilidade digital;
  • Atuar em parceria com a liderança de produto (PMs) e engenharia na definição, refinamento e priorização do backlog.
  • Sólida experiência em design de produto digital (UX/UI), atuando de ponta a ponta na construção e evolução de jornadas completas;
  • Vivência consolidada no segmento de e-commerce, produtos digitais de alta complexidade ou canais de autoatendimento/atendimento ao cliente;
  • Domínio avançado de pesquisa (quali/quanti), arquitetura de informação, prototipação e ecossistema de ferramentas de design (Figma, Miro, ferramentas de teste de usabilidade);
  • Prática no uso de ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao fluxo de trabalho e design de produto;
  • Conhecimento prático e aplicação rigorosa das diretrizes de acessibilidade digital (WCAG) e governança de Design System;
  • Capacidade analítica voltada a métricas de negócio (Data-Driven Design), com agilidade para testes A/B e iterações rápidas de produto;
  • Facilidade para construir alianças estratégicas e articular demandas com múltiplos stakeholders em ambientes dinâmicos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em jornadas de autoatendimento escaláveis, chat, chatbots ou assistentes virtuais baseados em IA;
  • Histórico de experimentação rápida e mensuração de impactos em fluxos de transbordo e conversão;
  • Pós-graduação, especialização ou certificações nas áreas de Design, Negócios, Tecnologia ou Produto.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Saúde:

  • Plano médico e odontológico flexíveis
  • Auxílio medicamentos e vale saúde para familiares
  • Sessões de psicoterapia gratuitas e telemedicina 24h
  • Programas contínuos de prevenção, cuidado mental e vacinação

Alimentação & bem-estar

  • Vale Refeição (ou restaurante local) e Vale Alimentação (com vale extra no Natal)
  • Desconto de até 40% nas marcas do nosso ecossistema
  • Gympass/TotalPass para academias e estúdios esportivos
  • Auxílio Home Office para modalidades híbrida e remota
  • Day off de aniversário para celebrar do seu jeito
  • Plano de saúde pet, vantagens em convênios e programas de viagem/hospedagem

Para sua família

  • Licença parental estendida (180 dias para mães e 120 dias para pais)
  • Suporte para Pais Atípicos e auxílio babá / educação infantil
  • Auxílio material escolar e crédito nutrição infantil
  • Orientação jurídica, psicológica e social dedicada

Seguridade para proteção e tranquilidade financeira

  • Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida
  • Apoio ao falecimento de pais e empréstimo consignado
  • Vale Transporte e Estacionamento (conforme o modelo de trabalho)

You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at


About our Team

Our Database Engineering team is focused on building and supporting secure, scalable, and highly available database platforms in a cloud-first environment. Working collaboratively with software engineering, SRE, networking, and infrastructure teams, we help modernize database environments, automate operational processes, and enable resilient cloud-native solutions.

The team combines deep database expertise with infrastructure automation and modern software development practices to support mission-critical platforms and continuously improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.


About the Role

We are seeking a Principal / Consulting DBA to provide strategic and hands-on technical leadership for mission-critical database platforms across cloud-first and hybrid environments. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, helping define database platform strategies, guide modernization initiatives, and architect resilient solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.

You will combine deep expertise in MySQL and Oracle Database with cloud architecture, automation, infrastructure engineering, and consulting skills to drive platform reliability, scalability, security, and performance across enterprise environments.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as a principal technical consultant and trusted advisor, designing, administering, optimizing, and modernizing enterprise MySQL and Oracle Database platforms.
  • Assess database environments for reliability, performance, security, operational, cost, and modernization opportunities, and define strategic improvement roadmaps.
  • Architect and implement replication, clustering, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
  • Lead migrations from traditional and on-premises database platforms to cloud-native architectures and managed database services.
  • Develop, review, and establish standards for production-quality code and automation covering provisioning, deployments, upgrades, patching, monitoring, compliance, maintenance, and operations.
  • Drive Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices using Terraform, GitHub, and GitHub Actions.
  • Establish and mature SRE practices, including SLOs, observability, incident response, blameless postmortems, reliability engineering, and automation that reduces manual operational work.
  • Lead adoption of GitHub Copilot CLI, Copilot app, and Copilot in VS Code, establishing standards for AI-assisted coding, troubleshooting, testing, review, and security.
  • Partner with engineering, SRE, security, networking, and infrastructure teams to deliver resilient and cost-effective platforms while mentoring engineers and providing technical direction through architecture reviews, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

Requirements

  • Expert knowledge of MySQL administration, replication, backup and recovery, high availability, security, and performance tuning.
  • Strong hands-on Oracle Database expertise, including RMAN, Data Guard, RAC or equivalent HA architectures, backup and recovery, tuning, security, and upgrades.
  • Proven experience designing and operating highly available, resilient, enterprise-scale database platforms and leading assessments, modernization programs, cloud migrations, or architecture consulting engagements.
  • Strong Linux administration, troubleshooting, and networking knowledge, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, firewalls, SSL/TLS, virtual networking, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to develop, test, and review production-quality code and automation using Python, Go, Java, C#, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.

Job Description Summary

Internal job title: Sr CRA

Job Description Summary
This is a field-based and remote opportunity in an assigned geography. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you. Candidates must be located near an airport (Houston, Dallas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Iowa, Nebraska are highly desirable locations).

Drive clinical trials forward where it matters most - at the site level and with patients at the center. As a Senior CRA at Novartis, you will manage trusted site relationships and perform on-site and remote monitoring activities to support the initiation, conduct, and timely completion of Phase I – IV trials in compliance with International Council for Harmonization / Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), local regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring procedures. Serving as a key point of contact for investigational sites, you will proactively manage site performance, recruitment, quality, risks, and issue resolution to ensure sustainable trial execution and high-quality data delivery. Assigned to complex trials and/or less experienced sites, you may also act as a Subject Matter Expert, support audit and inspection readiness activities, ensure timely implementation of corrective actions, and collaborate with local and global cross-functional teams to drive process improvements that help bring innovative therapies to patients faster.

The successful candidate will be required to travel by plane or car up to 80% of the time.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager.

Job Description

Key responsibilities:

  • Primary site manager and first point of contact between site staff and Novartis
  • Frontline liaison supporting collaboration, milestones, and deliverables
  • Monitor according to legislation, ICH/GCP, and Novartis standards
  • Manage assigned sites/networks conducting Phase I–IV protocols according to monitoring plans and Novartis procedures
  • Conduct site initiation visits and deliver ongoing training for site personnel
  • Continuous on-site/remote monitoring; protocol, GCP, regulatory and process compliance; data integrity and patient safety
  • Facilitate preparation and collection of site- and country-level documents
  • Identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as needed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive efficient study execution
  • Deliver timely, high-quality, robust, reliable site data supporting Trial Monitoring goals
  • Partner with SSU CRA for seamless transition of site responsibility
  • Act as a subject matter expert across study activities when required

Essential Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in site monitoring
  • BS/BA degree, Scientific, Healthcare or related field
  • Excellent knowledge of the drug development process specifically clinical trial/research
  • Knowledge of international standards (GCP/ICH, FDA, EMEA)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and manage time efficiently
  • Excellent Site management capabilities with demonstrated negotiating and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communicator and presentation skills (oral and written)
  • Fluent in both written and spoken English

Desirable Requirements:

  • RLT, CAR T or Oncology experience a plus!

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced AI/LLM Engineer (Model Fine-Tuning & Conversational AI) to join a fast-growing international technology company developing AI-powered conversational products. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on training, fine-tuning and improving self-hosted, open-weight large language models (LLMs) that power personalised AI conversations. You will work directly with model training pipelines, datasets, evaluation frameworks and GPU infrastructure to improve conversational quality, personality consistency, contextual memory and multilingual capabilities.

The position covers the full model improvement lifecycle, from identifying weaknesses and preparing training data to running experiments, measuring results and deploying improved models into production. You will collaborate closely with AI engineering, product, web development and DevOps teams to deliver measurable improvements in conversational performance and user experience. The ideal candidate has practical experience personally fine-tuning and deploying open-weight LLMs, strong Python and PyTorch skills, and a solid understanding of post-training techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA and QLoRA. This is a model engineering position rather than a prompt engineering, API integration or purely academic research role. Candidates must have direct experience working with model weights, training processes and production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Train, fine-tune and optimise existing open-weight language models to improve conversational performance.

  • Develop and maintain model post-training workflows using supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient training techniques.

  • Prepare, clean, structure and improve training datasets to enhance response accuracy, naturalness and consistency.

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure model quality and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Improve conversational memory, contextual understanding and personality consistency across extended interactions.

  • Develop and optimise multilingual conversational capabilities.

  • Enhance interactions involving multiple AI characters and complex dialogue scenarios.

  • Investigate model failures, inconsistent responses and behavioural issues.

  • Optimise training data, prompting approaches and response filtering mechanisms based on evaluation findings.

  • Conduct GPU-based model training experiments and troubleshoot performance, memory and training stability issues.

  • Apply techniques such as SFT, LoRA and QLoRA, with exposure to preference optimisation approaches such as DPO or GRPO.

  • Analyse experimental results and identify measurable improvements in model behaviour and conversational quality.

  • Deploy improved models into production environments and monitor their performance.

  • Continuously refine deployed models using evaluation data, user interaction patterns and performance insights.

  • Collaborate with AI engineers, product teams, web developers and DevOps specialists on model integration and deployment.

  • Research and evaluate relevant developments in open-weight language models and post-training methodologies.

Requirements

  • Proven hands-on experience personally fine-tuning open-weight LLMs and deploying improved models into production.

  • Strong professional programming skills in Python.

  • Practical experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face or comparable machine learning frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.

  • Familiarity with preference optimisation techniques, particularly DPO or GRPO.

  • Experience independently preparing training datasets and building model evaluation frameworks.

  • Practical experience conducting GPU-based training experiments, including debugging training issues.

  • Strong understanding of model behaviour, conversational quality and post-training optimisation.

  • Ability to investigate model weaknesses, implement improvements and demonstrate measurable results.

  • Experience taking model improvements from experimentation through to production deployment.

  • Previous experience working with consumer-facing AI applications or products.

  • Ability to work with complex conversational datasets and assess model outputs systematically.

  • Strong analytical thinking, technical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product and infrastructure teams.

  • Comfortable taking ownership of model training, evaluation and deployment tasks.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international remote environment.

  • Based in Europe and willing to work under a B2B contractor agreement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience fine-tuning models for conversational AI, AI companionship, roleplay or interactive entertainment.

  • Experience improving long-context dialogue, memory retention or personality consistency.

  • Practical experience with multilingual LLM training and evaluation.

  • Experience implementing preference-based optimisation using DPO or GRPO.

  • Familiarity with production model monitoring and iterative improvement workflows.

  • Experience optimising GPU training efficiency and troubleshooting model training infrastructure.

  • Experience with consumer generative AI products serving large user bases.

Benefits

  • Fully remote working arrangement within Europe.

  • Long-term collaboration under a B2B contractor agreement.

  • 20 working days of paid leave.

  • $100 monthly health insurance allowance.

  • Equipment budget to support your remote working setup.

  • Access to AI development tools.

  • Learning and professional development support.

  • Opportunity to work directly with self-hosted LLMs powering consumer-facing conversational AI products.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Full Stack QA Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver the product server side cpaabilities as per the requirements meeting the functional and non-functional criteria
  • Design and develop scalable test automation using Playwright/Typescript or Playwright/C#
  • Automate testing of REST APIs, microservices, and service-to-service integrations
  • Validate JSON/XML, data flows, contracts, and asynchronous/event-driven workflows
  • Validate Azure-based applications using Blob Storage, Application Insights, logs, etc.
  • Build automated functional, integration, contract, end-to-end, reliability, and API security coverage
  • Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based deployments
  • Collaborate with developers to shift quality left across unit, component, API, contract, integration, and system testing
  • Use Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, and refactoring

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in Playwright/Typescript or Playwright/C#, modern .NET
  • Strong experience with REST API and microservices testing/automation
  • Experience with Postman/Newman, HttpClient, RestSharp, or equivalent
  • Strong understanding of JSON, XML, OOP, design principles, and architectural patterns
  • Experience testing event-driven and asynchronous systems
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure Service Bus, Blob Storage, and Application Insights
  • Experience with Azure CI/CD, Docker, Git, and JIRA
  • Experience with Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants is desirable

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

raw.title: Buyer
raw.excerpt: Leidos currently has an exciting opportunity for a Buyer to join our Shared Services Procurement organization.
raw.description:
Leidos currently has an exciting opportunity for a Buyer to join our Shared Services Procurement organization. In this role, you’ll be part of a collaborative team that plays an important role in helping Leidos programs deliver solutions for some of our customers’ most critical missions.


As a Buyer, you’ll manage a diverse portfolio of procurement activities supporting programs and internal customers across the company. You’ll work directly with suppliers and cross-functional teams to source materials, equipment, and services; evaluate supplier proposals; negotiate pricing and terms; and place and administer purchase orders.


This is an excellent opportunity for a procurement professional who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, negotiating with suppliers, and taking ownership of their work. You’ll have the opportunity to expand your knowledge of government contracting and procurement while gaining exposure to a wide variety of programs, suppliers, technologies, and purchasing requirements.


Ready to take the next step in your procurement career? Join Leidos and build your expertise through challenging assignments, collaboration, and opportunities to learn and grow while supporting missions that matter.


2. Primary Responsibilities


As a Buyer, you will:


  • Manage assigned procurement requirements from receipt through purchase order award, administration, and closeout, as applicable.
  • Partner with program teams and internal customers to understand purchasing requirements, priorities, and delivery needs.
  • Develop and issue Requests for Quote (RFQs) and other supplier solicitations.
  • Identify and engage qualified suppliers and pursue competitive sourcing opportunities whenever practicable.
  • Evaluate supplier quotations and proposals for price, delivery, terms and conditions, and other business considerations.
  • Conduct price analysis and document fair and reasonable price determinations in accordance with established procedures.
  • Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, terms and conditions, and other commercial considerations with suppliers.
  • Prepare, issue, and administer purchase orders and modifications within delegated authority.
  • Monitor supplier performance and delivery commitments and proactively address issues that could affect program schedules.
  • Develop productive relationships with suppliers while serving as a trusted procurement partner to internal customers.
  • Communicate procurement status, risks, and recommended solutions to program teams and other stakeholders.
  • Identify procurement and supplier risks and collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop practical solutions.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready procurement files and documentation.
  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with Leidos policies and procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable government procurement regulations.
  • Manage multiple purchasing actions and priorities in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.
  • Apply sound business judgment and procurement experience to independently resolve moderately complex purchasing issues.
  • Collaborate with fellow procurement professionals and cross-functional partners to accomplish team and program objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes, supplier performance, cost, and customer experience.

3. Basic Qualifications


To be successful in this role, you will have:


  • Bachelor's degree with 2–4 years of prior relevant experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, contracts, or a related field; or a Master's degree with less than 2 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Practical knowledge of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or supplier management principles and practices.
  • Experience soliciting, evaluating, and/or negotiating supplier quotations or proposals.
  • Ability to analyze supplier pricing and other relevant information to support sound purchasing decisions.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and competing priorities while meeting established deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately complex assignments and exercise sound business judgment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively work with suppliers, program personnel, management, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to analyze procurement issues, identify potential risks, and develop practical solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability and willingness to learn and effectively use procurement, purchasing, and enterprise resource planning systems.
  • Ability to meet any U.S. Person requirements applicable to the position or programs supported.

4. Preferred Qualifications


It would be great if you also have:


  • Experience purchasing direct materials, equipment, components or indirect goods and services.
  • Procurement or supply chain experience within the government contracting, aerospace, defense, technology, or other regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS).
  • Experience working within a CPSR-compliant procurement environment.
  • Experience conducting price analysis and documenting fair and reasonable pricing.
  • Experience managing competitive and sole/single-source procurement actions.
  • Experience negotiating supplier pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms and conditions.
  • Familiarity with government contractor procurement documentation and audit requirements.
  • Experience supporting multiple programs, projects, or internal customers simultaneously.
  • Experience managing supplier performance and resolving delivery, quality, pricing, or contractual issues.
  • Experience with enterprise procurement or ERP systems.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and analytical skills, including experience analyzing procurement, supplier, or spend data.
  • A customer-focused approach and demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
  • An interest in continuous improvement and identifying ways to make procurement processes more efficient and effective.

Why Leidos?


At Leidos, procurement is more than placing purchase orders. Our Buyers help programs solve problems, manage supplier relationships, negotiate business solutions, and support the successful execution of important customer missions. You’ll work alongside experienced procurement professionals while building skills that can support continued growth within Procurement, Supply Chain, Subcontracts, and other areas of the organization.


Bring your curiosity, business judgment, and drive to grow—we’ll provide the opportunity to put them to work.


If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting:

November 6, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range:

Pay Range $52,000.00 - $94,000.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we help people be their best in the moments that matter. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. Our work is very meaningful, impactful, and cutting edge and we invite you to explore it. We are the Best!

Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems, public safety software, and mobile video with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of these mission critical systems for Government & Public Safety customers.


Job Description

As a Project Sales Engineer you are responsible for delivering end-to-end system solutions as a subject matter expert to customers looking to evaluate mobile video, license plate readers (LPR), and digital evidence management software. You will work closely with aligned project management and sales teams to provide successful evaluations. The driving goal of the Project Sales Engineer is to ensure evaluation delivery is provided to the customer so they are equipped to use and operate their Motorola Solutions products and solutions in the most effective and efficient way, driving sales and strong customer relationships. Your contributions in this key position ensure success with our customers in a shared mission to solve for safer.

Responsibilities:

  • Deploy necessary networking equipment on customer networks.

  • Provide customer support for deployed evaluations of installed systems

  • Create and deliver collateral including, but not limited to, training materials, how-to videos, and technical documentation.

  • Review current evaluation deployment processes and procedures to validate we are delivering world-class solutions that showcase our products and continue to further develop the program to streamline and bring forward additional value

  • Act as a conduit for feedback from customers and end-users to product management, marketing, development, and other appropriate groups.

  • Engage in opportunities with the sales team and provide technical solutions expertise to external stakeholders.

  • Ability to captivate a meeting by delivering world-class product training, demonstrations and compelling technical presentations to both C-Level and front line decision makers.

  • Proactively seek out both internal and external training opportunities to stay current on MSI products and services as well key complementary technologies, industry trends, and relevant certifications. Ultimate goal is to be able to set up and demonstrate the ecosystem of Video centric solutions (LPR, in-car, body camera, fixed video)

  • Bachelors Degree with 2+ years of experience in one of the following: Sales, Pre Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Public Safety experience

  • OR 6+ years of experience in one of the following: Sales, Pre Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Public Safety experience

  • Ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Possesses strong problem solving / troubleshooting skills with strong knowledge of IP networking architecture, protocols and security.

  • Self-motivated individual with a positive attitude that demonstrates passion and enthusiasm for technology with an aptitude for customer satisfaction.

  • Strong knowledge of or experience utilizing MSI mobile video, LPR, software, and/or radio products is highly desirable.

  • Ability to self-manage working as an individual contributor or as part of a collaborative group

Travel:

  • Up to 50% of the time in the US

Target Base Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree with 2+ years of experience in one of the following: Sales, Pre Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Public Safety experience

  • OR 6+ years of experience in one of the following: Sales, Pre Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Public Safety experience


Travel Requirements

Over 50%

None

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

raw.excerpt: This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.
raw.description:
This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis. Applicants must be located in the US or Canada.

Is your desk covered in Raspberry Pis, half-finished ESP32 builds and test prints? Do you run a 3D printer, tinker with single-board computers and keep a home lab going, and actually enjoy explaining what worked, what didn’t and why? Can you take a weekend project and turn it into a story readers can’t stop reading?

Valnet's Tech brands (XDA and How-to Geek) are looking for a Features Writer who lives at the crossroads of maker tech and computing. You’ll write first-person, hands-on features based on real projects you build, break, fix and improve.

We’re looking for a sharp, practical voice to cover these verticals:

  • Raspberry Pi & SBCs: Pi 5, Pi Zero, Pico and other single-board computers. Projects, setups, edge AI, value comparisons (SBC vs. mini PC) and community builds worth showing off.
  • Microcontrollers & DIY Electronics: Arduino, ESP32, GPIO projects, sensors and practical gadgets for the home and desk.
  • 3D Printing: Filaments (PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU and others), slicer settings, printer upgrades and monitoring, model management, and useful prints that solve real problems around the house, office and home lab.
  • Home Lab & Self-Hosting: NAS builds, TrueNAS, Proxmox, Docker, Jellyfin/Plex, and running local services on low-power hardware.
  • Mini PCs & Alternative OSes: Small-form-factor builds, Linux distros, and the odd niche OS that’s fun to explore.

Job Responsibilities

  • Contribute reliably and consistently under tight deadlines. Work includes hands-on features, project write-ups, tutorials, listicles and opinion pieces, plus timely news on Raspberry Pi and 3D printing launches.
  • Pitch original story ideas drawn from your own builds, experiments and failures.
  • Take original photos of your projects, prints and setups, and find and format images according to our guidelines.
  • Enter your work into our in-house CMS.
  • Stay current with maker, SBC, 3D printing and self-hosting news, including product releases, price changes, software updates and standout community projects.
  • Coordinate with the editorial team on assignments and feedback.

Application Requirements

  • CV
  • Cover Letter (tell us why you want to write for us, and what’s on your workbench right now!)
  • 2–3 tech articles you’ve written that best show your writing. Hands-on or project-based pieces are strongly preferred.

Applicants must have a self-starter attitude and meet the following requirements:

  • Relevant experience writing and editing in English.
  • Ownership of, and regular hands-on experience with, at least one 3D printer and one or more Raspberry Pis or other SBCs.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, the command line, and setting up and troubleshooting self-hosted services (Docker experience is a plus).
  • Comfort with slicers (e.g., Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Cura) and with diagnosing print-quality problems.
  • The ability to explain technical projects clearly and with personality, for beginners and experienced tinkerers alike.

Nice to Have

  • CAD experience (Fusion, OpenSCAD, Onshape, Tinkercad or similar) for designing your own prints.
  • Experience with Arduino, ESP32 or Pico projects, including basic wiring or soldering.
  • A home lab or NAS setup you actively maintain.
  • A background in IT, sysadmin or networking.

The hiring team will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you’d be a solid addition to the team. We only consider applications that include relevant writing samples.

raw.excerpt: About PrePassPrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform.
raw.description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

We’re seeking a BI Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team, reporting to the Manager of Business Intelligence. In this role, you’ll translate data into actionable insights that support business decision-making across the company. You’ll collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand their goals and objectives and deliver meaningful insights. This position is primarily remote, with occasional visits to our downtown Phoenix office, located directly across the street from Footprint Center.

Essential Responsibilities

Reporting & Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret data to provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Provide detailed quantitative and qualitative data analysis and reporting, applying statistical methods where appropriate.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in tolling, bypass, device, and customer data.
  • Respond to ad hoc report and data requests submitted through the BI service desk across multiple business areas.

BI Solutions & Data Quality

  • Create and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, and visualizations, including semantic model and DAX measure changes.
  • Troubleshoot report refresh failures and data issues, partnering with data engineers on root-cause fixes.
  • Validate report outputs against warehouse and source data before release to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and accessibility.
  • Document reports, metric definitions, and data lineage in Confluence.

AI-Assisted Analytics

  • Use AI-assisted workflows to translate business questions into reporting artifacts (semantic model changes, DAX, and documentation), validating outputs for accuracy and policy compliance.
  • Incorporate AI tools into routine reporting and documentation work, writing clear, specific prompts and refining them when the first output isn't quite right.
  • Begin applying simple agentic tools to single, well-defined tasks under guidance.
  • Review AI outputs for accuracy before use, ask informed questions, and seek out new AI use cases relevant to your work.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Gather and document business requirements to support reporting and analytics initiatives.
  • Proactively look for ways to improve your own workflows and reporting processes.
  • Collaborate across the BI team to reach shared goals, and mentor teammates one-on-one as opportunities arise.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience as a BI Analyst, Data Analyst, or in a similar reporting role.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and semantic models, including DAX.
  • Intermediate SQL skills (joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions) for querying, validating, and reconciling data.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests from different stakeholders and explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree (BSc/BA) in a relevant field.

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks) or a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) in analytical work, with a habit of verifying results before use.
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
  • Experience using Git for version control of BI assets.
  • Familiarity with tolling, transportation, or fleet data.
  • Exposure to Python, Alteryx, or Power Automate.
  • Exceptional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate dynamic environments and embrace change.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Strategic Partner Success Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with LifeStance’s largest patient referral sources including health systems, independent medical practices, and other behavioral health organizations in their assigned markets. The position will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Corporate and Business Development, and will work hand-in-hand with cross functional leadership to grow our referral base.


COMPENSATION: $90,000 - $120,000/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the SVP, Business Development and other business development leaders to develop a national strategy and implementation plan to increase awareness of and drive referrals toward our clinical service offerings.
  • Strategically identify, and execute on, opportunities for growth within existing referral relationships.
  • Troubleshoot barriers and challenges encountered by referral sources that inhibit a seamless patient referral process.
  • Develop and maintain trust with key stakeholders, both internal and external to LifeStance.
  • Partner with LifeStance’s marketing team on collateral development and educational materials.
  • In partnership with LifeStance’s clinical leadership, arrange educational opportunities to engage potential referral sources.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, analyzing market dynamics, and competitor activity to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Assist in maintaining a current, comprehensive, and organized customer relationship management system (CRM).
  • Proactively identify areas of underperformance (e.g., partners with declining referral volume) and take corrective action.
  • Operate with high integrity and comply with company policies and procedures.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, healthcare or a related field.

  • Experience working in the behavioral health industry is preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Proven track record of growing a book of business and successfully achieving targets.
  • Analyzing structured and unstructured data to draw actionable conclusions, prioritize time and resources, and implement process changes.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and LifeStance’s mission.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Detail oriented.
  • Cross functional collaboration.
  • Solution focused.
  • Proactive self-starter.
  • Building positive team culture.
  • Self-awareness.
  • Effective listener.
  • Ability to set realistic expectations while still meeting customer needs.
  • Open to receiving constructive feedback.
  • Navigating conflict and tradeoffs between personal targets and broader business objectives.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

raw.excerpt: As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end.
raw.description:
As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

LocationThis is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Inclusion StatementAt Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

How to apply?If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)

We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Senior Product Manager

North Hospitality - Remote



Join the hospitality experts. Imagine delivering sophisticated hospitality technology, simplified payment processing, and award-winning support to some of the top restaurants in the U.S.



North is seeking a highly detail-oriented and technically proficient Senior Product Manager to drive the execution of our product roadmap and oversee the delivery of innovative, high-impact solutions in the payments and fintech space. You will serve as the technical backbone of the product team, collaborating closely with multiple Agile engineering teams to translate strategic vision into actionable, detailed requirements and deliverables. Daily decisions include prioritization, value, timelines, risk management, and functionality for the Developer Experience Team’s product. The Product Manager is able to understand not only the business needs and value, but has an understanding of the technical and system aspects impacted by the projects and business needs.


As the Senior Product Manager, you will dig deep into technical details, coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives, and ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer value. You will be responsible for managing and optimizing workflows using Jira and other product management tools, and will play a key role in aligning internal and external stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on technical complexity, is relentless about details, can drive order out from multiple competing priorities, and is passionate about building products for developers in FinTech.



What you'll do:

  • Technical Product Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product areas, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization, with a strong emphasis on technical requirements and system integrations.
  • Deep Technical Engagement: Work closely with Agile engineering teams (internal and external) to break down complex business needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Agile Leadership: Act as Product Owner for one or more products, providing clear vision, direction, and detailed requirements. Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritization using Jira.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Gather and synthesize input from internal teams (engineering, product, leadership, sales, and support) and external partners/customers. Ensure alignment and transparency around product decisions, progress, and trade-offs.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Develop and own processes and tools to collect, analyze, and present data that informs prioritization, risk management, and release planning.
  • Release & Roadmap Management: Own and maintain a detailed product roadmap and backlog. Ensure visibility and communication of progress, risks, and changes to all stakeholders.
  • Quality & Compliance: Ensure all deliverables meet North’s Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Proactively manage escalations and communicate impact of expedited or unplanned work.
  • Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with other Product Managers and leadership to refine and improve product management best practices across North.



What we need from you:


  • Bachelor’s (BA or BS) or equivalent experience.
  • Four years previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Engineer, Product Analyst, or similar technical product roles.
  • Proven experience working with Agile software development teams.
  • Strong proficiency with Jira and modern product management software.
  • Product Owner Certification (CSPO, etc.) preferred.
  • Payments or fintech industry experience highly preferred.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and technical depth; able to dive into system architecture, APIs, and data flows.
  • Advanced knowledge of Agile methodologies and best practices; experience as a Product Owner on Scrum teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down complex business and technical problems into actionable requirements and deliverables.
  • Skilled in backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross-team coordination.
  • Strong analytical skills; able to leverage data to drive prioritization and decision-making.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-value products.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Innovative thinker who embraces change and continuous improvement.


Travel Requirements: Up to 20%

License and Certification Requirements: CSPO or similar Agile certification preferred



What we offer:


We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Education Assistance
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account


Salary Range: $115,000 to $135,000

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.



Who we are:

We are restaurateurs building products for restaurateurs. At North Hospitality, our team has years of experience working in, and for, some of the most renowned hotels and restaurants in the country. Now, we’re committed to bringing that passion to restaurateurs everywhere in the form of a single, seamless platform for all operations.


At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

raw.description:
Leidos is seeking a Junior Salesforce Health Cloud System Administrator to support the daily administration, configuration, operation, and maintenance of an enterprise Salesforce Health Cloud environment supporting the Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA).


The successful candidate will perform routine system administration activities, including user account management, access provisioning, system configuration, data maintenance, troubleshooting, and implementation of approved system changes.

The Salesforce Health Cloud environment supports healthcare contact center operations, including patient engagement, care coordination, case management, appointment scheduling, and referral management, with integrations to Amazon Connect and other enterprise healthcare systems.This position will work closely with senior Salesforce administrators, developers, cybersecurity personnel, and program operations teams to maintain a secure, reliable, and efficient Salesforce environment.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform daily Salesforce administration, including user provisioning, account updates, permission sets, role assignments, and access management.
  • Execute approved moves, adds, and changes (MACs) involving users, organizational assignments, security permissions, queues, and application configurations.
  • Configure and maintain Salesforce standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, and application settings.
  • Implement approved configuration changes using Salesforce Flow Builder, validation rules, assignment rules, and other declarative tools.
  • Create and maintain Salesforce reports, dashboards, list views, and operational reporting capabilities.
  • Perform approved data imports, updates, exports, and data quality activities using Salesforce administration tools.
  • Provide Tier 2 application support, including troubleshooting user access, configuration, workflow, and data-related issues.
  • Monitor application performance, scheduled jobs, system notifications, and integration errors using available monitoring tools.
  • Escalate complex application defects, integration failures, and issues requiring custom development to senior administrators or the Tier 3 development team.
  • Support operational integrations with Amazon Connect and other enterprise systems, including contact center workflows and associated data exchanges.
  • Assist with sandbox configuration, testing, validation, and deployment of approved system changes and application releases.
  • Maintain system documentation, configuration inventories, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Support periodic user access reviews, configuration audits, and remediation of identified security issues.
  • Ensure system administration activities comply with applicable DoD/DHA cybersecurity, privacy, access management, and change control requirements.
  • Collaborate with senior administrators, developers, cybersecurity personnel, and operational stakeholders to resolve issues and improve platform reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical field and 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with less than 2 years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in accordance with Leidos policies.
  • At least 1 year of hands-on Salesforce administration or configuration experience.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce administration concepts, including users, profiles, permission sets, roles, objects, fields, page layouts, reports, and dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce declarative configuration tools, including Flow Builder and validation rules.
  • Understanding of enterprise application support, incident management, and change management processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting application configuration, user access, and data-related issues.
  • Ability to follow established technical procedures, document configuration changes, and resolve routine to moderately complex technical issues.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaborate effectively with senior technical personnel and operational stakeholders.
  • Ability to meet applicable DoD/DHA personnel security and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator.
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder certification or equivalent configuration experience.
  • Experience administering Salesforce Health Cloud, Service Cloud, or other Salesforce enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Government Cloud Plus or Government Cloud Plus – Defense environments.
  • Experience supporting DoD, DHA, VA, or other federal healthcare programs.
  • Familiarity with healthcare operations, patient engagement, referral management, care coordination, or contact center workflows.
  • Experience using Salesforce Data Loader, Salesforce Inspector, or comparable administration tools

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
