raw.title: Product Operations Specialist
raw.excerpt: Help Build the Systems Behind NewLaw's Next Stage of GrowthDo you love figuring out how things could work better—and then making it happen?
raw.description:
Help Build the Systems Behind NewLaw's Next Stage of Growth

Do you love figuring out how things could work better—and then making it happen? Are you someone who can look at a complicated process, connect the dots between teams and technology, and turn it into something simpler, smarter, and more scalable?

At NewLaw Business Model (“NewLaw” or the “Company”), we're reimagining how lawyers build successful, fulfilling practices. We combine education, coaching, technology, and managed services to help estate planning lawyers grow thriving businesses while creating better experiences for the families they serve.

And we're growing.

We're investing in our Operations team to build the systems, processes, and infrastructure needed to support that growth. That's where you come in: We're looking for a Senior Product Operations Specialist who brings together technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a love of solving complex business problems.

This isn't a traditional project coordination or product administration role. You will serve as an internal operational consultant and business systems architect, have a meaningful voice in product development, lead cross-functional initiatives, and design and govern the operational systems that deliver our products.

If you love both the thinking and the doing, this might be your kind of role.

The Opportunity

You'll work across two distinct product suites:

  • Memberships: Digital education, coaching, community, and resources that help lawyers build successful estate planning practices.

  • Advanced Growth (Managed) Services (AGS): B2B services, technology, and specialized support that help law firm owners get big law support without the big law lifestyle.

As a key partner to our product teams, you'll help turn product ideas into exceptional experiences—evaluating operational feasibility, determining the optimal technical workflows, and establishing scalable operating procedures.

You'll also join an Operations function that's evolving. You'll have meaningful opportunities to formulate operational strategy, contribute to new product technology, and establish enterprise operating standards and policies that support our next stage of growth.

You'll have the autonomy to exercise independent judgment, evaluate operational challenges, formulate solutions, commit project resources, and establish processes that have a direct impact on our members and internal teams.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Shape Product Technology & Development

  • Advise product leadership on operational strategy and system feasibility to guide product design and roadmap decisions.

  • Improve internal and member-facing tools by establishing operating standards and designing workflow frameworks that optimize business efficiency.

  • Identify and evaluate emerging AI and automation solutions, determining business case viability and formulating implementation strategies.

Build the Systems Behind Our Products

  • Establish the operational architecture, launch specifications, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) needed to successfully launch new products and features.

  • Design and govern cross-departmental data flows and platform integrations across product administration, member access, internal teams, and the member experience.

  • Analyze operational friction points, evaluate alternative solutions, and implement systemic structural changes to improve reliability and scalability.

Turn Data Into Better Decisions

  • Design core business performance metrics and executive reporting frameworks to evaluate product activation, usage, engagement, and operational health.

  • Connect member feedback and operational data across Product, Sales, Coaching, and Member Care.

  • Synthesize business intelligence to advise senior leadership on operational trends and provide actionable strategic recommendations.

Lead Meaningful Projects

  • Exercise independent discretion to lead high-impact, cross-functional business initiatives from conception through implementation, launch, and optimization.

  • Drive accountability and results by determining project priorities, allocating operational resources, and resolving cross-departmental roadblocks.

  • Ensure successful adoption through authoring comprehensive operational documentation, designing training programs, and managing organizational change.

Make Operations Easier & More Scalable

  • Establish governance policies and architectural standards across HubSpot, Docebo, and connected enterprise systems to optimize administration.

  • Formulate sustainable operational policies and oversee administrative workflows to eliminate redundancy.

  • Solve problems at the source, evaluating systemic root causes and designing long-term operational policies rather than temporary fixes.

What “Success” Looks Like

  • Strengthen Product Operations: Establish consistent systems and processes across Memberships and AGS.

  • Improve the member experience: Use data, feedback and technology to make products easier to navigate and engage with.

  • Connect and automate systems: Improve how HubSpot, our LMS and other tools support purchases, access, reporting and product administration.

  • Scale new offerings: Build systems that support increasingly sophisticated products and service packages.

  • Explore AI-enabled solutions: Help develop smarter internal workflows and member-facing experiences.

Who You Are

You're an experienced operator who enjoys solving complex problems, building better systems and bringing people together to make meaningful improvements. You can think strategically about what needs to change—and you're comfortable rolling up your sleeves to make it happen.

You Bring:

  • Experience in Product Operations, Business Systems, Technical Operations, or a comparable operational advisory or systems architecture role.

  • Strong technical skills with CRM platforms, workflow automation, and connected business systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in designing system workflows, establishing integration standards, and resolving complex operational breakdowns.

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects with full ownership over project scope, timelines, and deliverables.

  • Strong systems thinking, analytical skills, and experience using data to drive strategic business improvements.

  • Ability to collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and functional leaders to turn business needs into working solutions.

  • Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Docebo, Asana, Zapier, or Make.

  • A background in SaaS, digital education, memberships, or managed services.

  • Experience evaluating and executing platform migrations, complex product structures, or third-party integrations.

  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, or AI-enabled workflows.

You thrive at the intersection of business strategy and technology, with a track record of translating high-level business requirements into robust, scalable operational architectures.

You'll Thrive Here If...

  • You love turning complex problems into simple, scalable solutions.

  • You enjoy leading projects and taking ownership of outcomes.

  • You think strategically but aren't afraid to get technical.

  • You're curious about AI, automation, and emerging technology.

  • You thrive in evolving environments where there's room to build something new.

  • You care about people as much as processes and technology.

Why NewLaw?

  • Meaningful work. Help transform the legal industry and create better experiences for families.

  • Real impact. Influence how our products, systems and Operations team evolve.

  • A seat at the table. Collaborate with Product Management and leadership on meaningful decisions.

  • Innovation with purpose. Explore AI, automation and technology that empower our teams and members.

  • People-first culture. Join a passionate, collaborative team committed to growth.

  • Room to grow. Expand your expertise and explore new opportunities as our company scales.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt (W2)

  • Annual Base Wage: Pay Range: $82,000-$95,000/ annually

    • Starting base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable experience, relevant skills, market data, and internal equity.

    • Bonus Eligibility: This position is eligible for company-wide and individual performance-based discretionary bonuses.

This is a 100% remote position open to qualified candidates authorized to work and residing anywhere in the continental United States, with the exception of California. NewLaw Business Model is not currently hiring or registered to employ individuals in the State of California for this position.

Benefits

  • 100% Remote Work at a Profitable, Growing Company

  • Recession-Proof Industry, Product, and Audience

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • 401K Retirement Program w/Discretionary Company Match

  • Flexible Paid Time Off*

  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Leadership Development

  • Be Part of a Mission-Driven Company Transforming the Legal Industry

    *Flexible PTO allows team members to self-manage time off for vacation, personal needs, and cultural or religious holidays of choice, and includes applicable statutory paid sick leave in accordance with state and local laws.

Interested? Let's Talk.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to maintain existing systems, but wants to help build what comes next. If you're excited about solving problems, leading meaningful projects, and creating systems that make products and people more successful, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a 100% remote position. Team members are expected to maintain a dedicated workspace with reliable high-speed internet and hardware capable of running modern SaaS and automation workflows (minimum 16GB RAM). NewLaw provides all required software licenses, security access, and a monthly home office/technology allowance to assist with remote workspace and internet expenses.

New Law Business Model (NLBM) respects your time and work. Any portfolio materials, technical breakdowns, or operational insights submitted during this application process are requested solely for the purpose of assessing your qualifications for this position. NLBM will not use, publish, or commercially exploit any material submitted during your application process without your express written consent. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that any skills assessments do not create an employment relationship or a contract for services.

NLBM provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state laws. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interviewing process, please contact us at .

New Law Business Model is an equal opportunity organization. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. All qualified practitioners are encouraged to apply.

Highlights

Drive seamless product delivery across NewLaw's memberships and managed services by optimizing systems, automating workflows, improving member access and supporting successful product launches.

raw.excerpt: About PrePassPrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform.
raw.description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

PrePass is seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Public Sector to lead an enterprise-wide strategy connecting government needs, transportation policy, funding, research, pilots and procurement opportunities with PrePass capabilities.

This role connects Public Sector and Product, owns the consolidated public-sector roadmap and prioritization process, represents public-sector customers across Product, and positions PrePass to engage before programs and requirements are fully defined.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Public-Sector Product Strategy

  • Integrate opportunities across Safety, Innovation, Site Systems, 360SmartView, Compliance and Bypass into a unified public-sector roadmap.
  • Translate agency needs, policy changes and funding priorities into product implications, opportunity hypotheses and recommendations.
  • Evaluate opportunities based on customer value, strategic fit, roadmap alignment, funding potential, product readiness and organizational capacity.
  • Develop leadership decision materials that clarify value, tradeoffs, dependencies and the recommended path, then drive agreed product outcomes.

Deliver Public-Sector Product Outcomes

  • Translate contract commitments, RFP responses, grant deliverables and regulatory mandates into clear requirements for value-stream Product Managers.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Product Operations to prioritize commitments and deliver them on schedule.
  • Provide product expertise for RFP responses, state onboarding and renewals.
  • Define and report outcomes, including agency adoption, data quality, safety impact and contribution to renewals and new states.

Co-Lead Grants, Pilots and Upstream Development

  • Monitor and evaluate federal and state grants, research opportunities, demonstrations and pilot funding cycles.
  • Participate in coalitions with agencies, state DOTs, enforcement organizations, University Transportation Centers, research institutions, carriers and technology partners.
  • Identify collaborations and PoC requirements early so opportunities address public-sector needs and align with PrePass investments and capabilities.

Policy, Regulatory and Market Intelligence

  • Partner internally to assess legislation, rulemakings, standards and government initiatives affecting commercial vehicle safety and compliance, and communicate roadmap implications early.
  • Coordinate product input into RFIs, RFPs, public comments, research initiatives, standards discussions and related government opportunities.

Represent PrePass as a Public-Sector Thought Leader

  • Represent PrePass in relevant forums, including FMCSA, FHWA, CVSA, state DOTs, University Transportation Centers, IRP and IFTA committees, ITS America initiatives and autonomous vehicle task forces.
  • Build trusted relationships with leaders who influence transportation policy, funding, research, procurement and implementation.

What Success Looks Like

  • PrePass maintains a clear, current and actionable public-sector strategy and consolidated roadmap.
  • Public-sector opportunities are identified and shaped before grant, pilot and procurement requirements are finalized.
  • Product teams receive timely insight that improves planning and aligns funded pursuits with PrePass capabilities and investments, including voice of the customer.
  • Public-sector stakeholders increasingly engage PrePass as a trusted strategic, technical and commercialization partner.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in transportation product management, public-sector program development, transportation technology, innovation or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated success translating public-sector transportation needs into technology, product, pilot or program strategies.
  • Expertise in federal and state transportation funding, including identifying opportunities, shaping concepts, coordinating partners, developing scopes and leading proposals.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams to translate public-sector needs into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
  • Established relationships across the public-sector transportation ecosystem, such as federal agencies, state DOTs, enforcement organizations, CVSA, University Transportation Centers, task forces, advisory councils or industry associations.
  • Ability to travel regularly up to 30% for agency meetings, conferences, task forces, partner development and industry engagements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Public Policy, Transportation, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience, is a plus.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

  • Supporting digital transformation and continuous improvement by aligning commercial processes, customer-data requirements and technology capabilities, while maintaining data quality, customer hierarchies, attributes and system controls that enable accurate customer-program and incentive payments.

If you have...

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business or a related field.
  • At least eight years of progressive experience in commercial systems, business processes and data analytics, including demonstrated leadership of cross-functional initiatives.

Create your own chemistry with you@BASF

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

As a Senior Director, Brand Strategist, you will be a key driver to the brand strategy of your account. You’ll develop a keen understanding of your client’s business requirements and generate insights that create the foundation for brand strategy. As a critical thinker, you will work collaboratively within the strategy team as well as with the account, creative, and scientific teams to facilitate strategic recommendations that lead to significant brand results.

What you'll do:

    ACCESS MARKETING STRATEGY – CLIENTS

  • Direct, develop, and execute comprehensive access strategy to support pipeline and inline assets in maximizing and communicating brand value, and in doing so, establish and reinforce client confidence in our strategic value
  • Conduct and support the analysis of qualitative and quantitative research relating to market access stakeholders and derive meaningful insights
  • Analyze market research, market landscape, and analytics reports as well as track relevant market access congresses/media to identify key audience insights, behaviors and trends that provide critical access engagement opportunities
  • Conduct and support the development of market access stakeholder personas/archetypes, strategy maps, integration into brand plans, positioning, brand identity strategy, creative briefs, and messaging strategy among other critical strategic elements
  • Conduct and support the ideation and execution of access marketing solutions, tactics, and activations that amplify brand/access performance
  • Design and facilitate workshops, training meetings, launch meetings, and other key events on behalf of Access Marketing clients
  • Provide a advanced strategic voice in internal and client meetings, including consistent and visible advisement to clients on emerging access-related trends
  • Leads strategic planning responsibilities on multiple brands and integrated accounts with advanced autonomy and proficiency
  • Contributes to the development of actionable project briefs through translation of insights and strategy execution in partnership with team
    • ACCESS MARKETING STRATEGY – NEW BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND GROWTH AND THOUGHT LEADERSHIP
  • Contribute to the growth of the Access Marketing offer by helping to define the strategy for RFPs/capabilities and identify organic growth within businesses managed, and, proactively sourcing new business development opportunities as appropriate
    • ACCESSMARKETING STRATEGY – THOUGHT LEADERSHIP
  • Support SVP, Access Strategy in market access thought leadership activities by:
  • Staying ahead and informed of the leading market access platforms, trends, and innovations for market access customers, including but not limited to payers, health systems, employers, and others
  • Keeping pulse on key access trends, drafting expert pieces/POVs, contributing to podcasts/webinars, and leveraging thought leadership into attracting new Access Marketing clients
    • STRATEGY – INTEGRATION, PARTNERSHIPS, AND TEAM DEVELOPMENT
  • Integrate seamlessly and maintain fluency between Advisory and Marketing disciplines within a matrixed organization, including establishing a productive, coordinated, and seamless partnership with other strategy counterparts
  • Lead collaboratively with account, medical, and creative partners on the delivery of Access Marketing strategy, including ensuring that access strategy aligns to broader business objectives and audience needs
  • Build and grow an external network of strategic partners for collaboration and consultation as needed
  • Supervise direct reports (if applicable) including managing performance and progressive growth
  • Mentor, coach, and counsel strategy team members to facilitate their growth and development
  • Be flexible with travel up to 20-30% of time as needed

About you:

    Personal Attributes
  • Loves a challenge, especially as the Access Marketing team is in a building phase; relentlessly pursues excellence; little fear of adversity and headwinds; self-starter mentality that takes direction but doesn’t wait for it; challenges current practices and standards; open to different ways of thinking/creating; innovative; embraces change; curious; enjoys learning with an appetite for curiosity
    • Education and Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree preferred (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MPH, etc.)
  • 7-10 years in market access strategy or related experience (e.g., payer, health system, pharma direct, etc.), with 3-5 years in agency required
  • Management experience a plus
    • Market Access/Access Strategy Qualifications
  • Market access agency and/or industry experience required
  • Advanced understanding of market access marketing, strategies, and trends
  • Advanced working knowledge in market access-related research tools, agency offerings, services, products, and solutions
  • Proven success building and launching market access strategies and tactical plans that leverage market research, customer insights, clinical data, and market trends and dynamics
  • Seamless ability to translate Advisory subject matter expertise into Marketing brand/access strategy
  • Proficient at persuasive storytelling and paving the path from compelling strategy to brilliant creative
  • Highly skilled as an interdisciplinary thinker, strategic problem-solver, and focused business leader
  • Curious strategist who keeps abreast of everchanging healthcare landscape and encourages clients to challenge the status quo
  • Crisp and persuasive communications skills, both written and verbal
  • Comfortable with public speaking and demonstrates strong presentation skills
  • Ability to use AI platforms to enhance, but not replace, brand strategic needs
  • Competent in software specific to client/agency processes, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
    • Work Style
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and cross-discipline environment as a working strategy team member with a proactive mindset
  • Ability to inspire collaboration and lead conversations across multiple stakeholders (both internal and external)
  • Creative and constructive problem solver who can work both independently and within a team environment
  • Good listener who can quickly interpret data, ask thoughtful questions, and provide a strategic point-of-view
  • Quick learner with a natural drive and curiosity for continual learning
  • Comfortable leading and working under pressure with tight deadlines, across both inline client work and pipeline new business development work
  • Proven track record in inspiring teams as well as upholding the organization’s culture with integrity
  • Exceptional and reliable organizational skills

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

Job Overview

The Principal Stat Programmer plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of statistical programming across various clinical projects. This position demands proficiency in SAS programming and familiarity with CDISC standards, particularly ADaM and SDTM models. Key responsibilities include developing and validating complex data sets and outputs, collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize processes, and providing technical guidance on statistical methodologies and programming best practices. The role also involves mentoring junior programmers and contributing to the continuous improvement of programming workflows and standards, supporting the overall quality deliverables of the statistical programming department.

  • Develops and validates complex datasets and outputs using SAS programming, ensuring compliance with CDISC standards such as ADaM and SDTM models.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to optimize statistical programming processes and enhance overall efficiency and accuracy.
  • Provides technical guidance and expertise on statistical methodologies to support clinical trial projects and departments.
  • Mentors and guides junior programmers, fostering their growth and development.
  • Contributes to the continuous improvement of programming workflows and departmental standards.
  • Ensures high-quality deliverables from the statistical programming department by adhering to best practices and established protocols.
  • Leads initiatives to enhance programming tools and techniques, driving innovation in statistical programming.
  • Partners with leadership to align programming objectives with larger organizational goals.

  • Bachelor's Degree Statistics, Computer Science or related field Req
  • Master's Degree Statistics or Computer Science Pref
  • Ability to lead/manage others Capably leads and manages programming teams, ensuring adherence to standards and mentoring junior programmers.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidential information Maintains strict confidentiality of sensitive project data and internal communications
  • Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills Exercises sound judgment and decision-making in selecting statistical methods and programming techniques.
  • Ability to work within tight timeframes and meet strict deadlines Effectively manages time and resources to deliver high-quality programming outputs within tight deadlines.
  • Project Demonstrated project management skills Executes projects efficiently, demonstrating strong project management skills to coordinate tasks and resources effectively.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude Demonstrates robust technical aptitude with a deep understanding of SAS programming and CDISC standards.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret financial data Analyses and interprets financial data accurately to make informed decisions in statistical programming.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills Utilizes strong analytical skills to assess statistical programming requirements and ensure data integrity.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills Applies effective problem-solving skills to overcome programming challenges and optimize workflows.
  • Excellent interpretation of complex statistical data Interprets complex statistical data with proficiency, ensuring accurate construction and validation of clinical datasets.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills Exhibits strong written communication skills to document programming methodologies and procedures clearly
  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills Communicates effectively with cross-functional teams to facilitate collaboration and improve statistical programming processes
  • Instills commitment to organizational goals Inspires and motivates programming teams to align their work with organizational goals and quality standards.

  • Analyzes and reconciles complex financial data across multiple systems, organizations, and transaction sources in support of audit readiness.
  • Facilitates discovery sessions and working groups to understand business processes, identify control gaps, and define reconciliation requirements between data systems.

  • Experience analyzing and reconciling complex financial data across multiple systems and transaction sources in support of audit readiness
  • Experience aligning operational transactions with GL balances and financial reporting
  • Experience facilitating discovery sessions or working groups with accountants, financial managers, business process owners, and system users

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

raw.description:
We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

CM.com is building its go-to-market engine in the US, and we are looking for a marketer to help design it and run it. As Marketing Manager, you will work side by side with our US Partner Sales Managers and our AI Technical Solutions Consultant to turn our platform into pipeline through two motions: channel partnerships and brand-direct campaigns built around industry solutions.

This is a builder role for an early-career marketer ready to take on real scope. You will have a seat at the table, a US sales team that wants to collaborate with you, and the mandate to use AI to do the work of a much larger team. You will move between strategy and execution, across every pillar of marketing, and see your work show up in pipeline. This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the Eastern Time Zone.

You will

  • Help architect the US go-to-market plan: Shape our strategy across the channel partner and brand-direct motions, with clear priorities, targets and a regular rhythm of measuring what works and adjusting.

  • Co-market with our channel partners: Work with the Partner Sales Managers to build partner-ready programs: joint value propositions, co-branded campaigns, onboarding and enablement kits, partner webinars and events, and co-marketing funds.

  • Own industry solutions marketing: Turn our platform into vertical stories for the industries we prioritize with Sales: messaging, use cases, case studies, landing pages and campaigns that speak to a specific buyer.

  • Run full-funnel demand generation: Plan, launch and optimize campaigns across paid, email, social, SEO, web and events, from first touch to sales-qualified pipeline, including follow-up on events and trade shows.

  • Turn expertise into content: Partner with our AI Technical Solutions Consultant to translate demos, use cases and technical know-how into solution briefs, thought leadership, webinars and sales materials.

  • Build the AI-powered marketing engine: Design and run AI-enabled workflows for research, content production, personalization, lead qualification and reporting. Document what works and share it with the team and global marketing.

  • Measure what matters: Track pipeline, partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, and conversion across the funnel, and keep a tight feedback loop with Sales on lead quality.

  • Be the US voice in global marketing: Adapt global brand and content for the US market and bring back insight on customers, partners, competitors and market trends.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You know our portfolio, partners and buyers. You have shipped a first partner co-marketing campaign and a priority industry one-pager, set a baseline for funnel metrics, and proposed the US go-to-market plan.

  • By 6 months: A repeatable partner co-marketing playbook and at least one industry solution campaign are live and generating measurable pipeline, with AI workflows noticeably speeding up how the team produces and reports.

  • By 12 months: The go-to-market engine contributes measurable partner-sourced and brand-direct pipeline, and you are ready to take on more scope as the US business grows.

Requirements

  • About 3 years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in tech, SaaS or communications. Strong internships or early roles count. A degree in marketing, business, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A broad marketing foundation across campaigns, content, email, web and SEO, events and analytics. You may be strongest in one area, and you are curious and willing to learn the others.

  • Strong writing and structured thinking. You can turn a technical conversation into a clear message for a specific buyer.

  • A collaborative mindset. You enjoy working with sales and technical colleagues, and you are comfortable working with external partners.

  • An AI-native way of working. You already use AI in your daily work and can show us examples of workflows, prompts or automations you have built.

  • Ownership and initiative. You have experience working independently in a hybrid or remote setting, prioritize well and follow through.

  • Based in the Eastern Time Zone, ideally in or near Detroit, Michigan.

  • Comfort with data and tools, such as a CRM like Salesforce, marketing automation and web analytics.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, our internal company language.

  • Nice to have: exposure to partner or channel marketing, event experience, or familiarity with messaging, customer experience or conversational AI.

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-day Global Onboarding program at our Headquarters in Breda, the Netherlands, for a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

  • Work remotely: This is a fully remote role, so you can work independently from where you are in the Eastern Time Zone.

  • Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Your development: Work directly with US leadership, partner sales, and our AI solutions team, with a clear path to broader scope as the US business scales.

  • Culture: A collaborative and inclusive company culture that values diversity and creativity.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We move fast and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the US.

Highlights

Early in your marketing career but ready for real scope? Join CM.com’s US team, work fully remote in Eastern Time, and turn our AI-powered platform into pipeline.

🏠 Remote

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-moving global fashion distribution company that buys large lots of brand inventory and sells through its own DTC site, multiple marketplace channels, and a wholesale sales team. With a broad brand portfolio and a multi-channel sales operation, accuracy in pricing, product data, and images has a direct impact on revenue.

About the Role

We're looking for an E-Commerce and Wholesale Operations Specialist (AI-Forward) to be the operations backbone of the business. You'll centralize and manage product data, keep listings live and accurate, build wholesale offer sheets, support daily sales operations, and over time help build the CRM and automation infrastructure that ties it all together.

This is one role covering five connected areas: product management, e-commerce, wholesale, sales operations, and CRM and automation. The listing, wholesale, and sales admin work starts from day one, while the CRM and automation work develops as you build trust and context. We need someone highly competent, proactive, and detail-obsessed who is genuinely skilled with AI tools and takes ownership of a wide scope without needing tasks delegated one by one.

Responsibilities

  • Centralize product data, images, inventory, and pricing from vendor files and the ERP into one accurate system, managing variants, UPCs, size breakdowns, and pricing in spreadsheets
  • Source accurate product images and MSRPs from trusted sources, and edit and clean up images using AI tools
  • Keep inventory in sync as it flows from the ERP through Shopify to each channel
  • Create and maintain Shopify and marketplace listings, keeping them current, accurate, and consistent across all active channels
  • Build and update wholesale offer sheets with images, pricing, quantities, and size breakdowns, tailored to specific customers
  • Pull cost pricing from the ERP and calculate pricing within target and minimum margin parameters
  • Support daily sales administration, including pipeline updates, reporting, and coordination between departments
  • Track sales rep activity across the ERP, the sales order management platform, and email, maintaining an accurate CRM or activity dashboard
  • Run and improve the AI workflow that turns daily recaps into a morning sales meeting template
  • Over time, help build and maintain CRM infrastructure and reporting dashboards across e-commerce and wholesale
  • Identify and automate repetitive workflows to reduce manual work and errors

What We're Looking For

  • Highly competent and reliable, with a track record of ownership and accuracy on pricing, data, and product information
  • Proactive by nature, spotting what needs doing without waiting for tasks to be delegated
  • Strong systems thinker who can build and improve operational processes
  • Genuinely skilled with AI tools, including building internal AI workflows and automations, working with APIs, and using AI for image editing and data work
  • Fast and accurate in Google Sheets or Excel with advanced spreadsheet skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English for daily communication with a US-based team, primarily over WhatsApp and video calls
  • Comfortable building rapport with an in-office team through daily calls and regular check-ins in a remote setup
  • Based in Latin America

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Shopify, an ERP system, or marketplace platforms
  • Experience building dashboards or lightweight CRMs
  • Prior experience supporting a sales team with administrative and data management work
  • Interest in fashion, streetwear, or sneakers

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Pacific Time

Compensation & Time Off

  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your operations and AI tools experience, and walking through one workflow or automation you built or improved and how it saved time or reduced errors

Only candidates based in Latin America who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

raw.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant (Parexel Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday, with a preference of working from 11:30 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday - Friday.

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to assist in various stages, including the screening and assessment of applications. These tools support our evaluation of candidates based on role relevant qualifications, skills and experience. All decisions are made by our hiring team and stakeholders.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

Job Summary:

The Business Development Representative (BDR) Lead is responsible for overseeing the BDR team, driving lead generation efforts, and ensuring the successful qualification of leads. This role involves developing and implementing strategies to identify and engage potential clients, nurturing leads, and collaborating with the sales team to achieve revenue targets. The BDR Lead will also mentor and guide the BDR team to enhance their performance and achieve individual and team goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Generation:
    • Develop and execute lead generation strategies to identify potential clients through various channels, including cold calls, emails, social media, and networking.
    • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities.
    • Take the lead in prospecting high-quality leads and optimizing outreach strategies to drive sales growth.
  2. Team Management:
    • Supervise and mentor the BDR team, providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and performance.
    • Set clear performance goals and metrics for the BDR team and regularly review their progress.
  3. Lead Qualification:
    • Qualify leads from marketing campaigns as sales opportunities.
    • Conduct initial outreach to potential clients to understand their needs and assess their fit for the company's products or services.
  4. Collaboration:
    • Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handoff of qualified leads and provide support throughout the sales process.
    • Collaborate with the marketing team to align lead generation efforts with marketing campaigns and initiatives.
  5. Reporting and Analysis:
    • Track and analyze key performance metrics, such as lead conversion rates, sales pipeline growth, and revenue generated from leads.
    • Prepare regular reports on BDR team performance and lead generation activities for senior management.
  6. Continuous Improvement:
    • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and new technologies to continuously improve lead generation strategies.
    • Implement feedback and insights from the sales and marketing teams to refine lead qualification processes.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Business Development Representative or similar role, with a track record of achieving sales quotas and generating leads.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide a team.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with potential clients and internal teams.
  • Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., HubSpot) and other sales tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in using LinkedIn SalesNavigator and other outreach tools.
  • Experience in the industry relevant to the company's products or services.
  • Familiarity with sales performance metrics and reporting tools.
  • Ability to deliver engaging presentations and pitches to potential clients.
  • Experience using Apollo for lead generation and sales processes.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

The Supplier Quality Engineer will drive quality for assigned suppliers, including quality plan implementation, & selecting suppliers through qualification processes. They will own supplier results, drive improvements utilizing supplier scorecards. Own supplier audits, ensuring compliance, and driving improvement plans where needed. Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Supplier Quality Assurance and Supplier Quality Development
  • Lead supplier qualifications, action plans, audits, performance monitoring, and assisting key suppliers towards industrial standards of excellence
  • Track metrics & works quality improvement plans to address problem areas
  • Review and approve quality plans, investigate quality escapes to provide root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective actions are taken
  • Mentor suppliers in the application of quality tools & requirements
  • Ensure compliance, and drive improvement plans where needed
  • Review documentation and witness supplier practices to determine if sound
  • Ensuring manufacturing and inspection principles are in place.
  • Travel required up to 30-40%.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing)
  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing

Desired Characteristics

  • Working knowledge of investment casting product or process engineering
  • Experience with part drawings and Geometrical Dimensioning and Tolerancing
  • Basic understanding of Quality Management System (policies, procedures, and support tools / systems)
  • Solid understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
  • Lean Six Sigma trained
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and support multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams
  • Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
  • Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
  • Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

JOB SUMMARY
Leads Quantitative Office (QO) program execution, operating discipline, and delivery transparency across model development, control partner engagement, and strategic management initiatives. Partners with model development leaders, business line partners and stakeholders, finance, and risk functions to translate priorities into executable plans, clarifying capacity tradeoffs, key milestones, risks and opportunities, and producing executive-ready reporting and decision materials. Drives consistent standards, governance routines, and operating practices that improve decision speed, practitioner throughput, and progress against strategic initiatives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.


1. Plans and coordinates closely with functional QO managers and stakeholders. Ensures projects and initiatives are developed with consideration for budgeting, planning, and reporting.

2. Works closely with model development leaders, technology partners, finance, risk/control partners, and other subject matter experts to clarify requirements, dependencies, capacity constraints, and decision points to support program needs and deliver program outcomes.

3. Maintains program delivery visibility through dashboards, executive updates, and portfolio health reporting that clearly communicate progress, risks, issues, tradeoffs, and required actions.

4. Establishes and maintains operating standards for program planning, status reporting, issue escalation, governance materials, and executive communications in alignment with company and unit requirements.

5. Identifies risks to delivery, quality, capacity, and governance requirements, develops mitigation plans, and escalates decisions and tradeoffs when leadership action is required.

6. Coordinates exams, audits, risk oversight reviews, and issue remediation to support timely, accurate, and well-organized responses.

7. Leads cross-functional workstreams and working groups to drive execution against model delivery, strategic expansion, and operating improvement goals.

8. Supports Quantitative Office financial discipline, resource planning, hiring coordination, enterprise program requirements, and other business management routines.

3. Strong skills and experience in issue resolution, influencing stakeholders, driving decisions, managing ambiguity, and delivering under stringent timelines.

4. Demonstrated superior understanding of business operations, model development or analytics functions, governance expectations, and enterprise policies.

5. Demonstrated leadership in the implementation of complex programs and projects.

6. Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous assignments.

7. Demonstrated executive level verbal and written communication skills, including concise write-ups, decision materials, dashboards, and PowerPoint presentations.

8. Working knowledge of business matters, finance, planning, forecasting, capacity management, and portfolio reporting.

9. Strong skills in MS Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Visio, Project)


Preferred Qualifications:

1. Advanced degree in a relevant field of work (e.g., MBA), PMP and/or PgMP.

2. Certification in Lean Six Sigma or similar process improvement, facilitation and project management methodologies.

3. Experience supporting model development, quantitative analytics, risk management, regulatory remediation, and audit/exam management.

4. Experience designing operating models, intake/prioritization processes, executive reporting routines, and governance forums for complex initiatives.

6. Financial Services experience, preferably quantitative analytics, model development, model risk management, or related control environments.

Sobre a GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH é uma plataforma detecnologia e serviços especializados para o mercado de crédito. Unimos tecnologia de ponta à inteligência regulatória e operacional para estruturar produtos de financiamento e operações de securitização. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e nosso combustível diário é descomplicar o mercado de crédito: transformamos regras complexas em soluções fluidas que simplesmente funcionam.

Aqui, você vai entender na prática a engrenagem que move o mercado de capitais e de financiamento, desde formalização de CCBs e arranjos com correspondentes bancários até a estrutura de securitização e FIDCs.

Através de nossas unidades de negócio desenvolvemos soluções que operam de forma integrada e escalável. Por meio de APIs robustas, plataformas proprietárias e estrutura operacional especializada, conectamos originadores de crédito, investidores e esteiras completas de originação com precisão. Cada parceiro tem desafios e dinâmicas próprias, e nossa missão é arquitetar e sustentar a infraestrutura tecnológica exata para cada um deles.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem tem BRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDs apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos com tecnologia inteligente. Atuamos com uma mentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH, mérito e entrega real andam juntos. Quem gera impacto e fortalece o time será sempre recompensado. Nossas lideranças e time sênior são formadas majoritariamente por profissionais que começaram como estagiários ou em cargos júnior. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos buscam futuros parceiros e sócios para a empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores [nossa base]

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.

Isso é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Evolução contínua:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos a inquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Venha construir o futuro da infraestrutura de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga

Você vai sustentar os três sistemas que rodam a nossa operação todos os dias: GTPayroll, GTFgts e a Central de Operações. É o posto de quem entra no código que não escreveu, descobre por que uma operação de crédito parou e corrige na origem. Quando uma integração com órgão público degrada, é você quem vê primeiro. Se você é do tipo que não sossega enquanto não encontra a causa raiz, e gosta de ser a pessoa que destrava o cliente, essa vaga é para você.


O desafio

Você vai nos ajudar a:

  • Resolver o que o primeiro nível não conclui, investigando logs, banco e histórico da operação até reconstituir o que aconteceu de verdade.
  • Corrigir na origem, com teste automatizado cobrindo o caso que gerou o chamado, em vez de repetir o contorno conhecido.
  • Enxergar antes do cliente, monitorando a saúde das APIs e das integrações externas e tratando fila travada, mensagem em dead letter e job que falhou.
  • Devolver resposta em linguagem humana para Atendimento e Operação, para que eles consigam falar com o cliente sem intermediário.
  • Transformar diagnóstico em conhecimento, documentando o recorrente até o primeiro nível passar a resolver sozinho.
  • Reduzir o próprio sobreaviso, tratando todo acionamento que se repete como defeito a corrigir e não como rotina a aceitar.

Quem buscamos

  • Capacidade de entrar em um código Java com Spring que você não escreveu, localizar a causa do defeito e corrigi-la sem quebrar o resto.
  • Investigação em produção: leitura de log, rastreamento de requisição e reconstituição de histórico a partir de dados.
  • SQL para consultas de investigação, incluindo join entre tabelas de operação e de evento.
  • Entendimento prático de HTTP, autenticação e webhook, com faro para distinguir falha própria de falha do terceiro.
  • Noção de fila e job agendado suficiente para diagnosticar mensagem travada e reprocessar com critério.
  • Disponibilidade para escala de sobreaviso e atuação fora do horário comercial em incidente crítico e em janela de manutenção.
  • Inglês suficiente para ler documentação técnica e mensagem de erro.
  • Experiência: mínimo de 2 anos em desenvolvimento ou sustentação de software em produção.
  • Qualidade: Clean Code e testes automatizados aplicados à correção, para que o bug corrigido não volte.
  • IA e produtividade: desenvolvimento assistido por IA aplicado à investigação e à correção, com assistentes de código e LLMs para análise de log e uso de skills, commands, workflows, agent teams e harness de agentes para automatizar diagnóstico recorrente, dentro das diretrizes de segurança de dados.

Vai ser um diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia em sustentação, suporte N2 ou SRE.
  • Python para script de diagnóstico e automação de rotina.
  • AWS: SQS, Lambda, CloudWatch e RDS.
  • Ferramenta de observabilidade usada para investigar e para criar alerta, não só instalada.
