raw.description:
Job Description Summary

As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform owns the D&S Palantir Foundry environment and leads delivery across the technical teams that build on it and feed it. This person will own platform health, configuration, access and security markings, and ontology development for the D&S Foundry instance and the shared demonstration environment. This person will also be the program owner for 8+ platform functions (data products, platform support, predictive models, emerging technology, user-facing applications, and fleet data), managing the dependencies between them without owning the teams directly. The role also governs Foundry resources, cost, and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) capacity, and owns the platform's access model, including enrollment of external customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role. It turns the D&S data strategy set by the Chief Technology Office (CTO) into a reliable, governed platform that the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) products and our AI roadmap run on.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Palantir Foundry Platform Ownership

  • Own platform health. Keep the D&S Foundry instance available, performant, and correctly configured, and own the platform roadmap that keeps it that way.
  • Run the demonstration environment. Keep the shared Foundry demo environment current, stable, and ready for customer-facing and leadership demonstrations on short notice.
  • Build the ontology. Drive ontology development in step with front-end work in Workshop and Contour, so the data model and the applications on top of it evolve together.
  • Manage the Palantir roadmap. Serve as the primary vendor contact for licensing, product roadmap, support escalations, and new capability adoption.

Palantir Foundry Resource, Cost, and AIP Management

  • Govern platform resources. Oversee compute allocations, ontology volumes, and storage across every Foundry usage account, and partner with the platform teams to keep resources optimized and fully visible.
  • Own cost attribution. Monitor, analyze, and manage platform consumption and cost down to the usage account, project, and ontology level, with proactive reporting and usage controls (FinOps).
  • Manage AIP capacity. Partner with Palantir to manage AIP utilization, usage thresholds, platform limits, and spend, balancing advanced AI capability against cost containment and operational stability.
  • Security, Access Governance, and B2B Enrollment
  • Own the access model. Own the Foundry security posture: design and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC), fine-grained security roles and markings, and scalable access provisioning, so every dataset and application is visible only to the people cleared to see it.
  • Control intangible exports. Define and maintain the strategy for intangible exports (export-controlled technical data shared electronically through the platform) in partnership with Export Compliance.
  • Run customer B2B enrollment. Oversee business-to-business (B2B) onboarding, identity federation, and enrollment workflows so external customers get secure, compliant multi-tenant access.

Cross-Team Platform Delivery and Dependency Management

  • Run the platform as one program. Coordinate delivery across Data Foundry, Platform Support, Insight Engines, Future Tech Labs, Digital Service Delivery, and Fleet Data Hub Support, plus the Data Flow Engine and Cloud & Solutions Design teams in the CTO organization.
  • Own the dependencies. Map, track, and resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain a single integrated view of the platform roadmap and release plan.
  • Sequence releases. Partner with Platform Support on patch and release management for the D&S Foundry instance so changes land without disrupting users.
  • Bring models into production. Work with Insight Engines to integrate predictive models, machine learning (ML), and simulations into the platform and the applications that use them.
  • Move emerging technology to the platform. Partner with Future Tech Labs to take promising technologies from evaluation and prototype to deployed capability.

Data Products and Platform Strategy

  • Translate strategy into execution. Partner with CTO Architecture & Data to turn the D&S data strategy and technical standards into the DSCX platform roadmap.
  • Centralize critical data products. Work with Data Foundry to model, secure, and publish the data products and semantic layer that DSCX applications depend on.
  • Set the data quality bar. Define data quality, lineage, and governance tagging standards for the platform, and measure against them.
  • Build the foundation for AI. Make sure the data behind TrueChoice Defense (TCD) fleet management and supply optimization, and every AI capability on the DSCX roadmap, is defined, governed, and ready to use.
  • Platform Reliability and Compliance
  • Own the escalation path. Partner with Platform Support on Level 1 through Level 3 (L1-L3) incident resolution and own escalations that cross teams.
  • Keep the platform audit-ready. Drive Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) readiness and vulnerability remediation for the D&S Foundry instance, along with data governance and audit readiness.
  • Partner on infrastructure. Work with CTO Architecture & Data, which owns the Amazon Web Services (AWS) tech stack, the Data Flow Engine, and architecture review, so platform needs are reflected in infrastructure and data delivery decisions.

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead without authority. Align 8+ technical teams behind one platform plan through clear priorities, transparent tradeoffs, and credible follow-through.
  • Set the platform standard. Provide principal-level leadership and mentorship across the D&S Digital Technology team for data platform management.
  • Improve continuously. Use FLIGHT DECK, the GE Aerospace lean operating model, to cut toil and shorten delivery cycles. You will need to be AI experienced and know how to use AI agents to help the platform teams deliver more.

Environment

  • The D&S Foundry instance runs on AWS infrastructure owned by CTO Architecture & Data, with data arriving through the Data Flow Engine from U.S. and international sources. The platform handles export-controlled and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) data, so access controls, security markings, and governance tagging are core to the work. The shared demo environment supports customer-facing and leadership demonstrations alongside the production instance, and external customers access the platform through B2B enrollment.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience, OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 13 years of professional experience, OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 15 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in data platform management, technical product or program management, or a related Distinct Area of Work (DAW).

Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.


Eligibility Requirement:

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired Characteristics:

Technical Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry (ontology, pipelines, Workshop, Contour, security markings) or a comparable enterprise data platform (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Working fluency in data modeling, semantic layers, and data governance.
  • Experience managing consumption-based platform cost and capacity (FinOps), ideally Palantir Foundry and AIP.
  • Experience designing RBAC and identity federation (e.g. SAML, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra B2B) in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Experience with DevSecOps practices, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and secure platform operations in a regulated environment.
  • Experience delivering in an Agile environment (Scrum and Kanban) alongside engineering and architecture teams.

Business Acumen

  • Breaks complex platform roadmaps into sequenced, dependency-aware delivery plans.
  • Manages a strategic software vendor across licensing, roadmap, and support.
  • Connects data quality and platform reliability to the business decisions they support (e.g. fleet readiness, supply optimization).

Leadership

  • Aligns teams they do not manage around a shared plan.
  • Explains the reasoning behind platform tradeoffs.
  • Recognizes when a process needs to change and shapes it with the CTO and platform teams.

Personal Attributes

  • Finds important patterns in seemingly unrelated technical and operational information.
  • Sustains momentum across teams through setbacks.
  • Innovates and integrates new processes that add measurable value to GE Aerospace.

Key Success Metrics:

  • Platform reliability: Foundry availability, incident resolution time against service level agreements (SLAs), and demo environment readiness.
  • Data quality: critical data product coverage, data quality scores, and governance tagging completeness.
  • Delivery velocity: cross-team dependencies delivered on time and release cadence.
  • Compliance: CMMC and vulnerability findings closed on schedule, and audit readiness.
  • Cost and capacity: platform consumption attributed by usage account, project, and ontology; spend and AIP usage within approved thresholds.
  • Access governance: access provisioning time, access reviews completed on schedule, and customer B2B enrollments completed without security findings.

Location and Travel:

Location: Cincinnati, OH (Evendale), strongly preferred. Additional eligible U.S. locations include Atlanta, GA; Livonia, MI; and Niskayuna, NY.

Travel: up to 10% for vendor engagement, cross-team planning, and leadership demonstrations.


Note:

The base pay range for this position is $152,000 to $222,000 annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 13th, 2026.

raw.description:
About Us

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
  • An AI-forward way of working. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
  • A business owner's mindset. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
  • Technical fluency. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
  • A strong point of view, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
  • Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
  • You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
  • You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
  • Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
  • Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
  • Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
  • Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
  • Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
  • Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

US Health Partners

Position Title: FP&A Analyst (Healthcare)

Location: Remote

Travel Required: Less than 5%

Who we are:

US Health Partners (“USHP”) seeks to redefine high-quality specialty care in the United States and establish a high-performing, technology-enabled care delivery platform. USHP is partnering with the country's leading physicians to build a comprehensive, out-patient focused specialty care network targeting the nation's cardiovascular concerns. Our physician-led organization is passionate about supporting exceptional care and enriching the lives of patients across the United States. We envision the opportunity to create a scaled, cutting-edge, technology-enabled healthcare services platform that leverages a value-based delivery model.

Position Summary:

The FP&A Analyst is an experienced contributor to the finance team, playing a key role in the company's budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. This role independently builds and maintains financial models, monitors performance against budget, and delivers polished reporting and analysis that inform leadership decision-making. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced finance professional to deepen their FP&A expertise and take on greater ownership within a growing, physician-led healthcare organization.

Responsibilities may include:

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • -Lead the preparation of components of the annual budget and periodic financial forecasts, working directly with department and business unit leaders.
  • -Consolidate and validate inputs from cross-functional departments, ensuring accuracy and alignment with corporate goals.
  • -Track actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and develop clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Financial Reporting and Analysis:

  • -Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
  • -Independently conduct financial analysis to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • -Build and maintain supporting schedules, dashboards, and executive-ready summaries for leadership review.
  • -Prepare revenue recognition reports as part of the close process, ensuring accurate accruals, cutoffs, and reconciliations across all practices.

Business Partnering:

  • -Serve as a day-to-day finance partner to assigned business units, providing financial insights and guidance to support decision-making.
  • -Proactively respond to data requests from business units and anticipate follow-on questions from leadership.
  • -Lead scenario analysis and ad hoc financial calculations to support business decisions and investment discussions.

Process Improvement:

  • -Identify and lead opportunities to streamline financial models, reports, and recurring processes.
  • -Maintain data integrity and consistency across financial systems and reporting tools, and recommend improvements where gaps are identified.
  • -Document and continuously improve FP&A processes and procedures, and help train junior team members on best practices.

Ad-hoc Analysis:

  • -Lead ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting as requested by the FP&A team or senior management.
  • -Provide analytical support for special projects, business initiatives, and cross-functional strategic efforts as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Experience:

  • -3–5 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or a related role; healthcare or multi-site company experience is a plus.
  • -Solid understanding of financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting techniques, with demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • -Strong proficiency with Excel; experience with financial planning tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) is a plus.

Competencies:

  • -Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into clear, actionable insights.
  • -Confident written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • -Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • -Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.
  • -Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools and data visualization software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, as well as talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand and walk. The employee may lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement:

Employment and processes, including decisions to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, are based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Type: Remote Contract
Location: United States (US work authorization required)
Openings: 2 positions, including 1 Platform Lead

Duration: Multi-month engagement, with potential extension

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are building a senior engineering team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform helps operations leaders understand what is happening across their workforce, make informed decisions, take action within the enterprise systems they already use, and measure the results.

We are looking for two Senior DevOps / Platform Engineers, including one Platform Lead, to design, build, secure, and operate the production infrastructure supporting this platform.

The environment will run within the client's own Azure tenant, handle regulated workforce and operational data, and support isolated production deployments for individual customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring deep Azure expertise, infrastructure as code, cloud security, and production platform ownership. You will establish the initial build environment, develop the production infrastructure, and implement the automation, security controls, observability, and disaster recovery capabilities needed to operate a reliable enterprise platform.

For the Platform Lead position, you will also own key architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and work directly with the client's architects and security teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain production Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, creating reusable modules and automated provisioning processes.

  • Establish the initial build and development environments, followed by secure, production-ready infrastructure within the client's Azure tenant.

  • Design and implement isolated customer deployments, ensuring strict separation of subscriptions, networking, encryption keys, and data stores.

  • Build repeatable infrastructure deployment processes that allow new customer environments to be provisioned consistently and efficiently.

  • Implement secure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time access, and break-glass procedures.

  • Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using client-controlled repositories and runners, including automated testing, security scanning, approval workflows, and controlled production releases.

  • Implement cloud security controls and support enterprise security assessments, penetration testing, compliance reviews, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Build observability capabilities across customer deployments, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, and integration with enterprise SIEM platforms.

  • Design and implement resilient infrastructure, backup strategies, zone redundancy, and disaster recovery solutions, including secondary-region failover capabilities.

  • Define recovery objectives, conduct disaster recovery and performance testing, and document results and remediation actions.

  • Collaborate with application engineers, security teams, enterprise architects, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure meets operational, security, and performance requirements.

  • Develop operational runbooks, infrastructure documentation, and incident response procedures.

  • Participate in production on-call rotations, incident troubleshooting, and post-deployment hypercare.

  • Take ownership of infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

  • For the Platform Lead position, guide technical architecture, establish platform engineering standards, coordinate engineering activities, and represent the team in client architecture and security discussions.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • Senior Azure platform engineering experience. You have designed, built, and operated production Azure environments end to end, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. You have personally implemented infrastructure rather than only maintaining environments designed by others.

  • Infrastructure as code. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform or Bicep, including reusable infrastructure modules, automated provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure lifecycle ownership.

  • Security and regulated environments. You have built production platforms handling PHI or similarly sensitive data and successfully supported HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable enterprise security reviews. You have participated in penetration testing, addressed security findings, and produced technical evidence for compliance assessments.

  • Identity and secrets management. Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time and break-glass access, credential rotation, and secure secrets management. You understand how to eliminate long-lived credentials from pipelines and repositories.

  • Multi-tenant infrastructure architecture. You have designed and operated customer-isolated environments with separate networking, encryption keys, and data stores. You can automate repeatable customer deployments while maintaining strict security boundaries.

  • Secure CI/CD engineering. Experience building production deployment pipelines within enterprise-controlled environments, including secure runners, environment promotion, approval workflows, container and dependency scanning, and coordinated releases across multiple deployments.

  • Disaster recovery and resilience. Hands-on experience implementing backup strategies, zone-redundant infrastructure, secondary-region recovery environments, and documented RTO/RPO objectives. You have personally executed and validated production disaster recovery or failover tests.

  • Observability and production operations. Strong experience implementing logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, security event monitoring, and performance testing. You can troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and participate in on-call support.

  • Technical ownership and stakeholder communication. You can independently own complex infrastructure initiatives, explain architectural decisions to enterprise architects and security reviewers, and document operational procedures and technical trade-offs.

  • Strong English communication. You are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable collaborating directly with US-based engineers, enterprise architects, security teams, and client stakeholders.

  • US location and work authorization. You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the US. Occasional domestic travel may be required.

  • Available around December 1, 2026.

Additional requirement for the Platform Lead: Previous experience leading a small platform engineering team, establishing technical standards, owning architectural decisions, and representing infrastructure designs in enterprise client discussions.

Nice-to-haves

  • Healthcare technology experience, particularly provider, payer, workforce management, or other regulated healthcare platforms.

  • Snowflake administration, including customer-specific environments, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys, replication, and failover.

  • Experience operating graph databases such as Neo4j in production, including clustering, encryption, backup, and patching.

  • Experience deploying and supporting Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, including regional data controls and infrastructure for AI applications.

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, or equivalent security monitoring and governance tools.

  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps for production containerized workloads.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, scripting, and CI/CD engineering.

  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms with strict security, availability, and customer isolation requirements.

Our recruitment process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • Client interview (45 min)

We strive to move efficiently from step to step to make the recruitment process as fast as possible.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Executive Marketing & Operations Coordinator to support day-to-day execution across marketing, executive operations, content, CRM management, and administrative workflows.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and confident working across marketing and operational systems.

You’ll work closely with leadership to keep:

  • Marketing initiatives moving
  • Social media content organized and published
  • GoHighLevel workflows running
  • Leads and follow-ups tracked
  • Executive priorities coordinated
  • Internal systems and documentation organized

If you enjoy combining executive support, marketing coordination, CRM management, and operations, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Executive & Operational Support

  • Track projects, deadlines, tasks, and follow-ups
  • Maintain organized operational trackers and documentation

Social Media & Marketing Execution

You’ll also:

GoHighLevel CRM & Email Marketing

Content & Creative Support

Program & Community Coordination

Research & Lead Generation Support

Website & Platform Support

Required Experience & Skills

    • Marketing Coordination
    • Operations Support
    • Digital Support
    • Similar execution-focused roles
  • Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel CRM
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Proficiency with:
    • Google Docs
    • Google Sheets
    • Google Drive
    • Google Calendar
  • Experience managing LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram
  • Experience using Canva
  • Familiarity with video-editing tools such as Veed, OpusClips, or similar platforms
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote-work setup
  • Ability to work U.S. PST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting founders, coaches, consultants, or entrepreneurial businesses
  • Startup or fast-growth company experience
  • Exposure to lead generation and prospect research
  • Experience with email outreach and nurture campaigns
  • Familiarity with campaign tracking and reporting
  • Experience supporting online communities, programs, or memberships

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are highly organized and execution-focused
  • Take ownership of tasks from start to finish
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Enjoy creating structure across multiple workflows
  • Can balance marketing, administrative, and operational responsibilities
  • Are comfortable switching between different priorities throughout the day
  • Follow up consistently without needing constant reminders
  • Enjoy supporting entrepreneurial leadership in a fast-moving environment

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Managing calendars and executive priorities
  • Updating project and operational trackers
  • Scheduling and publishing social media content
  • Responding to DMs, comments, and community messages
  • Building or updating GoHighLevel workflows

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

IT Support Technician
MSP (Microsoft 365, Active Directory, N-able N-sight RMM)

Remote | Philippines | Part-Time (20 hrs/week) | Php 30,000 – 40,000/month | 5:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT, Mon–Fri (8:00 AM – 12:00 PM NSW, Australian business hours) | Long-Term Remote Role

If you’re a high-performing IT support technician who stays calm on a live support call, works to the clock on SLAs, and writes things down so others can follow them, and you want to work with a growing Australian managed service provider that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading.

This isn’t a role for a “close the ticket and move on” technician who needs every step spelled out.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll be the first responder for an MSP’s clients during the morning support window, resolving issues within agreed service levels and building the documentation that lets the business scale.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with the founders of a young, fast-growing Australian MSP who:

  • Champions Innovation: Runs a modern MSP stack (N-able N-sight RMM, TeamViewer, Microsoft 365, cloud services) and wants your ideas on scripts, checklists and RMM automations that cut repeat issues.
  • Values Your Growth: Supports relevant certifications and continued learning (e.g. Microsoft 365 or cloud), allocates training time on tools you haven’t used yet, and gives you a dedicated Success Manager (CSM) for performance coaching.
  • Respects Your Expertise: Wants a technician who owns the support window and brings a resolution plan, not someone waiting to be told each step.
  • Builds Stability: Is looking for a long-term team extension, with the option to move from part-time to full-time after the first three months based on workload and performance.
  • Includes Benefits: Health insurance (HMO) is included from day one.

You’ll get career transformation, direct visibility with the business owners, and the chance to shape how a growing MSP runs its support, without being stuck as an anonymous seat on a large helpdesk.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core first-line support role covering live phone support, email requests, user administration and routine infrastructure maintenance for clients that are mostly accounting firms and nonprofits. You aren’t just resetting passwords; you’re triaging every request against clear SLAs, keeping clients informed, escalating smartly, and turning rough notes into proper SOPs.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • Live Phone & Email Support: Handling urgent calls (helping the customer live where possible) and email requests through a structured triage flow: review within 10 minutes, resolution plan or escalation within 15 minutes, implement, inform the customer, log a timesheet.
  • SLA-Driven Resolution: Meeting acknowledgment and resolution targets across Critical (15 min / 1–1.5 hrs), Non-Critical (30 min / 2–4 hrs) and Non-Urgent (1 hr / 4–6 hrs) requests.
  • User Lifecycle Management: Onboarding and offboarding users in Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
  • Desktop, Network & Printer Troubleshooting: Resolving everyday end-user issues remotely via N-sight RMM and TeamViewer.
  • Daily Maintenance: Running server, email and Microsoft 365 maintenance checks, and raising and tracking tickets with cloud providers for affected clients.
  • Documentation & SOPs: Turning existing rough documentation into written SOPs for the most frequent request types, so a second technician could be onboarded from them.
  • Continuous Improvement: Spotting recurring issues and proposing a script, checklist or RMM automation that measurably reduces repeat problems or resolution time.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Are a Mid-Level Support Pro: You have solid IT support experience, ideally within an MSP or supporting multiple client environments.
  • Thrive on Live Support: You’ve handled live phone support and email ticket queues against defined SLAs, and stay composed with frustrated users.
  • Know the Microsoft Stack: You have hands-on experience with Active Directory user management, Microsoft 365 administration, and Windows server and email system maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot Methodically: You resolve desktop, network and printer issues and can clearly explain the solution. Expect real-world scenario questions in the interview.
  • Can Script and Speak Cloud: You have working knowledge of scripting (e.g. PowerShell) and foundational cloud knowledge.
  • Have Used an RMM: You’ve worked with an RMM platform (N-able N-sight preferred, comparable tools accepted) and remote-access tools such as TeamViewer.
  • Respect Access Boundaries: You work strictly within the access you’re given and handle sensitive client data with care.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, log your work consistently, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Communicate with Clarity: You explain technical issues plainly to non-technical staff by phone and in writing, and you document procedures by habit.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You’re self-directed and available for an early-morning shift aligned to Australian business hours.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Experience supporting accounting firms or nonprofits.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • SLAs Are Met: You’re consistently acknowledging and resolving client requests within service levels across every priority, backed by timesheet and ticket records.
  • Triage Is Second Nature: Every phone and email request follows the triage flow, and no request is left without a clear next step.
  • The Support Window Is Yours: You independently own first-line support, user on/offboarding and routine server, email and Microsoft 365 maintenance, with the founders involved only for escalations and site visits.
  • Documentation Is Built: Written SOPs cover the most frequent request types and form a library a second technician could learn from.
  • Trust Is Earned: You flag recurring issues and SLA risks before they become client problems, and you’ve proposed at least one concrete improvement to how support runs.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m a solid, reliable technician who’s great with clients and good at fixing things. I just want a team that gives me real ownership, clear SLAs, and room to grow into a bigger role.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

raw.description:
Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Platform & Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, support, and continuously improve our hybrid infrastructure and cloud platforms. This role will be responsible for maintaining highly available, secure, and scalable environments that support both internal business operations and customer-facing digital services, including our growing Homeowner Portal platform. The ideal candidate combines expertise in cloud infrastructure, networking, systems engineering, automation, and platform operations with a strong focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence. This individual will play a key role in cloud transformation initiatives, infrastructure modernization, disaster recovery planning, and DevOps adoption across the organization. This position requires a hands-on engineer who is comfortable working across the full technology stack, from networking and virtualization to cloud services, application delivery, automation, and business continuity planning. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering Design, implement, support, and optimize hybrid infrastructure environments spanning on-premises and Microsoft Azure platforms.

Manage and maintain compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and virtualization services. Assist with infrastructure modernization, migration, and cloud adoption initiatives. Build and maintain highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. Evaluate and implement emerging technologies and services to improve operational efficiency and platform capabilities. Assist with infrastructure lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and performance optimization.

Application Platform & Homeowner Portal Support

Support and maintain the infrastructure and cloud services that power the organization's Homeowner Portal and other customer and non-customer-facing applications. Partner with development teams to design and support scalable, resilient, and secure application hosting environments. Partner to help support web applications, APIs, authentication services, databases, and supporting platform services. Implement and maintain solutions utilizing Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Load Balancers, and related services. Monitor and optimize application performance, availability, and user experience across production environments. Participate in application deployments, release management activities, and production readiness reviews.

DevOps & Automation

Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation and deployment methodologies. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes. Create and maintain scripts, workflows, and deployment pipelines to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort. Support CI/CD practices and collaborate with development teams on deployment automation and platform reliability. Identify opportunities to improve operational maturity through automation and standardization.

Networking & Security

Assist with supporting enterprise networking environments, including routing, switching, VPN connectivity, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, and network security services. Design and support secure hybrid-cloud networking architectures. Assist with supporting identity and access management solutions including Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust security principles. Collaborate with security teams to ensure compliance with organizational policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

Reliability, High Availability & Disaster Recovery

Design and maintain highly available and fault-tolerant infrastructure architectures. Implement and support resiliency solutions including: High Availability (HA) Load balancing Redundancy Active/passive & Active/active failover Assist to Develop, maintain, and test Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) strategies. Support Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) for critical business services. Assist with disaster recovery testing, failover exercises, and recovery validation activities. Support enterprise backup and recovery solutions.

Incident Management & Operational Support

Provide advanced technical support and resolution for infrastructure, cloud, networking, and platform-related incidents. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurring issues. Participate in incident response and major outage management activities. Ensure operational service levels, availability targets, and customer satisfaction objectives are consistently achieved. Collaborate with vendors and third-party partners to resolve technical issues and drive service improvements.

Qualifications & Technical Requirements Required Experience

5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. 3+ years of experience supporting Microsoft Azure cloud environments. Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure architectures. Strong understanding of networking concepts including routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, load balancing, and network security. Experience supporting highly available and mission-critical production environments. Experience supporting customer-facing web applications and digital platforms. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple technology domains.

Cloud & Platform Technologies Experience with:

Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, Conditional Access, (MFA), Azure Virtual Networks, Azure Front Door, Azure Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Azure Load Balancer, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights

Infrastructure & Virtualization Experience with VMware vSphere, Virtual Networking, Enterprise Storage Platforms, Backup and Recovery Solutions Automation & DevOps

Strong PowerShell scripting experience. Experience with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code methodologies. Experience with Git-based source control platforms. Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms. Experience building automated deployment and operational workflows.

Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

Strong understanding of Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) principles. Experience implementing failover, redundancy, backup, recovery, and resiliency solutions. Experience with technologies such as Azure Site Recovery, VMware SRM, Zerto, or similar platforms. Knowledge of disaster recovery testing and recovery validation processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, or similar Infrastructure as Code technologies. Experience with Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience with Azure App Services and cloud-native application hosting platforms. Experience supporting SQL platforms and cloud database services. Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Datadog, or Splunk. Understanding of OWASP security principles and secure application delivery practices. Experience with API management and integration platforms. Cloud architecture experience supporting customer-facing SaaS or web-based platforms.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience considered. Relevant Microsoft, VMware, networking, cloud, or security certifications preferred.

Examples include:

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Success in This Role Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to build and operate highly available cloud and hybrid infrastructure, automate operational processes, support customer-facing platforms such as the Homeowner Portal, and ensure the organization maintains strong security, resiliency, and disaster recovery capabilities while driving continuous improvement across the infrastructure landscape.

raw.description:
*This is a 10 month maternity leave contract*

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission 

Reporting to the Controller, Nuvei-Paya, you will play an instrumental role within the North American accounting team. This position will be responsible for managing the monthly close and general ledger accounting. The Accounting Manger will be responsible for overseeing AP and GL accounting for Paya Holdings. The position requires the desire to take ownership of your work, is self-motivated and a team player.

Main Duties / Responsibilities

  • Manage monthly close and general ledger accounting process
  • Responsible for accounts payable, and general ledger accounting, including fixed assets, payroll, commissions and software capitalization

This role partners with hospital and regional leadership to develop skills in process improvement methodologies and supports the execution of targeted initiatives. The Director serves as a corporate resource and mentor for performance improvement, fostering collaboration and the adoption of evidence-based best practices.

Essential Functions

  • Develops and implements a practical process improvement curriculum to support the skill development of regional and hospital leadership teams.

  • Provides consultation and mentorship to hospital and corporate teams in the development, implementation, and evaluation of process improvement programs.

  • Collaborates with corporate and hospital leadership, service line directors, and quality leaders to improve operations and promote a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
  • This is a remote opportunity.

  • Master's Degree in Nursing, Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required
  • Actively enrolled in a relevant Master’s degree program may be considered
  • 5-7 years of experience in process improvement with a focus on value stream mapping, rapid improvement events, and financial outcome reporting required
  • 3-6 years of management experience with direct report responsibilities required
  • Six Sigma Green Belt Certification required

Preferences:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About The Role

Avalere Health is seeking aResearchScientistIto join our Evidence & Strategy Practice. The practice focuses on a range of issues including developingvalue-based assessments and supporting evidence generation; quantitative, qualitative, and feasibility studies utilizing a broad range of open and closed source datasets; go-to-market strategies and tactics for an evidence-differentiated offering. We rely on deep subject matter expertise and understanding of the business issues facing our clients to assess how the changing healthcare evidence, market access and policy landscape impacts the pharmaceutical industry, managed care plans, providers, and consumers. We provide analytic support and advisory services, including legislative strategy, regulatory analysis, and quantitative modeling of proposed and enacted policies to a wide range of clients across the healthcare industry.

What you'll do

  • Perform data management activities to generate analytic-ready dataset, such as importing, transforming, merging and validating data to deliver accurate, reproducible results using SQL and/or SAS.
  • Perform descriptive and basic statistical analysis using large patient and/or claims databases in support of economic and outcomes modeling to execute analysis plans and support client strategic objectives.
  • Independently develops and troubleshoots code, resolves data issues, and seeks guidance on higher-risk methodological or client-impacting decisions.
  • Contributes to the development of concept proposals, scope of work, budgets, and analysis plans.
  • Independently manages workflow and make direct contributions to the research and analysis process.
  • Works within and across organizational analytics teams to identify areas for delivering innovation to clients.
  • Ensuring the accuracy, quality, and consistency of analytic outputs.

About you

    Minimum Requirements:

  • BA/BS or higher in computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics, data science, epidemiology, statistics or related discipline
  • 3+ years of SAS or SQL programming experience in a work setting
  • Experience analyzing large administrative pharmacy and medical claims databases (public and private)
  • Experience with importing data, transforming, cleaning, merging, and editing data and extensive quality/accuracy measures
  • Working knowledge of basic statistical techniques and/or econometric skills
  • Demonstrated problem solving, analytical reasoning and decision-making skills and strong commitment to meeting goals and deadlines
  • Positive, flexible and self-motivated attitude, with excellent teamwork skills and ability to work in a multi-disciplinary environment
  • Comfortable working in a remote/hybrid environment with demonstrated ability to be productive and self-guided.

About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced English into Lithuanian linguists specializing in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) documentation translation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate medical device and in vitro diagnostics documentation from English (US) into Lithuanian.

  • Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated content, ensuring accuracy, terminology consistency, and compliance with project-specific quality requirements.

  • Review and address QA feedback and client feedback on flagged linguistic issues.

  • Meet agreed deadlines and maintain high-quality standards across assigned tasks.

  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment (memoQ 12.5 or higher), using the provided license.

  • Follow project-specific instructions and workflows.

Field of Expertise

  • Medical Devices: Instructions for Use (IFUs), User Manuals, product documentation, labeling, and other medical device-related materials.

  • In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD): Diagnostic test documentation, instructions for use, product information, labeling, and other IVD-related materials.

Must-Have Criteria

Education and Professional Experience

Applicants must meet at least one of the following criteria:

  • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree); or

  • A recognized graduate qualification in another field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional translation experience; or

  • A minimum of five years of full-time professional translation experience.

Relevant Translation Experience

  • At least two years of professional experience in Life Sciences translation, specifically in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).

  • Proven experience translating medical documentation in the relevant fields.

  • Experience limited to patent translation will not be considered sufficient.

  • Ability to perform both Translation and Copy Edit tasks.

Technical Skills

  • Mandatory: Experience with memoQ, version 12.5 or higher.

  • A suitable desktop version of memoQ must be installed. A free version is acceptable; a license will be provided by Welo Global.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word and document editing workflows.

Nice-to-Have

  • Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Biomedical Sciences, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology, or a related field.

  • Previous in-house experience within a medical device manufacturer, diagnostics company, or Life Sciences organization.

  • Experience with ISO standards and quality-controlled translation workflows.

Project Details

  • Language Pair: English (US) into Lithuanian.

  • Service Line: Life Sciences – Medical Devices.

  • Task Types: Translation and Copy Edit.

  • Expected Capacity: Ongoing weekly availability.

Translation is paid per word, while Copy Edit is compensated per hour or per word, depending on the task size. For smaller Copy Edit assignments, payment will be calculated per word, as minimum fees cannot be offered.

Additional QA feedback checks and client feedback reviews may also be assigned as part of the initial project scope, without a separate purchase order.

Before Applying

Please note that an assessment will be part of our onboarding and quality procedure. Only apply if you are willing to complete the assessment.

Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical Devices translation experience, including:

  • Total years of professional translation experience.

  • Years of experience specifically in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics.

  • Examples of medical documentation and content types translated.

  • Your experience with memoQ (please specify the version used).

  • Your experience performing both Translation and Copy Edit.

  • Your contact information (email AND phone number).

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

We look forward to receiving your application!

raw.description:
Stage SEO : Off Page

GreenTomatoMedia · À distance ou à Chiang Mai (Thaïlande) · 6 mois, dès que possible

Le stage

Une partie de notre stratégie SEO repose sur la publication d’articles sur des médias tiers : sites d’actu, de sport, de lifestyle, en France et à l’international. Le principe est de s’appuyer sur la puissance de ces sites pour positionner nos contenus sur des requêtes très concurrentielles dans l’iGaming.

Tu rejoins l’équipe SEO pour piloter ces publications de bout en bout, du choix du média jusqu’au suivi des positions. Tes décisions ont un impact visible dès les premières semaines.

Si tu aimes comprendre pourquoi un site ranke, écrire des contenus qui performent et voir tes articles grimper dans Google, ce stage est pour toi.

Tes missions

  • Analyser des médias pour repérer ceux qui ont le meilleur potentiel : autorité, trafic, thématique, mots-clés et pages sur lesquels ils se positionnent déjà.
  • Choisir, pour chaque média, les mots-clés qu’il a réellement les moyens de viser.
  • Analyser les SERP et les concurrents pour comprendre ce qui ranke, et construire des plans d’articles qui collent aux attentes de Google.
  • Rédiger et optimiser les articles publiés sur ces médias, en français et dans d’autres langues selon les marchés.
  • Préparer les articles pour la publication : mise en forme, tableaux, comparatifs.
  • Suivre les positions et le trafic des articles publiés, et proposer des mises à jour quand c’est nécessaire.
  • Utiliser l’IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex) pour aller plus vite sur l’analyse, la rédaction et les tâches répétitives. On te montrera comment on s’en sert au quotidien.

Marchés et langues

Nos publications couvrent de nombreux marchés européens et internationaux. Chaque langue que tu maîtrises est un vrai atout : précise-les dans ta candidature.

Ton profil

  • Un œil exigeant à l’écrit, quelle que soit la langue : tu sais juger si un article tient la route et le retravailler.
  • Un vrai goût pour l’analyse : tu aimes creuser les données d’un site pour comprendre ce qu’il vaut.
  • Une première approche des outils SEO (Ahrefs, Semrush ou équivalents) est un plus.
  • Un bon niveau d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
  • De la curiosité pour l’IA : tu utilises déjà ChatGPT ou Claude, et idéalement tu as testé Claude Code ou Codex.
  • À l’aise avec l’univers de l’iGaming.
  • Autonome, organisé(e) et rapide, avec le souci du détail.

Infos pratiques

  • Lieu : à distance ou à Chiang Mai (Thaïlande)
  • Horaires : 35 h par semaine, flexibles, dont 4 heures par jour en commun avec ton manager
  • Durée : 6 mois
  • Début : dès que possible
  • Congés : 1 jour par mois
  • Rémunération : 1 000 € par mois en télétravail

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Apprendre une stratégie SEO que peu d’agences maîtrisent, sur des projets réels.
  • Travailler sur des niches parmi les plus concurrentielles du web.
  • Un suivi direct et des retours quotidiens.
  • Des méthodes de travail modernes, assistées par l’IA.
  • Une équipe sympa et une ambiance détendue.

Le processus de recrutement

  1. Candidature et entretien RH : si ton profil nous intéresse, on te propose un premier échange.
  2. Test pratique : une mise en situation proche du poste.
  3. Entretien avec le SEO Manager : on revient ensemble sur ton test, et tu rencontres la personne avec qui tu travailleras chaque jour.

Pour postuler

Envoie ton CV avec quelques lignes sur toi : les langues que tu parles, ton expérience en rédaction ou en SEO, et les outils d’IA que tu utilises.

Salary: 1000 EUR

  • Conduct user training and support for assigned facilities via live chat, video conference, and phone as needed

During the hiring process, your recruiter can provide more information about the specific salary range for the job location.

Sales positions receive short-term incentives through commission plans and bonuses. On the other hand, non-sales positions have starting salaries that consist of a base salary and short-term incentives through various bonus plans, which are paid out monthly, quarterly, or annually.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Level 3 AWS Cloud Engineer to join an Infrastructure Services team supporting fast-paced, cloud-focused customer environments. This role is ideal for a hands-on cloud professional with strong AWS expertise and experience designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure.

You will work extensively with Infrastructure as Code, containerisation, serverless technologies, cloud security, monitoring, and CI/CD, while collaborating with DevOps, software engineering, and security teams to deliver robust production-grade solutions.

About the Client

You will be working with an established Australian technology services organisation that provides infrastructure and cloud solutions to a range of customers. The organisation focuses on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable technology environments while helping clients modernise and optimise their cloud infrastructure.

The team promotes technical excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, providing cloud engineers with the opportunity to work across modern AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.

Ideal Profile

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or a related role.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across AWS services including EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, and IAM.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services.
  • Proven experience designing and managing production-grade cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with Terraform preferred.
  • Understanding of IaC best practices including version control, modularisation, reusability, and automated provisioning.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation.
  • Strong Git and GitHub workflow experience.

Containers & CI/CD

  • Experience managing containerised applications using ECS and/or Kubernetes.
  • Kubernetes experience with EKS, AKS, or self-managed clusters is highly desirable.
  • Experience collaborating with development teams to implement CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and/or GitLab CI.

Monitoring, Security & Databases

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and Azure Monitor.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, encryption, and network security.
  • Working knowledge of databases and SQL.
  • Understanding of cloud compliance and organisational security standards.

Personal Attributes

  • Self-motivated with a strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Collaborative approach with a willingness to share knowledge.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for delivering reliable cloud solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator Associate, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator are highly desirable.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, deploy, manage, and maintain cloud-based solutions primarily across AWS, with additional exposure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Build highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments.
  • Manage and optimise AWS infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, databases, serverless, and identity services.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to stakeholders on cloud infrastructure initiatives.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
  • Apply best practices for version control, modularisation, reusability, and maintainability across IaC solutions.
  • Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve infrastructure deployment and operational efficiency.

Containers & CI/CD

  • Deploy, manage, and optimise ECS and Kubernetes environments supporting containerised applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to design and implement effective CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support deployment automation and improve the reliability and consistency of software delivery processes.
  • Troubleshoot container and deployment-related issues across production environments.

Monitoring, Performance & Cost Optimisation

  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability.
  • Monitor cloud infrastructure performance and proactively identify potential issues.
  • Optimise cloud resource utilisation to improve cost efficiency and application performance.
  • Investigate incidents and implement appropriate improvements to maintain service reliability.

Security & Collaboration

  • Apply cloud security best practices across IAM policies, encryption, networking, and infrastructure configuration.
  • Ensure cloud environments align with relevant organisational and industry compliance standards.
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external DevOps, software engineering, and security teams.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and industry practices to continuously improve infrastructure services.

NICE TO HAVE

You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.
